+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The Kimi K3.1 specialized decode's DCP top-k exchange over a real DCP group
+(4 GPUs of one node, NVLink; the local select needs N = 1.5 K / W < 1024, so
+W >= 4): the fused indexer's local select pushes its B' rows into
+every rank's symmetric exchange slots and ExchangeMerge merges them
+(FusedIndexer.run_exchange, topk_exchange.py), against the #63 path it
+replaces (run_dcp's B' rows, NCCL all-gather, select + rescue:
+dcp_topk_merge_rows) on the same MXFP4 shards: this rank's KV rows, counts and
+the global ids bit-equal, in the same order; eagerly over several calls (both
+epoch parities), replayed from a CUDA graph, and over a padded batch (rows
+past the step's decodes come out empty).
+
+Shapes: 1, 4, 12, 28 and 62 requests x q = 5 (5-310 rows: one select row per
+SM up to 140, rows sharing SMs at 310, the HIGH hybrid decode's batch) at
+~136.5K and ~32K contexts plus short ones, with rows whose keys on one rank
+lead the row's global top-K (a saturated rank: the rescue round). At 310 rows
+the stock path selects candidates with DeepSelect, which may resolve ties at a
+rank's N-th logit to other keys: there both paths must select the exact global
+top-K logits, and the exchange must equal #63's merge of the same candidates.
+"""
+
+import time
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="the fused FP4 indexer and the DCP top-k merge need SM100",
+)
+
+TOPK, UNIT, ROW, Q = 2048, 64, 68, 5
+WORLD = 4
+REQUESTS = (1, 4, 12, 28, 62)
+
+
+def _contexts(requests, world, n):
+    base = [136_505, 32_773, 100, world * (n + 7), 2_050, 120_000]
+    return [base[r % len(base)] + 997 * (r // len(base)) for r in range(requests)]
+
+
+def _case(requests, world, n, seed):
+    """The unsharded MXFP4 cache (identical on every rank), block table, per-row
+    ends, MXFP4 query rows and head weights; odd requests' keys on rank
+    r % world get 2^4 larger scales (that rank saturates)."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    contexts = _contexts(requests, world, n)
+    need = [-(-(c + Q) // UNIT) for c in contexts]
+    blocks = sum(need)
+    cache = torch.empty(blocks, UNIT, ROW, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    pages = cache.view(blocks, UNIT * ROW)
+    pages[:, : UNIT * 64] = torch.randint(
+        0, 256, (blocks, UNIT * 64), device="cuda", generator=gen
+    ).to(torch.uint8)
+    scales = torch.randint(118, 132, (blocks, UNIT, 4), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+    table = torch.zeros(requests, max(need), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    used = 0
+    for r, k in enumerate(need):
+        table[r, :k] = torch.arange(used, used + k, dtype=torch.int32)
+        if r % 2:
+            keys = torch.arange(k * UNIT, device="cuda")
+            mine = keys % world == r % world
+            scales[used : used + k].view(-1, 4)[mine] += 4
+        used += k
+    pages[:, UNIT * 64 :] = scales.to(torch.uint8).view(blocks, -1)
+    ends = torch.tensor(
+        [c + 1 + j for c in contexts for j in range(Q)],
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    rows = requests * Q
+    q_rows = torch.zeros(max(rows, 64), 32, 128, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    packed, q_scales = fp4_query_views(q_rows, rows)
+    packed.copy_(
+        torch.randint(0, 256, packed.shape, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(
+            torch.uint8
+        )
+    )
+    exps = torch.randint(118, 132, (rows, 32, 4), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+    q_scales.copy_(exps.to(torch.uint8).view(torch.int32).view(rows, 32))
+    weights = torch.randn(max(rows, 64), 32, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.1
+    return cache, table, ends, q_rows, weights.bfloat16()
+
+
+def _shard(cache, table, ends, requests, world, rank):
+    """This rank's interleave-1 shard as its own paged cache, table, ends."""
+    local_ends = ((ends - rank + world - 1) // world).clamp_min(0).int()
+    lengths = local_ends.view(requests, Q)[:, -1].tolist()
+    need = [-(-max(x, 1) // UNIT) for x in lengths]
+    blocks = sum(need) + 1
+    local = torch.zeros(blocks, UNIT, ROW, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    src = cache.view(cache.shape[0], UNIT * ROW)
+    dst = local.view(blocks, UNIT * ROW)
+    s_codes, s_scales = src[:, : UNIT * 64].view(-1, UNIT, 64), src[:, UNIT * 64 :]
+    d_codes, d_scales = dst[:, : UNIT * 64].view(-1, UNIT, 64), dst[:, UNIT * 64 :]
+    s_scales, d_scales = s_scales.view(-1, UNIT, 4), d_scales.view(-1, UNIT, 4)
+    local_table = torch.zeros(requests, max(need), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    order = torch.randperm(blocks - 1, generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(rank))
+    used = 0
+    for r, (length, k) in enumerate(zip(lengths, need)):
+        ids = order[used : used + k].to("cuda").int()
+        local_table[r, :k] = ids
+        used += k
+        if not length:
+            continue
+        i = torch.arange(length, device="cuda")
+        g = i * world + rank
+        blk, pos = table[r][g // UNIT].long(), g % UNIT
+        lb, lp = ids[i // UNIT].long(), i % UNIT
+        d_codes[lb, lp] = s_codes[blk, pos]
+        d_scales[lb, lp] = s_scales[blk, pos]
+    return local, local_table, local_ends
+
+
+def _check(group):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.topk_exchange import (  # noqa: E501
+        reserve,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge import dcp_merge_local_topk
+
+    world, rank = group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+    n = dcp_merge_local_topk(TOPK, world)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    exchange = reserve(group.device_group, device, world, rank, 64 * Q, n)
+    saturated = 0
+    for requests in REQUESTS:
+        saturated += _check_requests(group, exchange, n, requests)
+        torch.distributed.barrier(group=group.cpu_group)
+    assert saturated > 0, "no saturated row: the rescue round never ran"
+
+
+def _merge_local_select(fused, rows, logits, row_ends, args):
+    """#63's NCCL merge over the fused local select's B' rows (its push-variant
+    kernel; the pushes it also makes carry the current epoch and are rewritten
+    by the next exchange call)."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        stream,
+        to_cute,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import dcp_topk_merge_rows
+
+    local, _ = fused.exchange_kernels[rows, Q]
+    out, valid = fused.out[:rows], fused.valid[:rows]
+    local(
+        to_cute(fused.logits),
+        to_cute(row_ends, 4),
+        to_cute(out, 4),
+        to_cute(valid, 4),
+        *fused.exchange_args(),
+        stream(fused.device),
+    )
+    dcp_topk_merge_rows(logits=logits, row_ends=row_ends, packed=out, **args)
+
+
+def _same_logits(group, logits, row_ends, stock, ours, rows, max_local_len):
+    """Per row: this rank's same count of KV rows, and the selected global ids'
+    logits (gathered from every rank's local logits) the multiset of the row's
+    exact top-K logits, for both paths."""
+    world, width = group.world_size, min(max_local_len, logits.shape[1])
+    local = logits[:rows, :width].contiguous()
+    every = group.all_gather(local.unsqueeze(0), dim=0)  # [W, rows, width]
+    ends = group.all_gather(row_ends[:rows].contiguous().unsqueeze(0), dim=0)
+    assert torch.equal(stock[1], ours[1]), "counts"
+    bad = {"stock": [], "exchange": []}
+    for t in range(rows):
+        row = torch.cat([every[r, t, : int(ends[r, t])] for r in range(world)])
+        c = min(TOPK, row.numel())
+        exact = row.float().topk(c).values.sort().values
+        for name, out in (("stock", stock), ("exchange", ours)):
+            ids = out[2][t].long()
+            ids = ids[ids >= 0]
+            if ids.numel() != c:
+                bad[name].append(t)
+                continue
+            got = every[ids % world, t, ids // world].float().sort().values
+            if not torch.equal(got, exact):
+                bad[name].append(t)
+    assert not bad["exchange"], ("exchange not the exact top-K", bad)
+    assert not bad["stock"], ("stock not the exact top-K", bad)
+
+
+def _check_requests(group, exchange, n, requests):
+    """One shape: the exchange path against the stock one; returns the rows
+    with a saturated rank."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.indexer import (
+        FusedIndexer,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import dcp_topk_merge_rows
+
+    world, rank = group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    rows = requests * Q
+    cache, table, ends, q_rows, weights = _case(requests, world, n, requests)
+    local, local_table, local_ends = _shard(cache, table, ends, requests, world, rank)
+    max_model_len = int(ends.max()) + 64
+    max_local_len = -(-max_model_len // world)
+    indexer = SimpleNamespace(
+        k_cache=SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=local),
+        topk_tokens=TOPK,
+        max_model_len=max_model_len,
+        dcp_world_size=world,
+    )
+    decode = SimpleNamespace(
+        seq_lens=local_ends.view(rows, 1),
+        block_table=local_table.repeat_interleave(Q, 0),
+    )
+    fused = FusedIndexer(
+        indexer,
+        [(rows, Q)],
+        device,
+        rows,
+        local_topk=n,
+        packed=True,
+        page=UNIT,
+        exchange=exchange,
+    )
+    assert fused.exchanges(rows), rows
+    mla_blocks = -(-int(local_ends.max()) // UNIT) + 1
+    mla_table = torch.arange(requests * mla_blocks, device="cuda").int()
+    mla_table = mla_table.flip(0).view(requests, mla_blocks).contiguous()
+    req_id = torch.arange(requests, device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32)
+    req_id = req_id.repeat_interleave(Q).contiguous()
+
+    def outputs(fill):
+        return (
+            torch.full((rows, TOPK), fill, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            torch.full((rows,), fill, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+            torch.full((rows, TOPK), fill, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),
+        )
+
+    def merge_args(out):
+        return dict(
+            max_local_len=max_local_len,
+            local_topk=n,
+            topk=TOPK,
+            req_id=req_id,
+            block_table=mla_table,
+            block_size=UNIT,
+            stride_rows=UNIT,
+            dcp_rank=rank,
+            rows_out=out[0],
+            valid_out=out[1],
+            ids_out=out[2],
+        )
+
+    # Stock: B' rows, NCCL all-gather, select + rescue (#63).
+    ref = outputs(-9)
+    packed, logits, row_ends = fused.run_dcp(q_rows, weights, decode, rows, Q)
+    dcp_topk_merge_rows(
+        logits=logits, row_ends=row_ends, packed=packed, **merge_args(ref)
+    )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    if packed is None:
+        # Past the SM count the stock path selects the B' rows with DeepSelect
+        # + #63's pack, the exchange with the fused local select: the same
+        # exact top-N, but ties at a rank's N-th logit may resolve to other
+        # keys. The global selection must hold the same logits; the exact
+        # comparison below is against the NCCL merge over the local select's
+        # own B' rows.
+        stock = ref
+        ref = outputs(-9)
+        _merge_local_select(fused, rows, logits, row_ends, merge_args(ref))
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        _same_logits(group, logits, row_ends, stock, ref, rows, max_local_len)
+    sat = (fused.workspace.sat_word[:rows] >> 16).ne(0)
+
+    def exchange_call(out):
+        merge = req_id, mla_table, UNIT, out[0], out[1], max_local_len
+        fused.run_exchange(q_rows, weights, decode, rows, Q, merge, out[2])
+
+    for call in range(3):  # both epoch parities
+        got = outputs(-7)
+        exchange_call(got)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        for a, b, what in zip(got, ref, ("rows", "counts", "ids")):
+            assert torch.equal(a, b), (rank, requests, call, what)
+        assert torch.equal((fused.workspace.sat_word[:rows] >> 16).ne(0), sat), (
+            rank,
+            requests,
+            call,
+        )
+    # Replayed from a CUDA graph (the epochs advance on the device).
+    got = outputs(-5)
+    side = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(side):
+        exchange_call(got)  # warm
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    torch.distributed.barrier(group=group.cpu_group)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        exchange_call(got)
+    for _ in range(2):
+        for t in got:
+            t.fill_(-3)
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        for a, b, what in zip(got, ref, ("rows", "counts", "ids")):
+            assert torch.equal(a, b), (rank, requests, "graph", what)
+    # A padded batch (the step's decodes fill only the first rows; merge_rows
+    # runs the exchange over every row of the batch): the live rows as above,
+    # the rows past them empty, as the stock path's fill.
+    if requests > 1:
+        live = rows - Q
+        short = SimpleNamespace(
+            seq_lens=decode.seq_lens[:live], block_table=decode.block_table[:live]
+        )
+        got = outputs(-7)
+        merge = req_id, mla_table, UNIT, got[0], got[1], max_local_len
+        fused.run_exchange(q_rows, weights, short, rows, Q, merge, got[2])
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+        for a, b, what in zip(got, ref, ("rows", "counts", "ids")):
+            assert torch.equal(a[:live], b[:live]), (rank, requests, "padded", what)
+        assert bool((got[0][live:] == -1).all()), (rank, requests)
+        assert bool((got[1][live:] == 0).all()), (rank, requests)
+        assert bool((got[2][live:] == -1).all()), (rank, requests)
+    # Every rank selects the same ids.
+    every = group.all_gather(ref[2].unsqueeze(0), dim=0)
+    for other in range(world):
+        assert torch.equal(every[other], every[0]), (requests, other)
+    return int(sat.sum())
+
+
+def run_worker(rank, world, init_method):
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+        get_dcp_group,
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge import init_dcp_topk_merge
+
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    config = VllmConfig()
+    config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size = world
+    config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size = world
+    config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs = 64
+    config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens = 8192
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        init_distributed_environment(
+            world_size=world,
+            rank=rank,
+            local_rank=rank,
+            distributed_init_method=init_method,
+        )
+        initialize_model_parallel(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=world, decode_context_model_parallel_size=world
+        )
+        try:
+            gate = SimpleNamespace(
+                parallel_config=config.parallel_config,
+                kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                    sparse_indexer_topk_backend="auto", enable_jit_warmup=False
+                ),
+                model_config=SimpleNamespace(max_model_len=world << 17),
+                scheduler_config=config.scheduler_config,
+                compilation_config=config.compilation_config,
+                speculative_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                    num_speculative_tokens=Q - 1, parallel_drafting=False
+                ),
+                num_speculative_tokens=Q - 1,
+                use_v2_model_runner=True,
+            )
+            assert init_dcp_topk_merge(gate, TOPK), "merge disabled"
+            _check(get_dcp_group())
+        finally:
+            cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(torch.accelerator.device_count() < WORLD, reason="Need 4 GPUs.")
+def test_k31_dsa_topk_exchange_matches_stock():
+    init_method = f"tcp://127.0.0.1:{get_open_port()}"
+    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
+    procs = [
+        ctx.Process(target=run_worker, args=(r, WORLD, init_method))
+        for r in range(WORLD)
+    ]
+    for p in procs:
+        p.start()
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 600
+    for p in procs:
+        p.join(timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+    for p in procs:
+        if p.is_alive():
+            p.kill()
+            p.join()
+    assert [p.exitcode for p in procs] == [0] * WORLD

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode at DEP2 (TP1 attention per DP rank + EP2 MoE) on 2
+real ranks: admission (TP1 + EP, FP32 KDA conv and recurrent state, RecoverSSM),
+the DEP plan (``SpecializedDecode.build_dep`` / ``plan``: q = 5 verify steps take
+``run_wide``), and the step's output against the stock decode
+of the same step.
+
+Each rank runs ``vllm bench forward`` in-process on a layer-truncated K3.1
+(``KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL``: a config-only K3.1 directory with a few layers, e.g. 3
+KDA + 1 DSA + MegaMoE layers; dummy weights, balanced EP routing). The bench
+compares the step's CUDA graph replay (captured: the specialized decode) with the
+same step run eagerly (outside a capture the specialized decode never plans: the
+stock forward), per rank. Contexts stay below the DSA top-k (2048), so both paths
+attend over every token and the routing is the bench's fixture on both: the
+outputs differ only by accumulation order and FP8 / BF16 rounding.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+MODEL = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL")
+# Its DSpark draft config (target layers inside the truncated model).
+DRAFT = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_DRAFT")
+WORLD = 2
+# Per DP rank: DSpark k = 4 verify (q = 5) steps. (Under DSpark the KDA metadata
+# counts draft-less decodes as spec decodes, so a q = 1 step is not uniform and
+# runs stock, at TP8 as at DEP.)
+CASES = ("v1=1*5@1900:4", "v4=4*5@1500:4", "v16=16*5@1100:4")
+# The deployment's capture sizes (rows).
+CAPTURE = (5, 20, 80)
+

+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode at DEP: every MegaMoE layer's ``DepMoe`` (the
+EpMoeLayer schedule: split-K [shared gate_up | latent down] front, side-stream
+router and shared expert, MegaMoE routed experts, latent RMSNorm + up-projection)
+against the stock ``KimiMoE.forward`` on identical inputs, on real ranks (DEP2 by
+default; ``KIMI_K31_DEP_MOE_WORLD=4`` runs DEP4 on one 4-GPU node).
+
+Live routed experts: under ``--load-format dummy`` MegaMoE's packed int32 UE8M0
+weight scales stay 0, so the routed experts output exactly 0 and a step test
+cannot see the routed path (router, top-k weights, dispatch, combine, latent norm
+and up-projection). Here every expert scale is set to 2^-2, the router weight is
+scaled so the sigmoid top-16 is decisive, and the shared expert is scaled so both
+branches carry comparable magnitude; the test asserts the routed experts' output is
+live (a sizeable share of the layer output).
+
+Each rank runs ``vllm bench forward`` in-process on a layer-truncated K3.1
+(``KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL``, its DSpark draft config ``KIMI_K31_DEP_DRAFT``) with real
+routing. During the eager (stock) step, every MoE layer whose batch a DepMoe
+serves takes the layer's input plus per-row noise (distinct rows) through both
+``KimiMoE.forward`` and ``DepMoe.run`` (every DP rank at the same layer and batch,
+as the MegaMoE collective requires) and compares the outputs row by row; a
+row-shifted copy of the output is the negative control.
+
+Bound: both paths quantize the latent to MXFP8 for MegaMoE's FP4 x FP8 experts;
+the schedule's split-K front reduces the BF16 latent in another order, and one
+BF16 ulp flips some FP8 activation codes (and the split-K FP32 router order can
+flip a near-tie expert), so rows differ by up to ~2e-2. A row placed or routed
+wrongly differs by O(1).
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+MODEL = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL")
+DRAFT = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_DRAFT")
+WORLD = int(os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_MOE_WORLD", "2"))

+CASES = ("v1=1*5@1900:4", "v4=4*5@1500:4", "v16=16*5@1100:4")
+CAPTURE = (5, 20, 80)
+# E8M0 2^-2 in every byte of the packed int32 UE8M0 scales: the routed latent's
+# RMS then sits far above the latent RMSNorm's sqrt(eps) (at 2^-7 SiTU's quadratic

+        model = load(self, *args, **kwargs)
+        with torch.no_grad():
+            tensors = [*model.named_parameters(), *model.named_buffers()]
+            for name, t in tensors:

+def compare_layers(records):
+    """After each eager KimiMoE.forward whose batch a DepMoe serves, run the DepMoe
+    on the same rows and record the per-row error and the routed share."""
+    import vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.model as km
+    import vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.runtime.dep as dep
+
+    moes = {}
+    init = dep.DepMoe.__init__
+
+    def register(self, module, *args, **kwargs):
+        init(self, module, *args, **kwargs)
+        moes[id(module)] = self
+
+    dep.DepMoe.__init__ = register
+    stock = km.KimiMoE.forward
+
+    def forward(self, hidden_states):
+        moe = moes.get(id(self))
+        rows = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if (
+            moe is None
+            or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+            or not moe.serves(rows)
+        ):
+            return stock(self, hidden_states)
+        out = stock(self, hidden_states)
+        # The layer's input at unit RMS plus unit per-row noise: no two rows are
+        # equal (the bench's dummy batch repeats rows), and both branches keep
+        # their share at every layer (the dummy residual stream grows per layer).
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=hidden_states.device).manual_seed(len(records))
+        noise = torch.randn(
+            hidden_states.shape, generator=gen, device=hidden_states.device
+        )
+        h = hidden_states.float()
+        rms = h.pow(2).mean().sqrt().clamp(min=1e-20)
+        x = (h / rms + noise).to(hidden_states.dtype)
+        routed = []

+            lambda m, i, o: routed.append(o.float().pow(2).mean().sqrt().item())

+        shifted = (got.roll(1, dims=0) - ref).norm(dim=1) / norms
+        # The routed branch's share: RMSNorm(routed latent) up-projected, i.e. the
+        # layer output minus the stock shared expert.
+        shared = self.shared_experts(x).float()

+            dict(
+                rows=rows,
+                rel=((got - ref).norm() / ref.norm()).item(),
+                row_max=err.max().item(),
+                shifted_min=shifted.min().item() if rows > 1 else float("inf"),
+                routed_rms=routed[0] if routed else 0.0,
+                routed_share=((ref - shared).norm() / ref.norm()).item(),
+            )
+        )
+        return out
+
+    km.KimiMoE.forward = forward

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DEP EP dispatch / combine (specialized_decode/cutedsl/moe/ep/comm.py) on real ranks.
+
+Dispatch: every received row (static slot source x T + token) is the source token's
+MXFP8 latent, bit-identical to ``flashinfer.mxfp8_quantize``, with its ids, weights and
+source; exactly the tokens with a local expert arrive; empty rows stay non-local. A
+stand-in expert (a per-expert scale of the dequantized row, routing-weighted) fills the
+outputs; combine must return vLLM's RMSNorm of the rank-order FP32 sum of the BF16
+per-rank partials. Repeated calls and a CUDA-graph replay exercise the flag re-arming.
+
+pytest: 4 local GPUs (spawned ranks). Multi-node (16 / 32 ranks, one process per GPU):
+  srun -N4 -n16 python \
+    tests/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/specialized_decode/test_kimi_k3_sdec_ep_comm.py
+"""
+
+import os
+import socket
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+LATENT, TOPK, EXPERTS = 3584, 16, 896
+
+
+def dequant(x, sf):
+    """MXFP8 rows [R, 3584] fp8 + E8M0 [R, 112] -> FP32."""
+    scale = torch.exp2(sf.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, dim=1)
+    return x.float() * scale
+
+
+def stand_in(rows, ids, weights, rank, local):
+    """BF16 sum over the row's local experts of w * dequant(row) * (1 + e % 7) / 8."""
+    x = dequant(*rows)
+    total = torch.zeros_like(x)
+    for j in range(TOPK):
+        e = ids[:, j]
+        mine = (e // local) == rank
+        factor = torch.where(mine, weights[:, j] * (1 + e % 7).float() / 8, 0)
+        total += factor[:, None] * x
+    return total.to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def worker(rank, world, tokens_list=(1, 5, 37)):
+    from flashinfer import mxfp8_quantize
+
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe.ep.comm import stride
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe.ep.layer import (
+        EpRouted,
+    )
+
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.cuda.current_device())
+    group = dist.group.WORLD
+    local = EXPERTS // world
+    ep = EpRouted(group, max(tokens_list), device)
+    norm_w = (torch.rand(LATENT, device=device) + 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(100 + rank)
+    for tokens in tokens_list:
+        latent = (torch.randn(tokens, LATENT, device=device, generator=gen) * 3).to(
+            torch.bfloat16
+        )
+        ids = (
+            torch.rand(tokens, EXPERTS, device=device, generator=gen)
+            .topk(TOPK, dim=1)
+            .indices.int()
+        )
+        weights = torch.rand(tokens, TOPK, device=device, generator=gen) + 0.05
+        everyone = [torch.empty_like(v) for v in (latent, ids, weights)]
+        gathered = []
+        for v, like in zip((latent, ids, weights), everyone):
+            out = [torch.empty_like(like) for _ in range(world)]
+            dist.all_gather(out, v)
+            gathered.append(out)
+        lat_all, ids_all, w_all = gathered
+        q_all = [mxfp8_quantize(v, is_sf_swizzled_layout=False) for v in lat_all]
+        q_all = [(q, s.view(torch.uint8).view(tokens, -1)) for q, s in q_all]
+
+        # Reference: per destination rank the stand-in partial, rank-order sum, norm.
+        acc = torch.zeros(tokens, LATENT, device=device)
+        for d in range(world):
+            part = stand_in(q_all[rank], ids, weights, d, local)
+            sent = ((ids // local) == d).any(1)
+            acc += torch.where(sent[:, None], part.float(), 0)
+        routed = acc.to(torch.bfloat16)
+        expected = torch.empty_like(routed)
+        ops.rms_norm(expected, routed, norm_w, 1e-5)
+
+        def step(latent=latent, ids=ids, weights=weights, tokens=tokens):
+            normed = torch.empty_like(latent)
+            ep.dispatch(latent, ids, weights)
+            # stand-in experts on the receive rows (rows past the counter: zeros)
+            b, rows = ep.buffers, world * stride(tokens)
+            ep.out[:rows] = stand_in(
+                (b.x(rows), b.sf(rows)), b.ids(rows), b.weights(rows), rank, local
+            )
+            return ep.combine(ids, norm_w, normed)
+
+        for it in range(3):
+            ep.dispatch(latent, ids, weights)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            dist.barrier()
+            b, rows = ep.buffers, world * stride(tokens)
+            src = b.src(rows).tolist()
+            for r, v in enumerate(src):
+                s, t = divmod(r, stride(tokens))
+                sent = t < tokens and bool(((ids_all[s][t] // local) == rank).any())
+                if not sent:  # a non-local row: empty, its ids never local
+                    assert v == -1 and ((b.ids(rows)[r] // local) != rank).all()
+                    continue
+                assert v == (s << 16 | t), (rank, tokens, it, r, v)
+                assert torch.equal(
+                    b.x(rows)[r].view(torch.uint8), q_all[s][0][t].view(torch.uint8)
+                )
+                assert torch.equal(b.sf(rows)[r], q_all[s][1][t])
+                assert torch.equal(b.ids(rows)[r], ids_all[s][t])
+                assert torch.equal(b.weights(rows)[r], w_all[s][t])
+            ep.out[:rows] = stand_in(
+                (b.x(rows), b.sf(rows)), b.ids(rows), b.weights(rows), rank, local
+            )
+            normed = torch.empty_like(latent)
+            ep.combine(ids, norm_w, normed)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            assert (b.src(rows) == -1).all()
+            assert ((b.ids(rows) // local) != rank).all()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(normed, expected, atol=2e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+            dist.barrier()
+
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        s = torch.cuda.Stream()
+        s.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(s):
+            step()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        dist.barrier()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=s):
+            graph_out = step()
+        for _ in range(3):
+            dist.barrier()
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(graph_out, expected, atol=2e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+    dist.barrier()
+
+
+def _spawned(rank, world, port):
+    os.environ.update(
+        RANK=str(rank),
+        WORLD_SIZE=str(world),
+        MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
+        MASTER_PORT=str(port),
+        LOCAL_RANK=str(rank),
+    )
+    torch.cuda.set_device(rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", device_id=torch.device("cuda", rank))
+    try:
+        worker(rank, world)
+    finally:
+        dist.destroy_process_group()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+    or torch.cuda.device_count() < 4,
+    reason="needs 4 SM100 GPUs",
+)
+def test_ep_dispatch_combine_4_ranks():
+    with socket.socket() as sock:
+        sock.bind(("", 0))
+        port = sock.getsockname()[1]
+    torch.multiprocessing.spawn(_spawned, args=(4, port), nprocs=4, join=True)
+
+
+def _rendezvous(init_file):
+    """RANK / WORLD_SIZE / LOCAL_RANK / MASTER_ADDR / MASTER_PORT from srun's
+    environment and a shared file (torchrun sets them itself)."""
+    import time
+
+    if "RANK" in os.environ or "SLURM_PROCID" not in os.environ:
+        return
+    rank = int(os.environ["SLURM_PROCID"])
+    os.environ.update(
+        RANK=str(rank),
+        WORLD_SIZE=os.environ["SLURM_NTASKS"],
+        LOCAL_RANK=os.environ["SLURM_LOCALID"],
+    )
+    if rank == 0:
+        with socket.socket() as s:
+            s.bind(("", 0))
+            port = s.getsockname()[1]
+        address = f"{socket.gethostbyname(socket.gethostname())}:{port}"
+        with open(init_file + ".tmp", "w") as f:
+            f.write(address)
+        os.rename(init_file + ".tmp", init_file)
+    else:
+        while not os.path.exists(init_file):
+            time.sleep(0.2)
+        with open(init_file) as f:
+            address = f.read()
+    host, port = address.split(":")
+    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR=host, MASTER_PORT=port)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":  # srun: one process per GPU, any number of nodes
+    import sys
+
+    _rendezvous(
+        sys.argv[sys.argv.index("--init-file") + 1] if "--init-file" in sys.argv else ""
+    )
+    local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+    torch.cuda.set_device(local_rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", device_id=torch.device("cuda", local_rank))
+    worker(dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size())
+    if dist.get_rank() == 0:
+        print("EP COMM TEST PASSED", flush=True)
+    dist.destroy_process_group()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode in the hybrid decomposition (TP-G attention groups
+with DCP G + routed experts EP over every rank, MegaMoE) on real ranks: admission
+(TP > 1 + EP, FP32 KDA conv and recurrent state, RecoverSSM), the hybrid plan
+(``runtime.hybrid.HybridStep``: q = 5 verify steps with the TP-G KDA / DSA
+providers, the stock SP MoE on the rank's row shard), and the step's output
+against the stock decode of the same step (stock: sequence parallel over the TP
+group, the MoE on the rank's row shard).
+
+Default: TP4 x DCP4 x DP1 (EP4) on one 4-GPU node; ``KIMI_K31_HYBRID_WORLD`` /
+``KIMI_K31_HYBRID_TP`` / ``KIMI_K31_HYBRID_DCP`` select other shapes (e.g. 8 / 4 / 4:
+two groups, EP8, launched one process per GPU by ``KIMI_K31_HYBRID_SRUN=1``).
+
+Each rank runs ``vllm bench forward`` in-process on a layer-truncated K3.1
+(``KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL``: a config-only K3.1 directory with a few layers, e.g. 3
+KDA + 1 DSA + MegaMoE layers; dummy weights, balanced EP routing). The bench
+compares the step's CUDA graph replay (captured: the specialized decode) with the
+same step run eagerly (outside a capture the specialized decode never plans: the
+stock forward), per rank. Contexts stay below the DSA top-k (2048), so both paths
+attend over every token and the routing is the bench's fixture on both: the
+outputs differ only by accumulation order and FP8 / BF16 rounding.
+"""
+
+import json
+import os
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+MODEL = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL")
+# Its DSpark draft config (target layers inside the truncated model).
+DRAFT = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_DEP_DRAFT")
+WORLD = int(os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_HYBRID_WORLD", "4"))
+TP = int(os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_HYBRID_TP", "4"))
+DCP = int(os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_HYBRID_DCP", str(TP)))
+# Per TP group: DSpark k = 4 verify (q = 5) steps. (Under DSpark the KDA metadata
+# counts draft-less decodes as spec decodes, so a q = 1 step is not uniform and
+# runs stock, at TP8 as at DEP.)
+# R1 (5 rows: some ranks' MoE shard is padding), R4, R16, R33 and R62 (an
+# overhanging last MoE shard at TP8), R64 (320 rows, the most).
+CASES = (
+    "v1=1*5@1900:4",
+    "v4=4*5@1500:4",
+    "v16=16*5@1100:4",
+    "v33=33*5@900:4",
+    "v62=62*5@800:4",
+    "v64=64*5@700:4",
+)
+# The deployment's capture sizes (rows).
+CAPTURE = (5, 20, 80, 165, 310, 320)
+
+pytestmark = [
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+        reason="the specialized decode kernels need SM100/SM103",
+    ),
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        not all(os.path.isdir(p or "") for p in (MODEL, DRAFT)),
+        reason="needs a layer-truncated K3.1 config (KIMI_K31_DEP_MODEL) and its "
+        "DSpark draft config (KIMI_K31_DEP_DRAFT)",
+    ),
+    pytest.mark.skipif(
+        torch.accelerator.device_count() < min(WORLD, 4),
+        reason=f"Need {WORLD} GPUs.",
+    ),
+]
+
+
+def admit(capture_sizes, plans):
+    """Admit the specialized decode under ``vllm bench forward`` (its graphs are
+    one-shot captures of each exact batch; the deployment's capture sizes are
+    ``capture_sizes``) and record every captured step's plan."""
+    import dataclasses
+
+    import vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.model as model
+    import vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.runtime as runtime
+    from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.runtime.decode import (
+        SpecializedDecode,
+    )
+
+    check, build = runtime.unsupported, runtime.specialized_decode_config
+
+    def unsupported(vllm_config):
+        compilation = vllm_config.compilation_config
+        mode = compilation.cudagraph_mode
+        compilation.cudagraph_mode = CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
+        try:
+            return check(vllm_config)
+        finally:
+            compilation.cudagraph_mode = mode
+
+    def specialized_decode_config(vllm_config):
+        config = build(vllm_config)
+        assert config is not None, "the specialized decode was not admitted"
+        return dataclasses.replace(config, capture_sizes=capture_sizes)
+
+    runtime.unsupported = unsupported
+    runtime.specialized_decode_config = specialized_decode_config
+    model.specialized_decode_config = specialized_decode_config
+    plan = SpecializedDecode.plan
+
+    def recording(self, positions, intermediate_tensors):
+        step = plan(self, positions, intermediate_tensors)
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            kinds = sorted({type(a).__name__ for a in self.attention.values()})
+            plans.append(
+                dict(
+                    rows=positions.shape[0],
+                    planned=step is not None,
+                    wide=bool(step is not None and step.wide),
+                    q=step.q if step is not None else None,
+                    hybrid=self.hybrid is not None,
+                    attention=kinds,
+                )
+            )
+        return step
+
+    SpecializedDecode.plan = recording
+
+
+def worker(rank, port, out_dir):
+    os.environ.update(
+        RANK=str(rank),
+        WORLD_SIZE=str(WORLD),
+        LOCAL_RANK=str(rank),
+        MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1",
+        MASTER_PORT=str(port),
+    )
+    run(rank, out_dir)
+
+
+def worker_srun(rank, out_dir):
+    """srun: MASTER_ADDR / MASTER_PORT from the launcher's environment."""
+    os.environ.update(RANK=str(rank), WORLD_SIZE=str(WORLD))
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"]))
+    run(rank, out_dir)
+
+
+def run(rank, out_dir):
+    os.environ["VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN"] = "1"
+    plans: list = []
+    admit(CAPTURE, plans)
+    import vllm.benchmarks.forward.main as fm
+    from vllm.utils.argparse_utils import FlexibleArgumentParser
+
+    spec = {"method": "dspark", "num_speculative_tokens": 4, "model": DRAFT}
+    argv = [
+        "--model", MODEL, "--load-format", "dummy", "--trust-remote-code",
+        "-tp", str(TP), "-dcp", str(DCP), "-dp", str(WORLD // TP),
+        "--enable-expert-parallel",
+        "--routing", "balanced", "--moe-backend", "deep_gemm_mega_moe",
+        "--kv-cache-dtype", "fp8", "--mamba-cache-dtype", "float32",
+        "--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype", "float32", "--use-replayssm",
+        "--max-model-len", "8192", "--language-model-only",
+        "--gpu-memory-utilization", "0.8", "--max-num-seqs", "64",
+        "--speculative-config", json.dumps(spec), "--exclude-drafter",
+        "--additional-config", json.dumps({"decode_backend": "latency_specialized"}),
+        "--kernel-config", json.dumps({"enable_flashinfer_autotune": False}),
+        "--kv-len-jitter", "0", "--iters", "2", "--samples", "1",
+        "--output-json", os.path.join(out_dir, "result.json"),
+    ]  # fmt: skip
+    for case in CASES:
+        argv += ["--case", case]
+    parser = FlexibleArgumentParser()
+    fm.add_cli_args(parser)
+    fm.main(parser.parse_args(argv))
+    with open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"plans{rank}.json"), "w") as f:
+        json.dump(plans, f)
+
+
+def test_hybrid_specialized_decode_matches_stock(tmp_path):
+    if os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_HYBRID_SRUN") == "1":  # one process per GPU (srun)
+        rank = int(os.environ["SLURM_PROCID"])
+        out = os.environ["KIMI_K31_HYBRID_OUT"]
+        os.environ.setdefault("LOCAL_RANK", os.environ["SLURM_LOCALID"])
+        worker_srun(rank, out)
+        if rank:
+            return
+        while len([f for f in os.listdir(out) if f.startswith("plans")]) < WORLD:
+            time.sleep(5)
+        check(Path(out))
+        return
+    port = get_open_port()
+    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
+    procs = [
+        ctx.Process(target=worker, args=(r, port, str(tmp_path))) for r in range(WORLD)
+    ]
+    for p in procs:
+        p.start()
+    deadline = time.monotonic() + 1500
+    for p in procs:
+        p.join(timeout=max(0.0, deadline - time.monotonic()))
+    for p in procs:
+        if p.is_alive():
+            p.kill()
+            p.join()
+    assert [p.exitcode for p in procs] == [0] * WORLD
+    check(tmp_path)
+
+
+def check(tmp_path):
+    results = json.loads((tmp_path / "result.json").read_text())
+    assert [r["case"] for r in results] == [c.split("=")[0] for c in CASES]
+    for rank in range(WORLD):
+        plans = json.loads((tmp_path / f"plans{rank}.json").read_text())
+        # Every captured step took the hybrid path, with the TP-G DSA and KDA
+        # providers (the MoE and dense MLP run the stock modules).
+        assert plans, rank
+        for plan in plans:
+            assert plan["hybrid"] and plan["planned"] and plan["wide"], plan
+            assert plan["attention"] == ["HybridAttention"], plan
+        assert {p["rows"] for p in plans} >= set(CAPTURE), plans
+        assert {p["q"] for p in plans} == {5}, plans
+    for result in results:
+        for rank, r in enumerate(result["ranks"]):
+            err = r["graph_vs_eager"]["relative_rms"]
+            print(f"{result['case']} rank {rank}: spec vs stock rel rms {err:.2e}")
+            # Order and BF16 rounding only (measured 3.6e-4 - 6.0e-4 at TP4 / TP8:
+            # the TP-G cores read the stock layers' FP8 query and cache; a wrong
+            # row in one MoE stage alone gives 3e-2 - 8e-2).
+            assert err < 5e-3, (result["case"], rank, err)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode, TP8: the wide MoE layer (``moe.wide.WideMoE``: the
+MoE layer of verify steps past the 64-row full step) against the stock
+``KimiMoE.forward`` of the same module, on 8 real ranks.
+
+The module is the production one, built from a K3.1 checkpoint's config
+(compressed-tensors MXFP4 experts, ``process_weights_after_loading``: the
+trtllm-gen layout) on random weights. Both paths route exactly on FP32 router logits
+and differ only in accumulation order: the wide engine's sharded front, experts and
+``Finalize`` (80, 320 rows) or the stock TRTLLM-Gen experts (352 rows, ``ENGINES``),
+and the column-parallel tail. The sharded front computes its own FP32 router logits,
+so a row may route differently at a near tie (asserted).
+
+Launch: 8 ranks across two GB300 nodes with ``srun -n8`` (one pytest per rank),
+``KIMI_K3_SD_TP8_INIT`` a shared rendezvous file and ``KIMI_K31_CONFIG`` a K3.1
+checkpoint directory (its config is read; no weights are loaded).
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="the specialized decode kernels need SM100/SM103",
+)
+
+INIT = os.environ.get("KIMI_K3_SD_TP8_INIT")
+CONFIG = os.environ.get("KIMI_K31_CONFIG")
+TP, HIDDEN = 8, 7168
+# 80 and 320 rows: the wide engine (sharded front, listed experts) + Finalize; 352:
+# the stock TRTLLM-Gen experts (``ENGINES``).
+ROWS = (80, 320, 352)
+# Listed vs grouped spec engine (bit-exact), over consecutive calls (list parities).
+LISTED_ROWS = (80, 200)
+
+
+def make_config(model_dir, max_tokens):
+    from vllm.config import (
+        CacheConfig,
+        CompilationConfig,
+        CUDAGraphMode,
+        DeviceConfig,
+        LoadConfig,
+        ModelConfig,
+        ParallelConfig,
+        SchedulerConfig,
+        VllmConfig,
+    )
+
+    model = ModelConfig(
+        model=model_dir,
+        tokenizer=model_dir,
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        seed=0,
+        max_model_len=1 << 16,
+    )
+    config = VllmConfig(
+        model_config=model,
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(block_size=64, cache_dtype="fp8"),
+        parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        scheduler_config=SchedulerConfig(
+            max_num_seqs=128,
+            max_num_batched_tokens=max(max_tokens, 8192),
+            max_model_len=1 << 16,
+            is_encoder_decoder=False,
+        ),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig(),
+        load_config=LoadConfig(load_format="dummy"),
+        compilation_config=CompilationConfig(
+            cudagraph_mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL_AND_PIECEWISE
+        ),
+    )
+    # 8 ranks over 2 nodes: set after validation (one node has 4 GPUs).
+    parallel = config.parallel_config
+    parallel.tensor_parallel_size = parallel.world_size = TP
+    return config
+
+
+def init_weights(module, seed):
+    """BF16 fan-in scaled normals, packed FP4 uniform bytes, E8M0 scales 2^-5..2^-3,
+    norms 1, a small correction bias."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    for name, p in module.named_parameters():
+        if p.dtype in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float32):
+            if "norm" in name:
+                p.data.fill_(1.0)
+            elif "bias" in name:
+                p.data.copy_(torch.randn(p.shape, generator=g, device="cuda") * 1e-3)
+            else:
+                v = torch.randn(p.shape, generator=g, device="cuda")
+                p.data.copy_(v * p.shape[-1] ** -0.5)
+        elif p.dtype == torch.uint8 and "scale" in name:
+            p.data.copy_(torch.randint(122, 125, p.shape, generator=g, device="cuda"))
+        elif p.dtype == torch.uint8:
+            p.data.copy_(torch.randint(0, 256, p.shape, generator=g, device="cuda"))
+        else:
+            raise TypeError(f"{name}: {p.dtype}")
+
+
+def same_routing(module, x, ids, kind):
+    """Rows whose top16 set equals stock's. The stock-engine path routes inside the
+    stock experts (every row); the spec engine's front computes its own FP32 router
+    logits (a different GEMM: accumulation order only), so a row may pick another
+    expert only at a near tie of its 16th and 17th scores, which is asserted."""
+    rows = x.shape[0]
+    if kind == "trtllm":
+        return torch.ones(rows, dtype=torch.bool, device=x.device)
+    logits = module.gate(x)[0].float()
+    scores = logits.sigmoid() + module.gate.e_score_correction_bias.float()
+    top = scores.topk(17, dim=-1)
+    ref = top.indices[:, :16].sort(-1).values
+    same = (ids.long().sort(-1).values == ref).all(-1)
+    gap = (top.values[:, 15] - top.values[:, 16]) / top.values[:, 15].abs()
+    assert (gap[~same] < 1e-4).all(), gap[~same]
+    assert int((~same).sum()) <= max(1, rows // 50), int((~same).sum())
+    return same
+
+
+def check(config, device):
+    from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import graph_capture
+    from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.model import KimiMoE
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe import wide
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe.experts_runtime import (  # noqa: E501
+        PersistentExperts,
+    )
+
+    text = config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
+    torch.set_default_dtype(torch.bfloat16)  # as the model loader
+    try:
+        with torch.device(device):
+            module = KimiMoE(
+                text,
+                config,
+                quant_config=config.quant_config,
+                prefix="model.layers.1.mlp",
+                layer_idx=1,
+            )
+    finally:
+        torch.set_default_dtype(dtype)
+    init_weights(module, 101)
+    process_weights_after_loading(module, config.model_config, device)
+    beta, linear_beta = text.activation_situ_beta, text.activation_situ_linear_beta
+    routed = module.experts.routed_experts
+    w13, w2 = (w.view(torch.uint8) for w in (routed.w13_weight, routed.w2_weight))
+    weights = w13, routed.w13_weight_scale, w2, routed.w2_weight_scale
+    experts = PersistentExperts(*weights, beta=beta, linear_beta=linear_beta)
+    batches = wide.wide_batches(ROWS)
+    assert batches == ROWS
+    state = wide.WideScratch(TP, device, batches)
+    layer = wide.WideMoE(module, experts, state, beta, linear_beta)
+    assert all(layer.serves(b) for b in ROWS) and not layer.serves(64)
+    for rows in ROWS:
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1000 + rows)
+        x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        with set_forward_context(None, config):
+            stock = module(x).float().clone()
+        # The wide providers run in the decode step's CUDA graph.
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with graph_capture(device) as ctx:
+            with torch.cuda.stream(ctx.stream):
+                layer.run(x)  # warm up (compiles, plans)
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            holder = {}
+            with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=ctx.stream):
+                holder["y"] = layer.run(x)
+        for _ in range(2):  # replays are the step's
+            graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        ours = holder["y"].float()
+        assert torch.isfinite(ours).all()
+        err = float((ours - stock).norm() / stock.norm())
+        if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
+            print(f"WideMoE rows={rows} rel err vs KimiMoE.forward {err:.2e}")
+        # BF16 rounding of the paths' different accumulation orders (expert rows,
+        # top16 sum, all-reduce; the sharded front's FP32 router GEMM) only.
+        assert err < 5e-3, (rows, err)
+        # Rows routed as stock; a few elements may move further: the sharded front's
+        # latent (FP32-out GEMM, one BF16 rounding) can differ from stock's BF16 GEMM
+        # by an ulp (accumulation order), which flips some MXFP8 activation codes.
+        same = same_routing(module, x, layer.state.ids[:rows], layer.plans[rows][0])
+        a, b = ours[same], stock[same]
+        far = ((a - b).abs() > 3e-2 + 3e-2 * b.abs()).float().mean().item()
+        assert far < 1e-4, (rows, far)
+        del graph
+    check_listed(module, weights, device, beta, linear_beta)
+
+
+def check_listed(module, weights, device, beta, linear_beta):
+    """The spec engine's fronts over several consecutive calls (both routing-list
+    parities and the count clearing): "listed" (``WideRoute`` appends the routing
+    lists and writes the plan; the experts build their windows from them) is
+    bit-identical to "grouped" (routing, plan and unit-table kernels): pair order
+    inside a unit does not change any token's FC1/FC2 column. "sharded" (one FP32-out
+    GEMM over the router rows and latent down shard, multicast into the mailbox)
+    differs from them only by the GEMM's accumulation order."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe import wide
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe.experts_runtime import (  # noqa: E501
+        PersistentExperts,
+    )
+
+    layers = {}
+    saved = wide.ROUTING
+    try:
+        for kind in ("sharded", "listed", "grouped"):
+            wide.ROUTING = f"65-1024:{kind}"
+            experts = PersistentExperts(*weights, beta=beta, linear_beta=linear_beta)
+            state = wide.WideScratch(TP, device, LISTED_ROWS)
+            layers[kind] = wide.WideMoE(module, experts, state, beta, linear_beta)
+            name = "spec" if kind == "grouped" else kind
+            assert all(layers[kind].plans[b][0] == name for b in LISTED_ROWS)
+    finally:
+        wide.ROUTING = saved
+    for call in range(5):
+        rows = LISTED_ROWS[call % 2]
+        g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(2000 + call)
+        x = torch.randn(rows, HIDDEN, generator=g, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        outs = {k: layer.run(x).float().clone() for k, layer in layers.items()}
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        assert torch.isfinite(outs["sharded"]).all()
+        assert torch.equal(outs["listed"], outs["grouped"]), (call, rows)
+        ref = outs["listed"]
+        err = float((outs["sharded"] - ref).norm() / ref.norm())
+        assert err < 5e-3, (call, rows, err)
+    if torch.distributed.get_rank() == 0:
+        print(f"listed == grouped (bit-exact), sharded rel err {err:.2e}, 5 calls")
+
+
+def run_worker(rank, world, local_rank, init_method):
+    from vllm.config import set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    os.environ["VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN"] = "1"
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(local_rank)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", local_rank)
+    config = make_config(CONFIG, max(ROWS))
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        init_distributed_environment(
+            world_size=world,
+            rank=rank,
+            local_rank=local_rank,
+            distributed_init_method=init_method,
+        )
+        initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=world)
+        init_workspace_manager(device)
+        try:
+            check(config, device)
+        finally:
+            cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    INIT is None or CONFIG is None or not os.path.isdir(CONFIG or ""),
+    reason="needs an srun -n8 launch (KIMI_K3_SD_TP8_INIT) and a K3.1 config "
+    "(KIMI_K31_CONFIG)",
+)
+def test_wide_moe_matches_kimi_moe_tp8_launched():
+    """One rank of an ``srun -n8`` launch (TP8: 2 nodes x 4 GPUs)."""
+    rank, world = int(os.environ["SLURM_PROCID"]), int(os.environ["SLURM_NTASKS"])
+    assert world == TP, world
+    local = int(os.environ["SLURM_LOCALID"])
+    run_worker(rank, world, local, f"file://{INIT}")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The NVLink multicast budget of the Kimi K3 symmetric-memory mailboxes
+(``specialized_decode/symm.py``).
+
+A GB300 NVL72 rack shares one pool of about 820 multicast objects across every
+process of its NVLink domain; each ``symm_mem.rendezvous`` binds one unless
+multicast is disabled for it. Checked here:
+
+- ``peer_rendezvous``: no multicast address, every peer's stores land through
+  ``buffer_ptrs`` / ``get_buffer``, and the process environment is restored;
+- ``multicast_rendezvous``: the multicast address on multicast platforms, and 0 on
+  every rank when one rank's binding is skipped (the ranks agree on the path);
+- the specialized decode's peer-store mailboxes (DCP partials, top-k exchange,
+  MoE tail reduce-scatter) bind no multicast object and still map every peer.
+
+Runs on 2 GPUs (``mp.spawn``), or on every rank of a ``torchrun`` / ``srun`` launch
+(e.g. TP8 across two GB300 NVL72 trays) when ``RANK`` and ``WORLD_SIZE`` are set.
+"""
+
+import os
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch.multiprocessing as mp
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import (
+    get_tp_group,
+    init_distributed_environment,
+    initialize_model_parallel,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.system_utils import update_environment_variables
+
+ENV = "TORCH_SYMM_MEM_DISABLE_MULTICAST"
+
+
+def has_multicast() -> bool:
+    from torch._C._autograd import DeviceType
+    from torch._C._distributed_c10d import _SymmetricMemory
+
+    index = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    return bool(_SymmetricMemory.has_multicast_support(DeviceType.CUDA, index))
+
+
+def check_peer_stores(handle, tensor, world, rank, tag):
+    """Rank r stores r + 1 + 100 * tag into slot r of every peer's buffer."""
+    tensor.view(torch.int32)[:world].zero_()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier()
+    for peer in range(world):
+        handle.get_buffer(peer, [world], torch.int32, 0)[rank].fill_(
+            rank + 1 + 100 * tag
+        )
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier()
+    got = tensor.view(torch.int32)[:world].tolist()
+    assert got == [r + 1 + 100 * tag for r in range(world)], (tag, rank, got)
+
+
+def check(world: int) -> None:
+    import torch.distributed._symmetric_memory as symm_mem
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.symm import (
+        multicast_rendezvous,
+        peer_rendezvous,
+    )
+
+    group = get_tp_group()
+    rank = group.rank_in_group
+    name = group.device_group.group_name
+    device = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    multicast = has_multicast()
+
+    # peer_rendezvous: no multicast address, peer stores land, env restored.
+    for previous in (None, "0"):
+        if previous is None:
+            os.environ.pop(ENV, None)
+        else:
+            os.environ[ENV] = previous
+        t = symm_mem.empty(1 << 16, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        handle = peer_rendezvous(t, name)
+        # Restored ("0", which binds like an unset variable, where it was unset).
+        assert os.environ.get(ENV) == (previous or "0"), (previous, os.environ.get(ENV))
+        assert int(handle.multicast_ptr or 0) == 0
+        assert all(handle.buffer_ptrs) and len(handle.buffer_ptrs) == world
+        check_peer_stores(handle, t, world, rank, 1)
+    os.environ.pop(ENV, None)
+
+    # multicast_rendezvous: the address where every rank bound it, else 0 on all.
+    t = symm_mem.empty(1 << 16, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    _, mc = multicast_rendezvous(t, group.device_group, "test")
+    assert bool(mc) == multicast, (mc, multicast)
+    if multicast:
+        if rank == world - 1:
+            os.environ[ENV] = "1"  # this rank skips the binding
+        t = symm_mem.empty(1 << 16, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+        handle, mc = multicast_rendezvous(t, name, "test")
+        os.environ.pop(ENV, None)
+        assert mc == 0, (rank, mc)
+        check_peer_stores(handle, t, world, rank, 2)
+
+    # The decode's peer-store mailboxes bind no multicast object and map every peer.
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.topk_exchange import (  # noqa: E501
+        TopkExchange,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.mla.dcp import (
+        DcpMailbox,
+    )
+
+    box = DcpMailbox(group.device_group, device, world, 4, 2, "bf16")
+    assert box.peers.ne(0).all() and box.lse_peers.ne(0).all()
+    topk = TopkExchange(group.device_group, device, world, rank, 4, 64)
+    assert topk.peers.ne(0).all()
+    if multicast:
+        from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.oproj.prepared import (  # noqa: E501
+            OprojMailbox,
+        )
+
+        owner = group.device_group, device, world, rank
+        rs = OprojMailbox(*owner, (3, world, 4, 64), multicast=False)
+        latent = OprojMailbox(*owner, (3, world, 4, 64))
+        assert rs.mc == 0 and all(rs.handle.buffer_ptrs)
+        assert latent.mc != 0
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    group.barrier()
+
+
+def worker(rank: int, world: int, port: int) -> None:
+    update_environment_variables(
+        {
+            "RANK": str(rank),
+            "LOCAL_RANK": str(rank),
+            "WORLD_SIZE": str(world),
+            "MASTER_ADDR": "localhost",
+            "MASTER_PORT": str(port),
+        }
+    )
+    run_rank(world)
+
+
+def run_rank(world: int) -> None:
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+        local_rank = int(os.environ["LOCAL_RANK"])
+        torch.accelerator.set_device_index(local_rank)
+        init_distributed_environment()
+        initialize_model_parallel(tensor_model_parallel_size=world)
+        check(world)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="needs CUDA")
+def test_symm_multicast_budget():
+    if "RANK" in os.environ and "WORLD_SIZE" in os.environ:
+        run_rank(int(os.environ["WORLD_SIZE"]))
+        return
+    world = 2
+    if torch.accelerator.device_count() < world:
+        pytest.skip("needs 2 GPUs")
+    from vllm.utils.network_utils import get_open_port
+
+    mp.spawn(worker, args=(world, get_open_port()), nprocs=world)

+"""The runner side of the deferred RecoverSSM (``DeferredRecoverSSMState``) and how
+the specialized decode installs it on ``KimiK3ModelState`` and the KDA metadata
+builders: CPU only, the hybrid state's base class mocked."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.kda_metadata import KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.model_state import KimiK3ModelState
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.recoverssm.state import (
+    DeferredRecoverSSMState,
+    install_model_state,
+)
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.mamba_hybrid import MambaHybridModelState
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.recoverssm import RecoverSSMState
+
+
+def _kda_builder(use_recoverssm: bool = True) -> KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder:
+    builder = KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder.__new__(KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder)
+    builder.use_recoverssm = use_recoverssm
+    builder.recoverssm_context = None
+    builder.device = torch.device("cpu")
+    builder.vllm_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(max_num_seqs=6)
+    )
+    return builder
+
+
+class _Group:
+    def __init__(self, builder) -> None:
+        self.builder = builder
+
+    def get_metadata_builder(self, ubatch_id: int = 0):
+        assert ubatch_id == 0
+        return self.builder
+
+
+def _groups():
+    deferring = [_kda_builder(), _kda_builder()]
+    others = [SimpleNamespace(), _kda_builder(use_recoverssm=False)]
+    groups = [
+        [_Group(deferring[0]), _Group(others[0])],
+        [_Group(deferring[1]), _Group(others[1])],
+    ]
+    return groups, deferring, others
+
+
+def test_add_request_zeroes_the_pending_count() -> None:
+    state = DeferredRecoverSSMState(4, torch.device("cpu"))
+    assert isinstance(state, RecoverSSMState)
+    assert state.pending.dtype == torch.int32 and state.pending.tolist() == [0] * 4
+    state.pending.copy_(torch.tensor([3, 2, 4, 1], dtype=torch.int32))
+    state.add_request(2)
+    assert state.pending.tolist() == [3, 2, 0, 1]
+
+
+def test_bind_installs_only_on_recoverssm_kda_builders() -> None:
+    state = DeferredRecoverSSMState(4, torch.device("cpu"))
+    groups, deferring, others = _groups()
+    idx_mapping = torch.tensor([2, 0], dtype=torch.int32)
+    state.bind(groups, idx_mapping)
+    for builder in deferring:
+        assert builder.recoverssm_pending is state.pending
+        assert builder.recoverssm_request_slots is idx_mapping
+        assert builder.recoverssm_record_rows.tolist() == [-1] * 6
+        # Per-instance overrides; the class is unchanged.
+        assert "build" in vars(builder)
+        assert "_get_recoverssm_context" in vars(builder)
+        assert type(builder) is KimiK3KDAMetadataBuilder
+    for other in others:
+        assert not hasattr(other, "recoverssm_pending")
+        assert not hasattr(other, "recoverssm_request_slots")
+        assert "build" not in vars(other)
+
+    # Capture / dummy batches own no request: no slots, the same pending buffer,
+    # installed once.
+    builds = [builder.build for builder in deferring]
+    state.bind(groups, None)
+    for builder, build in zip(deferring, builds):
+        assert builder.recoverssm_pending is state.pending
+        assert builder.recoverssm_request_slots is None
+        assert builder.build is build
+
+
+def _fake_base_init(use_recoverssm: bool):
+    def init(self, vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device):
+        self.max_num_reqs = 8
+        self.device = device
+        self.recoverssm = RecoverSSMState() if use_recoverssm else None
+
+    return init
+
+
+def _make_state(use_recoverssm: bool, model=None) -> KimiK3ModelState:
+    model = model or SimpleNamespace(specialized_decode_config=None)
+    with patch.object(
+        MambaHybridModelState, "__init__", _fake_base_init(use_recoverssm)
+    ):
+        return KimiK3ModelState(None, model, None, torch.device("cpu"))
+
+
+def test_model_state_hands_itself_to_the_specialized_decode() -> None:
+    bound = []
+    decode = SimpleNamespace(bind_model_state=bound.append)
+    model = SimpleNamespace(specialized_decode_config=object())
+    model.build_specialized_decode = lambda: setattr(
+        model, "specialized_decode", decode
+    )
+    state = _make_state(use_recoverssm=True, model=model)
+    assert bound == [state]
+    # Without the specialized decode the stock state is left as it is.
+    assert type(_make_state(use_recoverssm=True).recoverssm) is RecoverSSMState
+
+
+def test_install_model_state_only_with_recoverssm() -> None:
+    state = _make_state(use_recoverssm=True)
+    install_model_state(state)
+    assert type(state.recoverssm) is DeferredRecoverSSMState
+    assert state.recoverssm.pending.shape == (8,)
+    plain = _make_state(use_recoverssm=False)
+    install_model_state(plain)
+    assert plain.recoverssm is None
+    assert "add_request" not in vars(plain) and "prepare_attn" not in vars(plain)
+
+
+def test_installed_add_request_resets_the_slot_after_the_base() -> None:
+    calls = []
+
+    def base_add_request(self, req_index, new_req_data):
+        calls.append((req_index, self.recoverssm.pending[req_index].item()))
+
+    with patch.object(MambaHybridModelState, "add_request", base_add_request):
+        state = _make_state(use_recoverssm=True)
+        install_model_state(state)
+        state.recoverssm.pending.fill_(3)
+        state.add_request(5, SimpleNamespace())
+    assert calls == [(5, 3)]
+    assert state.recoverssm.pending.tolist() == [3] * 5 + [0] + [3] * 2
+
+
+def test_installed_prepare_attn_binds_before_the_metadata_build() -> None:
+    groups, deferring, _ = _groups()
+    idx_mapping = torch.tensor([1, 4, 0], dtype=torch.int32)
+    input_batch = SimpleNamespace(idx_mapping=idx_mapping)
+    seen = []
+
+    def base_prepare_attn(
+        self,
+        input_batch,
+        cudagraph_mode,
+        block_tables,
+        slot_mappings,
+        attn_groups,
+        kv_cache_config,
+        for_capture=False,
+        ubatch_idx=0,
+        model_specific_attn_metadata=None,
+    ):
+        seen.append(
+            [
+                (
+                    getattr(b, "recoverssm_pending", None) is self.recoverssm.pending,
+                    b.recoverssm_request_slots,
+                )
+                for b in deferring
+            ]
+        )
+        return {"for_capture": for_capture}
+
+    with patch.object(MambaHybridModelState, "prepare_attn", base_prepare_attn):
+        state = _make_state(use_recoverssm=True)
+        install_model_state(state)
+        out = state.prepare_attn(input_batch, None, (), None, groups, None)
+        assert out == {"for_capture": False}
+        assert seen[-1] == [(True, idx_mapping), (True, idx_mapping)]
+
+        out = state.prepare_attn(
+            input_batch, None, (), None, groups, None, for_capture=True
+        )
+        assert out == {"for_capture": True}
+        assert seen[-1] == [(True, None), (True, None)]
+
+    # Without the install (stock) nothing is bound.
+    plain = _make_state(use_recoverssm=True)
+    groups, deferring, _ = _groups()
+    with patch.object(MambaHybridModelState, "prepare_attn", lambda self, *a, **k: {}):
+        plain.prepare_attn(input_batch, None, (), None, groups, None)
+    assert all(getattr(b, "recoverssm_pending", None) is None for b in deferring)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode at DEP (TP1 attention, 96 heads per GPU): the split
+MLA query (QueryNorm, the Q_B projection, MlaAbsorb; mla.query_wide) against the
+stock numerics (vllm_c RMSNorm, BF16 Q_B rows, BF16 W_UK absorption, per-tensor
+FP8 query) and the stock cache writers, and against MlaQuery itself at 96 heads;
+the TP1 policies (prims_ts at 96 heads, the split query's overlap modes)."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="the specialized decode kernels need SM100/SM103",
+)
+
+HEADS = 96  # TP1
+
+
+def pitch(heads=HEADS):
+    """The packed [q_a | kv_a | gate | wk | wv] row of ``heads`` local heads."""
+    return 2112 + heads * 128 + 128 + 32
+
+
+PITCH = pitch()
+FP8_ROW, NVFP4_ROW, UNIT, INDEX_ROW, EPS = 576, 352, 64, 132, 1e-6
+
+
+def rms_norm(x, weight):
+    x = x.float()
+    x = x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    return (x * weight.float()).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+
+def cache(blocks, block, row):
+    return torch.zeros(blocks, block, row, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+
+
+def split_query(batch, weights, mla, index, nvfp4, heads=HEADS):
+    """The split query of ``batch`` rows at ``heads`` local heads: (run(projected,
+    slots, q_scale_inv, k_scale) -> (query, q_c, Q_B rows))."""
+    import cutlass
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        layout,
+        stream,
+        to_cute,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.prepared import (
+        compile_core,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.query_stage import (  # noqa: E501
+        WideQuery,
+        q_b_policies,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.gemm.projection import (  # noqa: E501
+        PreparedProjection,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.mla.query_wide import (  # noqa: E501
+        fi_heads,
+    )
+
+    specs = tuple(layout(w) for w in (*weights, mla, index))
+    device = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    kernel = compile_core(
+        batch, heads, pitch(heads), specs, device, 1, fp8=True, nvfp4=nvfp4
+    )[0]
+    assert isinstance(kernel, WideQuery) and kernel.norm is not None
+    q_norm, kv_norm, q_b, w_uk, _ = weights
+    projection = PreparedProjection(q_b, q_b_policies([batch], heads)).prepare()
+    bf = dict(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    # FlashInfer's head-padded query rows (fi_heads: 128 at 96 heads): the pad
+    # heads stay zero.
+    padded = torch.zeros(batch, fi_heads(heads), 576, device="cuda", dtype=torch.uint8)
+    query = padded[:, :heads]
+    q_c = torch.zeros(batch, 1536, **bf)
+    rows = torch.zeros(batch, heads * 192, **bf)
+
+    def run(projected, slots, q_scale_inv, k_scale):
+        s = stream(torch.device("cuda"))
+        eps = cutlass.Float32(EPS)
+        kernel.norm(to_cute(projected), to_cute(q_norm), to_cute(q_c), eps, s)
+        projection.run(q_c, rows)
+        args = (to_cute(projected), to_cute(q_norm), to_cute(kv_norm), to_cute(rows))
+        uk = w_uk
+        if kernel.bmm:  # the stock W_UK bmm, then MlaQuant (query_wide.absorb_bmm)
+            nope = rows.view(batch, heads, 192)[..., :128].transpose(0, 1)
+            uk = torch.bmm(nope, w_uk)
+        args += (to_cute(uk), to_cute(mla), to_cute(slots, 8))
+        args += (to_cute(q_scale_inv, 4), to_cute(k_scale, 4), eps)
+        kernel.absorb(*args, to_cute(query), s)
+        assert not padded[:, heads:].any(), "the pad heads stay zero"
+        return query, q_c, rows
+
+    return run
+

+def inputs(batch, row, block=64, heads=HEADS):
+    torch.manual_seed(batch)
+    bf, dev = torch.bfloat16, "cuda"
+    projected = torch.randn(batch, pitch(heads), device=dev, dtype=bf)
+    q_norm = torch.rand(1536, device=dev, dtype=bf) + 0.5
+    kv_norm = torch.rand(512, device=dev, dtype=bf) + 0.5
+    q_b = torch.randn(heads * 192, 1536, device=dev, dtype=bf) / 40
+    w_uk = torch.randn(heads, 128, 512, device=dev, dtype=bf) / 12
+    w_uv = torch.randn(heads, 128, 512, device=dev, dtype=bf).transpose(1, 2)
+    blocks = max(4, -(-(batch + 1) // block))
+    mla = cache(blocks, block, row)
+    index = cache(8, UNIT, INDEX_ROW)
+    slots = torch.randperm(blocks * block - 1, device=dev)[:batch]
+    slots[0] = blocks * block - 1  # the last row
+    if batch > 2:
+        slots[1] = -1  # a padded row writes nothing
+    return projected, (q_norm, kv_norm, q_b, w_uk, w_uv), mla, index, slots
+
+
+# (local heads, rows): TP1 at every batch; TP8 (12 heads) from SPLIT_FROM rows,
+# including batches whose token tiles split over CTAs unevenly (MlaAbsorb splits).
+SHAPES = [(96, 1), (96, 5), (96, 20), (96, 80), (96, 320)]
+SHAPES += [(12, 25), (12, 40), (12, 80), (12, 160), (12, 320)]

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads,batch", SHAPES)
+def test_split_query_fp8(heads, batch):
+    """Per-tensor FP8 cache (FlashInfer sparse): the query rows, the q_c rows and the
+    KV row as the stock path computes and writes them (concat_and_cache_mla "fp8"),
+    with non-unit scales."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+
+    projected, weights, mla, index, slots = inputs(batch, FP8_ROW, heads=heads)
+    q_norm, kv_norm, q_b, w_uk, _ = weights
+    q_scale = torch.full((1,), 0.5, device="cuda")
+    k_scale = torch.full((1,), 2.0, device="cuda")
+    run = split_query(batch, weights, mla, index, nvfp4=False, heads=heads)
+    query, q_c, rows = run(projected, slots, 1 / q_scale, k_scale)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    ref_q_c = rms_norm(projected[:, :1536], q_norm)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(q_c, ref_q_c, atol=1e-2, rtol=1e-2)
+    # The Q_B rows: BF16 of an FP32 sum (order aside, the stock GEMM's).
+    ref_rows = (q_c.float() @ q_b.float().T).to(torch.bfloat16)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(rows, ref_rows, atol=1e-2, rtol=1.6e-2)
+    # The query from the kernel's own Q_B rows: the absorption's FP32 sum of BF16
+    # products, rounded to BF16, then scaled to FP8 (as the stock path).
+    q = rows.view(batch, heads, 192)
+    latent = torch.bmm(q[..., :128].transpose(0, 1).float(), w_uk.float())
+    latent = latent.transpose(0, 1).to(torch.bfloat16).float()
+    ref = torch.cat([latent, q[..., 128:].float()], -1) / q_scale
+    expected = ref.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8)
+    # FP8 bytes: equal up to the FP32 summation order of the absorption.
+    assert (query != expected).float().mean() < 2e-3
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        query.view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float(), ref, atol=3e-2, rtol=7e-2
+    )
+
+    stock = torch.zeros_like(mla)
+    kv = rms_norm(projected[:, 1536:2048], kv_norm)
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(kv, projected[:, 2048:2112], stock, slots, "fp8", k_scale)
+    live = slots[slots >= 0]
+    ours, theirs = (c.view(-1, FP8_ROW)[live] for c in (mla, stock))
+    assert torch.equal(ours[:, 512:], theirs[:, 512:])  # k_pe
+    # Latent bytes differ only where the RMSNorm rounds differently.
+    assert (ours[:, :512] != theirs[:, :512]).float().mean() < 0.01
+    # Nothing written for the padded row or past the live slots.
+    written = (mla.view(-1, FP8_ROW) != 0).any(-1).nonzero().flatten()
+    assert set(written.tolist()) <= set(live.tolist())
+
