+def dep_layer_step(core, batch, q, contexts):
+    """One decode step of a real 96-head (TP1) K3.1 DSA layer through the stock
+    KimiK3DSAAttention forward and through runtime.dep.DepAttention.run_wide (the
+    DEP step's attention: split-K / cuBLAS projection, PreparedDsa at 96 heads,
+    o_proj), each over its own copy of the same caches (written by the stock
+    writers), on the same metadata. Returns both outputs, both rows entering
+    o_proj, the top-k and what the FP32 reference needs."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from tests.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.test_specialized_decode_dsa import (  # noqa: E501
+        GAP,
+        LAYER_CORES,
+        LAYER_HIDDEN,
+        UNIT,
+        assert_index_nan_free,
+        common_metadata,
+        dsa_layer,
+        index_row,
+        layer_config,
+        owned_slots,
+        paged_rows,
+    )
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.config import set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.forward_context import create_forward_context, override_forward_context
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer import (
+        indexer_k_norm_quant_insert,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer_mxfp4 import (
+        mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.attn_fi import (
+        fi_kernels,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.runtime.dep import (
+        DepAttention,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.flashinfer_mla_sparse import (
+        _prims_ts_row_buckets,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+        DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.worker.block_table import get_block_table_width
+
+    cache_dtype, _, kernel = LAYER_CORES[core]
+    config = layer_config(core, q)
+    length = config.model_config.max_model_len
+    row = {"fp8": FP8_ROW, "nvfp4_ds_mla": NVFP4_ROW}[cache_dtype]
+    dev = torch.device("cuda", torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        topk_buffer = torch.full((length, 2048), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+        attn = dsa_layer(config, topk_buffer, HEADS)
+        layer, indexer = attn.mla_attn.mla_attn, attn.dsa_indexer
+        spec = layer.get_kv_cache_spec(config)
+        builder = layer.attn_backend.get_builder_cls()(
+            spec, [layer.layer_name], config, dev
+        )
+        index_spec = indexer.k_cache.get_kv_cache_spec(config)
+        index_builder = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder(
+            index_spec,
+            [indexer.k_cache.prefix],
+            config,
+            dev,
+            block_table_width=get_block_table_width(
+                index_spec.max_num_blocks_per_req(config, length), UNIT
+            ),
+        )
+        reqs = batch // q
+        gen = torch.Generator(device=dev).manual_seed(batch + q)
+        contexts = [contexts[r % len(contexts)] + 3 * r for r in range(reqs)]
+        mla, mla_table = paged_rows([c + q for c in contexts], UNIT, row, UNIT, gen)
+        index, index_table = paged_rows(
+            [c + q for c in contexts], UNIT, index_row(indexer), GAP, gen
+        )
+        old = [range(c) for c in contexts]
+        old_mla = owned_slots(mla_table, old)
+        old_index = owned_slots(index_table, old)
+        n = old_mla.numel()
+        unit = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=dev)
+        kv_c = torch.randn(n, 512, device=dev, dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        k_pe = torch.randn(n, 64, device=dev, dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        ops.concat_and_cache_mla(kv_c, k_pe, mla, old_mla, cache_dtype, unit)
+        keys = torch.randn(n, 128, device=dev, dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        scratch = torch.empty(n, 2048, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+        norm = torch.ones(128, dtype=bf, device=dev)
+        args = (norm, torch.zeros_like(norm), EPS, old_index, index, scratch, n)
+        insert = indexer_k_norm_quant_insert
+        if indexer.use_fp4_cache:
+            insert = mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert
+        insert(keys, *args)
+        assert_index_nan_free(index)
+        new = [range(c, c + q) for c in contexts]
+        new_mla = owned_slots(mla_table, new)
+        new_index = owned_slots(index_table, new)
+        hidden = torch.randn(batch, LAYER_HIDDEN, device=dev, dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        positions = torch.tensor([p for pos in new for p in pos], device=dev)
+        names = layer.layer_name, indexer.k_cache.prefix
+
+        def step(mla_cache, index_cache):
+            layer.kv_cache, indexer.k_cache.kv_cache = mla_cache, index_cache
+            md = builder.build(0, common_metadata(contexts, q, mla_table, new_mla))
+            index_md = index_builder.build(
+                0, common_metadata(contexts, q, index_table, new_index)
+            )
+            context = create_forward_context(
+                dict(zip(names, (md, index_md))),
+                config,
+                slot_mapping=dict(zip(names, (new_mla, index_md.slot_mapping))),
+            )
+            return md, override_forward_context(context)
+
+        entering = []
+        hook = attn.o_proj.register_forward_pre_hook(
+            lambda _, args: entering.append(args[0].clone())
+        )
+        stock_mla, stock_index = mla.clone(), index.clone()
+        _, context = step(stock_mla, stock_index)
+        with context:
+            stock = attn(positions, hidden)
+        hook.remove()
+        stock_topk = topk_buffer[:batch].clone()
+
+        policy = dict(kernels=(kernel,)) if kernel not in (None, "auto") else {}
+        runtime = SimpleNamespace(
+            device=dev,
+            buffers={},
+            wide=(batch,),
+            queries=(q,),
+            fi_kernels=policy.get("kernels", fi_kernels(cache_dtype)),
+            prims_ts_rows=_prims_ts_row_buckets(config),
+        )
+        dep = DepAttention(SimpleNamespace(self_attn=attn), runtime)
+        ours_mla, ours_index = mla.clone(), index.clone()
+        md, context = step(ours_mla, ours_index)
+        dep.prepare_layout([ours_mla])
+        if dep.core.fused is not None:
+            dep.core.fused.write_ids(topk_buffer)
+        topk_buffer.fill_(-1)
+        with context:
+            out = dep.run_wide(hidden, [ours_mla], md, {names[0]: new_mla}, q)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        attn=attn,
+        out=out,
+        stock=stock,
+        local=dep.local[:batch].clone(),
+        entering=entering[0],
+        topk=topk_buffer[:batch].clone(),
+        stock_topk=stock_topk,
+        projected=dep.projected[:batch].clone(),
+        caches=(ours_mla, stock_mla),
+        mla_table=mla_table,
+        kv=cache_dtype,
+    )
+
+
+def relative(x, ref):
+    return float((x.float() - ref.float()).norm() / ref.float().norm())
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("core", ["fi-auto", "fi-prims_ts"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch,q", [(5, 5), (20, 5), (80, 5), (8, 1)])
+def test_dep_attention_matches_stock_short_context(
+    workspace_init, dist_init, core, batch, q
+):
+    """DepAttention.run_wide against the stock 96-head DSA layer at contexts below
+    the top-k (2048): both attend over every token (no top-k tie can separate
+    them), and both pre-o_proj rows against FP32 attention over the dequantized
+    cache: ours at least as accurate as stock.
+
+    The two paths differ by ~2.8% (rel. RMS) at equal accuracy (~3.4% each vs
+    FP32), from two sources, both rounding-order effects (bisected stage by stage):
+    (1) the stock q_a / kv_a RMSNorm (native) rounds x * rstd to BF16 before the
+    weight multiply, ours rounds x * rstd * w once (the vllm_c kernel's math): 27%
+    of the q_c elements differ by one BF16 ulp, which flips ~10% of the FP8 query
+    codes (ours matches a single-rounding reference to <0.05% of bytes); (2) the FP8
+    sparse MLA kernels quantize P to E4M3 per KV tile, so the same top-k set in another
+    order changes the output by ~2.4% (the stock kernel against itself with its
+    top-k rows permuted); the fused indexer emits key order, stock's top-k its own
+    order. With identical inputs the core is the stock kernel."""
+    from tests.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.test_specialized_decode_dsa import (  # noqa: E501
+        layer_reference,
+    )
+
+    step = dep_layer_step(core, batch, q, (600, 1100, 1500, 1980, 37))
+    # Every token selected on both paths (contexts + q <= 2048).
+    for t in range(batch):
+        a = set(step.topk[t].tolist()) - {-1}
+        b = set(step.stock_topk[t].tolist()) - {-1}
+        assert a == b, t
+    # Each pre-o_proj row set against its own FP32 reference (same top-k).
+    args = step.attn, step.projected
+    ours_ref = layer_reference(
+        *args, step.caches[0], step.mla_table, step.topk, q, step.kv
+    )
+    stock_ref = layer_reference(
+        *args, step.caches[1], step.mla_table, step.stock_topk, q, step.kv
+    )
+    ours_err, stock_err = (
+        relative(step.local, ours_ref),
+        relative(step.entering, stock_ref),
+    )
+    between = relative(step.local, step.entering)
+    print(
+        f"pre-o_proj vs FP32: ours {ours_err:.4f} stock {stock_err:.4f}; "
+        f"ours vs stock {between:.4f}; layer output vs stock "
+        f"{relative(step.out, step.stock):.4f}"
+    )
+    assert ours_err <= 1.1 * stock_err + 1e-3, (ours_err, stock_err)
+    assert between < 0.04, between
+    assert relative(step.out, step.stock) < 0.04

+"""DSpark draft dense MLA decode with the block's query tokens folded into heads
+(specialized_decode/drafter/attention.py) against the stock one-row-per-token
+FlashInfer call and an exact FP32 reference over the dequantized FP8 inputs."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100):
+    pytest.skip("trtllm-gen MLA decode needs SM100", allow_module_level=True)
+
+KV_LORA, ROPE, NOPE = 512, 64, 128
+D = KV_LORA + ROPE
+PAGE = 64
+SCALE = 192**-0.5
+
+
+def _case(R, ctxs, heads, k, seed):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    pages = [-(-c // PAGE) for c in ctxs]
+    width = -(-max(pages) // 2) * 2  # trtllm-gen: block_num % (128 / page) == 0
+    num_pages = sum(pages) + 1
+    kv = (torch.randn(num_pages, PAGE, D, device="cuda", generator=g) * 0.5).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    perm = torch.randperm(num_pages, device="cuda", generator=g)
+    bt = torch.zeros(R, width, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    off = 0
+    for r, n in enumerate(pages):
+        bt[r, :n] = perm[off : off + n]
+        off += n
+    seq = torch.tensor(ctxs, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    q = (torch.randn(R * k, heads, D, device="cuda", generator=g) * 0.5).to(
+        torch.float8_e4m3fn
+    )
+    return q, kv, bt, seq
+
+
+def _reference(q, kv, bt, seq, k):
+    out = []
+    for r in range(bt.shape[0]):
+        n = int(seq[r])
+        rows = kv[bt[r]].reshape(-1, D)[:n].float()  # [n, D]
+        qr = q[r * k : (r + 1) * k].float()  # [k, H, D]
+        s = torch.einsum("thd,nd->thn", qr, rows) * SCALE
+        p = s.softmax(-1)
+        out.append(torch.einsum("thn,nl->thl", p, rows[:, :KV_LORA]))
+    return torch.cat(out)
+
+
+def _stock(q, kv, bt, seq, k, ws, dcp=None):
+    from flashinfer.decode import trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla
+
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.flashinfer_mla import (
+        _select_mla_decode_backend,
+    )
+
+    row_req = torch.arange(q.shape[0], device="cuda") // k
+    extra = {}
+    if dcp is not None:
+        extra = dict(
+            enable_dcp=True,
+            cp_world=dcp[0],
+            cp_rank=0,
+            causal_seqlens_kv_global=dcp[1][row_req],
+            backend="cute-dsl",
+            return_lse=True,
+        )
+    else:
+        b = _select_mla_decode_backend(q.shape[1])
+        if b is not None:
+            extra["backend"] = b
+    o = trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache_mla(
+        query=q.unsqueeze(1),
+        kv_cache=kv.unsqueeze(1),
+        workspace_buffer=ws,
+        qk_nope_head_dim=NOPE,
+        kv_lora_rank=KV_LORA,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=ROPE,
+        block_tables=bt[row_req].contiguous(),
+        seq_lens=seq[row_req],
+        max_seq_len=int(seq.max()),
+        bmm1_scale=SCALE,
+        bmm2_scale=1.0,
+        **extra,
+    )
+    if dcp is not None:
+        o, lse = o
+        return o.reshape(q.shape[0], q.shape[1], KV_LORA), lse.reshape(q.shape[:2])
+    return o.reshape(q.shape[0], q.shape[1], KV_LORA)

+    ws = torch.zeros(128 << 20, dtype=torch.int8, device="cuda")

+"""The specialized DSpark drafter (specialized_decode/drafter): the fused Markov
+sampling against vLLM's own loop (``DSparkSpeculator._sample_sequential``), and the
+drafter GEMM engine against an FP32 reference and cuBLAS."""
+
+import types
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100):
+    pytest.skip("specialized drafter kernels need SM100", allow_module_level=True)
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.drafter import markov  # noqa: E402
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.drafter.linears import (  # noqa: E402
+    DraftGemm,
+)
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.draft_logits import DraftLogitsCache  # noqa: E402
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.spec_decode.dspark.speculator import (  # noqa: E402
+    DSparkSpeculator,
+)
+
+HIDDEN = 256

+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _fp32_cublas_reductions():
+    # vLLM's loop runs the bias GEMV on cuBLAS; keep its split-K reductions in
+    # FP32 so the exactly representable cases compare bit for bit.
+    old = torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = False
+    yield
+    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_bf16_reduced_precision_reduction = old
+
+
+class UnquantizedEmbeddingMethod:  # the class name the fused path checks
+    pass
+
+
+def _weights(vocab, rank, exact, g):
+    if exact:
+        # Multiples of 1/64 in [-2, 2]: every product and partial sum of the
+        # 256-term bias is exact in FP32, so any summation order rounds alike.
+        def w(*s):
+            return (torch.randint(-128, 129, s, generator=g, device="cuda") / 64.0).to(
+                torch.bfloat16
+            )
+
+        return w(vocab, rank), w(vocab, rank)
+    return (
+        (torch.randn(vocab, rank, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.3).bfloat16(),
+        (torch.randn(vocab, rank, generator=g, device="cuda") * 0.3).bfloat16(),
+    )
+
+
+def _setup(R, k, vocab, rank, dtype, exact, fp64, seed=0, max_reqs=None):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    max_reqs = max_reqs or R + 3
+    w1, w2 = _weights(vocab, rank, exact, g)

+        num_speculative_steps=k,
+        max_num_reqs=max_reqs,
+        sample_indices=torch.randperm(num_tokens, generator=g, device="cuda")[:num],
+        sample_idx_mapping=idx,
+        sample_pos=torch.randint(5, 10_000, (num,), generator=g, device="cuda"),
+        input_buffers=types.SimpleNamespace(

+        draft_tokens=torch.zeros(max_reqs, k, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),

+        draft_watermarker=None,

+    spec._sample_logits = types.MethodType(DSparkSpeculator._sample_logits, spec)
+    spec._maybe_predict_acceptance = types.MethodType(
+        DSparkSpeculator._maybe_predict_acceptance, spec
+    )
+    head_hidden = (

+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode: the DCP sparse MLA decode (dsa/attn_sparse.py)
+against an FP32 emulation of its stated precision (E4M3 query / cache, FP32 logits,
+E4M3 P at 448 of the running max per chunk, FP32 sums, one BF16 output rounding)
+and against exact attention, where its error must not exceed FlashInfer's prims_ts
+sparse decode of the same rows (the kernel it replaces). One GPU."""
+
+import math
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="SM100 (Blackwell) only",
+)
+
+ROW, LATENT, PADDED, HEADS, WIDTH, CAP = 576, 512, 128, 96, 2048, 64
+SOFTMAX = 1.0 / math.sqrt(192)
+Q_SCALE, K_SCALE = 0.05, 0.03
+
+
+def _inputs(counts, rows_total=40_000, seed=0):
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    batch = len(counts)
+    q = (torch.randn(CAP, PADDED, ROW, generator=g, device="cuda") * 2).clamp(-8, 8)
+    q[:, HEADS:] = 0
+    query = q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    kv = (torch.randn(rows_total, ROW, generator=g, device="cuda") * 3).clamp(-12, 12)
+    kv = kv.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    rows = torch.full((batch, WIDTH), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    for b, n in enumerate(counts):
+        perm = torch.randperm(rows_total, generator=g, device="cuda")[:n]
+        rows[b, :n] = perm.to(torch.int32)
+    valid = torch.tensor(counts, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return query, kv, rows, valid
+
+
+def _reference(query, kv, rows, valid, quantize_p):
+    """FP32 attention of the first HEADS heads; ``quantize_p``: the kernel's
+    schedule (each of SPLIT CTAs takes a contiguous 1 / SPLIT of the keys in
+    chunks of CHUNK, E4M3 P at 448 of its running max, FP32 sums; the CTAs'
+    partials merge in FP32)."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.attn_sparse import (
+        CHUNK,
+        SPLIT,
+    )
+
+    batch = rows.shape[0]
+    scale_log2 = SOFTMAX * Q_SCALE * K_SCALE * math.log2(math.e)
+    out = torch.zeros(batch, HEADS, LATENT, device="cuda")
+    lse = torch.full((batch, HEADS), -math.inf, device="cuda")
+    for b in range(batch):
+        n = int(valid[b])
+        if n == 0:
+            continue
+        q = query[b, :HEADS].float()
+        k = kv[rows[b, :n].long()].float()
+        s = (q @ k.T) * scale_log2  # [H, n] log2 units
+        if not quantize_p:
+            p = torch.exp2(s - s.max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values)
+            out[b] = (p @ k[:, :LATENT]) / p.sum(1, keepdim=True) * K_SCALE
+            m = s.max(dim=1).values
+            lse[b] = (m + torch.log2(p.sum(1))) * math.log(2)
+            continue
+        per = -(-n // SPLIT)
+        parts = []
+        for first in range(0, n, per):
+            m_run = torch.full((HEADS,), -math.inf, device="cuda")
+            l_run = torch.zeros(HEADS, device="cuda")
+            acc = torch.zeros(HEADS, LATENT, device="cuda")
+            for c0 in range(first, min(n, first + per), CHUNK):
+                c1 = min(c0 + CHUNK, first + per, n)
+                sc = s[:, c0:c1]
+                m_new = torch.maximum(m_run, sc.max(dim=1).values)
+                alpha = torch.where(
+                    torch.isinf(m_run),
+                    torch.ones_like(m_run),
+                    torch.exp2(m_run - m_new),
+                )
+                p = torch.exp2(sc - (m_new - math.log2(448))[:, None])
+                pq = p.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float()
+                l_run = l_run * alpha + p.sum(1)
+                acc = acc * alpha[:, None] + pq @ k[c0:c1, :LATENT]
+                m_run = m_new
+            parts.append((m_run, l_run, acc))
+        top = torch.stack([m for m, _, _ in parts]).max(0).values
+        total = sum(torch.exp2(m - top) * part for m, part, _ in parts)
+        merged = sum(torch.exp2(m - top)[:, None] * a for m, _, a in parts)
+        out[b] = merged / total[:, None] * K_SCALE
+        lse[b] = (top - math.log2(448) + torch.log2(total)) * math.log(2)
+    return out, lse
+
+
+def _run_sparse(query, kv, rows, valid):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.attn_sparse import (
+        compile_sparse,
+        run_sparse,
+    )
+
+    batch = rows.shape[0]
+    kernel = compile_sparse(batch, HEADS, PADDED, WIDTH, CAP, 0)
+    latent = torch.full((batch, PADDED, LATENT), float("nan"), device="cuda")
+    latent = latent.bfloat16()
+    lse = torch.full((batch, PADDED), float("nan"), device="cuda")
+    scale_log2 = SOFTMAX * Q_SCALE * K_SCALE * math.log2(math.e)
+    run_sparse(kernel, query, kv, rows, valid, latent, lse, scale_log2, K_SCALE)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return latent, lse
+
+
+_PLANS: dict = {}
+
+
+def _run_prims_ts(query, kv, rows, valid):
+    latent, lse = _run_prims_ts_nosync(query, kv, rows, valid)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    return latent, lse

+
+def _run_prims_ts_nosync(query, kv, rows, valid):
+    """FlashInfer prims_ts on the plan of the batch's rows (planned once)."""
+    from flashinfer.attention.prims_ts import (
+        BatchSparseMLADecodePagedTSWrapper,
+        get_prims_ts_sparse_mla_decode_workspace_size,
+    )
+
+    batch, device = rows.shape[0], torch.device("cuda")
+    if batch in _PLANS:
+        plan, latent, lse, indptr = _PLANS[batch]
+        plan.run(
+            query[:batch],
+            kv,
+            rows,
+            valid,
+            qo_indptr=indptr,
+            softmax_scale=SOFTMAX * Q_SCALE * K_SCALE,
+            output_scale=K_SCALE,
+            out=latent,
+            lse=lse,
+            validate=False,

+        return latent, lse
+    kwargs = dict(
+        max_q_len=1,
+        q_dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+        max_topk=WIDTH,
+        packed_query=True,
+        qk_rope_head_dim=64,
+        kv_cache_format="native",
+    )
+    size = get_prims_ts_sparse_mla_decode_workspace_size(
+        device, batch, PADDED, return_lse=True, **kwargs
+    )
+    plan = BatchSparseMLADecodePagedTSWrapper(
+        torch.empty(size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+    )
+    plan.plan(device, batch, PADDED, return_lse=True, **kwargs)
+    latent = torch.empty(batch, PADDED, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    lse = torch.empty(batch, PADDED, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    indptr = torch.arange(batch + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+    _PLANS[batch] = plan, latent, lse, indptr
+    return _run_prims_ts_nosync(query, kv, rows, valid)

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "counts",
+    [
+        [256, 255, 0, 1, 31],
+        [300, 2048, 257, 513, 7],

+    ids=["dcp8", "saturated", "ten"],

+def test_sparse_matches_emulation(counts):

+    latent, lse = _run_sparse(query, kv, rows, valid)
+    ref, ref_lse = _reference(query, kv, rows, valid, quantize_p=True)
+    got = latent[:, :HEADS].float()
+    for b, n in enumerate(counts):
+        if n == 0:
+            assert torch.all(got[b] == 0)
+            assert torch.all(torch.isneginf(lse[b, :HEADS]))
+            continue

+        # One BF16 rounding plus E4M3 P flips at rounding ties (exp2 approx).
+        assert err < 2e-2, (b, n, float(err))

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("counts", [[256, 255, 1, 31, 200], [300, 2048, 257, 513, 7]])

+        e_fi = ((theirs[b, :HEADS].float() - exact[b]) / scale).pow(2).mean().sqrt()

+def test_sparse_push_into_value_mailbox():
+    """``push``: the merged rows and base-2 LSEs land in DcpValue's "bf16" mailbox
+    slot [parity, rank, row, head % H] of owner head // H (as DcpValue's own push
+    of the unpushed rows: no negative zeros; a row with nothing to merge sends
+    only EMPTY_LSE), and the q mailbox rows read are re-armed."""
+    from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.attn_sparse import (
+        compile_sparse,
+        run_sparse,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.mla.dcp import (
+        EMPTY_LSE,
+        PAIR_SENT,
+    )
+
+    counts = [256, 0, 37, 300, 2048]
+    owners, dcp, parity, rank = 12, 8, 1, 3
+    query, kv, rows, valid = _inputs(counts, seed=2)

+    batch = len(counts)
+    shape = (dcp, 2, dcp, CAP, owners, LATENT)
+    boxes = torch.empty(shape, dtype=torch.int16, device="cuda")
+    boxes.view(torch.int32).fill_(PAIR_SENT - (1 << 32))
+    lboxes = torch.full((dcp, 2, dcp, CAP, owners), -1, dtype=torch.int32).cuda()
+    i64 = dict(dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+    mail = SimpleNamespace(
+        peers=torch.tensor([boxes[o].data_ptr() for o in range(dcp)], **i64),
+        lse_peers=torch.tensor([lboxes[o].data_ptr() for o in range(dcp)], **i64),
+    )
+    kernel = compile_sparse(batch, HEADS, PADDED, WIDTH, CAP, 0, push=(owners, dcp))
+    pushed_q = query.clone()
+    out = torch.zeros(batch, PADDED, LATENT, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    out_lse = torch.zeros(batch, PADDED, device="cuda")
+    scale_log2 = SOFTMAX * Q_SCALE * K_SCALE * math.log2(math.e)
+    args = (pushed_q, kv, rows, valid, out, out_lse, scale_log2, K_SCALE)
+    run_sparse(kernel, *args, push=(mail, parity, rank))
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    want = latent.view(torch.int16).clone()
+    want[want == -32768] = 0  # no negative zeros
+    for b, n in enumerate(counts):
+        for gh in range(HEADS):
+            owner, h = gh // owners, gh % owners
+            got_lse = lboxes[owner, parity, rank, b, h].view(torch.float32)
+            row = boxes[owner, parity, rank, b, h]
+            if n == 0:
+                empty = torch.tensor(EMPTY_LSE, dtype=torch.float32)
+                assert float(got_lse) == float(empty)
+                assert torch.all(row.view(torch.int32) == PAIR_SENT - (1 << 32))
+                continue

+            expect = float(lse[b, gh]) * math.log2(math.e)
+            assert abs(float(got_lse) - expect) <= 1e-5 * abs(expect) + 1e-5
+    rearmed = pushed_q[:batch, :HEADS].view(torch.uint8)
+    assert torch.all(rearmed == 0xFF)
+    assert torch.equal(pushed_q[:batch, HEADS:], query[:batch, HEADS:])
+    assert torch.equal(pushed_q[batch:], query[batch:])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DEP MoE layer schedule (specialized_decode/cutedsl/moe/ep/layer.py EpMoeLayer) vs
+the stock op sequence of KimiMoE.forward on one GPU: router GEMM (FP32 logits) +
+sigmoid top-16, latent down-projection, routed experts (a deterministic stand-in of
+the EP kernel), shared expert (gate_up, SiTU, down), latent RMSNorm + up-projection
+accumulated into the shared output. The schedule's split-K GEMMs reduce in another
+order than cuBLAS; everything else is the stock op. Also captured in a CUDA graph.
+
+SiTU-and-mul runs both as the stock CUDA kernel (which indexes rows at a 2I pitch, so
+it needs contiguous gate_up rows: the packed front's rows are 2I + 3584 apart) and
+as the native op; every multi-row batch compares the shared expert row by row."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+H, LAT, SHARED, E = 7168, 3584, 6144, 896
+
+
+SEEN = []
+
+
+def stand_in(latent, topk_w, topk_ids):
+    """Routed-expert stand-in: depends on the latent only (top-k ties may differ);
+    the routing it was given is recorded and checked against the stock router."""
+    SEEN.append((topk_w, topk_ids))
+    return (latent.float() * 0.75 + latent.float().roll(1, dims=1) * 0.25).to(
+        latent.dtype
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100), reason="needs SM100"
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("impl", ["cuda", "native"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [1, 5, 20, 40, 80, 96])
+def test_ep_moe_layer_matches_stock_sequence(tokens, impl):
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.activation import SituAndMul
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.router.grouped_topk_router import (
+        fused_grouped_topk,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.moe.ep.layer import (
+        EpMoeLayer,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(tokens)
+    dev = "cuda"
+
+    def bf16(*shape, scale=0.02):
+        return (torch.randn(*shape, device=dev) * scale).to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+    gate_up, down = bf16(2 * SHARED, H), bf16(LAT, H)
+    w = dict(
+        gate=bf16(E, H),
+        bias=torch.randn(E, device=dev) * 0.01,
+        front=torch.cat([gate_up, down]),
+        shared_down=bf16(H, SHARED),
+        norm=(torch.rand(LAT, device=dev) + 0.5).to(torch.bfloat16),
+        up=bf16(H, LAT),
+    )
+    x = bf16(tokens, H, scale=1.0)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+        situ = SituAndMul(beta=4.0, linear_beta=25.0)
+        act = situ.forward_cuda if impl == "cuda" else situ.forward_native
+        # 96 > FRONT_MAX: the layer must fall back to the stock order.
+        layer = EpMoeLayer(w, act, stand_in, [tokens])
+        assert (tokens in layer.batches) == (tokens <= 80)
+
+        logits = torch.mm(x, w["gate"].t(), out_dtype=torch.float32)
+        ref_w, ref_ids = fused_grouped_topk(
+            x, logits, 16, True, w["bias"], 1, 1, "sigmoid", 1.0
+        )
+        latent = torch.mm(x, down.t())
+        shared = torch.mm(act(torch.mm(x, gate_up.t())), w["shared_down"].t())
+        routed = stand_in(latent, ref_w, ref_ids)
+        normed = torch.empty_like(routed)
+        ops.rms_norm(normed, routed, w["norm"], 1e-5)
+        expected = shared.addmm_(normed, w["up"].t())
+
+        SEEN.clear()
+        out = layer(x)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        ((got_w, got_ids),) = SEEN
+        # Same experts per token (as sets: ties may order differently) and weights.
+        order, ref_order = got_ids.sort(dim=1), ref_ids.sort(dim=1)
+        assert torch.equal(order.values, ref_order.values)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            got_w.gather(1, order.indices),
+            ref_w.gather(1, ref_order.indices),
+            atol=1e-5,
+            rtol=1e-4,
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected, atol=3e-2, rtol=2e-2)
+        rel = (out.float() - expected.float()).norm() / expected.float().norm()
+        assert rel < 5e-3, rel
+        # Row by row (a shared expert row read at the wrong pitch is O(1) off).
+        rows = (out.float() - expected.float()).norm(dim=1)
+        assert (rows < 1e-2 * expected.float().norm(dim=1)).all(), rows
+
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+            graph_out = layer(x)
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        torch.testing.assert_close(graph_out, out, atol=0, rtol=0)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""Kimi K3.1 specialized decode with the MXFP4 DSA indexer cache (68 B/token,
+indexer_kv_dtype="mxfp4" on SM100): the decode's FP4 writers against the stock writers
+(bit-exact), and the fused FP4 scorer against DeepGEMM's FP4 paged MQA logits
+(bit-exact: the same block-scaled MXF4 MMA and BF16 head sum), with the exact
+top-k of its own logits (TP) and the DCP logits layout and local select."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),
+    reason="the specialized decode kernels need SM100/SM103",
+)
+
+UNIT, MLA_ROW, FP4_ROW = 64, 656, 68  # indexer page tokens; cache row bytes
+GAP = 36  # rows of the other layers' pages between two blocks of a packed cache
+HEADS = 12  # TP8 attention heads
+GATE = HEADS * 128
+PITCH = 2112 + GATE + 128 + 32  # packed [q_a | kv_a | gate | wk | wv] row
+KEY = 2112 + GATE  # wk column offset in the packed row
+EPS = 1e-6
+E2M1 = (0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0)
+
+
+def packed_cache(blocks, block, row, gap=GAP):
+    stride = (block + gap) * row
+    raw = torch.zeros(blocks * stride, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    return torch.as_strided(raw, (blocks, block, row), (stride, row, 1))
+
+
+def pages(index):
+    """Each indexer page's bytes: [64 x 64 B E2M1 | 64 x 4 UE8M0]."""
+    return torch.as_strided(
+        index, (index.shape[0], index.shape[1] * FP4_ROW), (index.stride(0), 1)
+    )
+
+
+def dequant(codes, scales):
+    """E2M1 bytes [..., 64] (low nibble first) and UE8M0 bytes [..., 4] ->
+    FP32 [..., 128]."""
+    table = torch.tensor(E2M1, device=codes.device)
+    table = torch.cat([table, -table])
+    nib = torch.stack([codes & 15, codes >> 4], -1).flatten(-2).long()
+    values = table[nib].unflatten(-1, (4, 32))
+    scale = torch.exp2(scales.float() - 127).unsqueeze(-1)
+    return (values * scale).flatten(-2)
+
+
+def kernels(batch, mla, index, *weights):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        layout,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.prepared import (
+        compile_core,
+    )
+
+    specs = tuple(layout(w) for w in (*weights, mla, index))
+    device = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    return compile_core(batch, HEADS, PITCH, specs, device, 1)
+
+
+def adversarial_heads(iq):
+    """Heads whose block maxima sit at and next to 6 x 2^k (where the stock
+    writer's ceil(log2(amax / 6)) changes) and an all-zero head."""
+    rows = iq.view(iq.shape[0], 32, 4, 32)
+    for k, head in enumerate(range(1, 9)):
+        base = 6.0 * 2.0 ** (k - 4)
+        rows[:, head] *= 0.05 * 2.0 ** (k - 4)  # the planted value is the max
+        for b, ulps in enumerate((0, 1, -1, 2)):
+            value = torch.tensor(base, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            bits = value.view(torch.int16) + ulps
+            rows[:, head, b, 7] = bits.view(torch.bfloat16).item()
+    rows[0, 0] = 0
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("gap", [0, GAP])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 5, 64, 320])
+def test_fp4_indexer_inputs(batch, gap):
+    """DsaIndex on an MXFP4 indexer cache writes the stock writers' bytes:
+    mxfp4_q_quant's E2M1 query and UE8M0 scales (in the query rows'
+    FP4 layout) and its BF16 head weights, and mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert's
+    MXFP4 key bytes and scales (the stock writer's log2 rounding included)."""
+    import cutlass
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer_mxfp4 import (
+        mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert,
+        mxfp4_q_quant,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        stream,
+        to_cute,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(batch)
+    bf, dev = torch.bfloat16, "cuda"
+    projected = torch.randn(batch, PITCH, device=dev, dtype=bf)
+    projected[:, KEY : KEY + 128] *= torch.logspace(-3, 3, batch, device=dev).to(bf)[
+        :, None
+    ]
+    iq = torch.randn(batch, 32 * 128, device=dev, dtype=bf)
+    adversarial_heads(iq)
+    norm_w = torch.rand(128, device=dev) + 0.5
+    norm_b = torch.randn(128, device=dev) / 10
+    mla = packed_cache(8, UNIT, MLA_ROW)
+    blocks = -(-batch // UNIT) + 8
+    index = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW, gap)
+    slots = torch.randperm(blocks * UNIT - 1, device=dev)[:batch]
+    slots[0] = blocks * UNIT - 1
+    if batch > 2:
+        slots[1] = -1  # a padded row (or a token another DCP rank owns)
+    weights = (
+        torch.ones(1536, device=dev, dtype=bf),
+        torch.ones(512, device=dev, dtype=bf),
+        torch.zeros(HEADS * 192, 1536, device=dev, dtype=bf),
+        torch.zeros(HEADS, 128, 512, device=dev, dtype=bf),
+        torch.zeros(HEADS, 128, 512, device=dev, dtype=bf).transpose(1, 2),
+    )
+    _, index_kernel, _ = kernels(batch, mla, index, *weights)
+    q_rows = torch.full((batch, 32, 128), 0x77, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    head_w = torch.zeros(batch, 32, device=dev, dtype=bf)
+    args = (to_cute(projected), to_cute(iq), to_cute(norm_w, 4), to_cute(norm_b, 4))
+    args += (to_cute(index), to_cute(slots, 8), to_cute(q_rows), to_cute(head_w, 4))
+    index_kernel(*args, cutlass.Float32(EPS), stream(dev))
+
+    ref_q, ref_s, ref_w = mxfp4_q_quant(
+        iq.view(batch, 32, 128),
+        projected[:, KEY + 128 : KEY + 160],
+        128**-0.5 * 32**-0.5,
+        32,
+    )
+    packed, scales = fp4_query_views(q_rows, batch)
+    assert torch.equal(packed, ref_q)
+    assert torch.equal(scales, ref_s)
+    # The stock decode casts the FP32 weights to BF16 for SM100's MQA logits.
+    assert torch.equal(head_w, ref_w.to(bf))
+
+    stock = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW, gap)
+    topk = torch.empty(batch, 2048, device=dev, dtype=torch.int32)
+    k = projected[:, KEY : KEY + 128]
+    mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert(k, norm_w, norm_b, EPS, slots, stock, topk, batch)
+    assert torch.equal(pages(index), pages(stock))
+
+
+FRONT_BATCHES = [1, 16, 64, 80, 320]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kernel_kind", ["mma", "mma-qc", "cluster"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", FRONT_BATCHES)
+def test_fp4_index_front(batch, kernel_kind):
+    """The fused index fronts on an MXFP4 indexer cache: the key bytes exactly
+    the stock insert's, the head weights exactly bf16(wv / 64), and the FP4
+    query as mxfp4_q_quant of the front's own projection: its codes
+    equal the stock writer's of an FP32 projection of the same q_c except where
+    the BF16 projection rounds differently (dequantized within one E2M1 step of
+    the block's scale)."""
+    import cutlass
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer_mxfp4 import (
+        mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert,
+        mxfp4_q_quant,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        layout,
+        stream,
+        to_cute,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa import (
+        query_stage,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.gemm.projection import (  # noqa: E501
+        weight_map,
+    )
+
+    if kernel_kind == "cluster" and batch > 64:
+        pytest.skip("IndexFront serves at most 64 rows")
+    torch.manual_seed(batch)
+    bf, dev = torch.bfloat16, "cuda"
+    projected = torch.randn(batch, PITCH, device=dev, dtype=bf) * 2
+    q_norm = torch.rand(1536, device=dev, dtype=bf) + 0.5
+    wq = torch.randn(32 * 128, 1536, device=dev, dtype=bf) / 30
+    norm_w = torch.rand(128, device=dev) + 0.5
+    norm_b = torch.randn(128, device=dev) / 10
+    blocks = -(-batch // UNIT) + 8
+    index = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW, GAP)
+    slots = torch.randperm(blocks * UNIT - 1, device=dev)[:batch]
+    if batch > 2:
+        slots[1] = -1
+    dev_index = torch.accelerator.current_device_index()
+    normalized = kernel_kind == "mma-qc"
+    saved = query_stage.FRONT_KERNEL
+    query_stage.FRONT_KERNEL = "cluster" if kernel_kind == "cluster" else "mma"
+    try:
+        specs = layout(wq), layout(index)
+        args = batch, HEADS, PITCH, *specs, dev_index, normalized
+        kernel = query_stage.compile_front(*args)
+    finally:
+        query_stage.FRONT_KERNEL = saved
+    q_rows = torch.zeros(batch, 32, 128, device=dev, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    head_w = torch.zeros(batch, 32, device=dev, dtype=bf)
+    var = projected[:, :1536].float()
+    q_c = var * torch.rsqrt(var.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + EPS)
+    q_c = (q_c * q_norm.float()).to(bf)
+    args = (to_cute(projected),)
+    weights = to_cute(wq)
+    if kernel_kind != "cluster":
+        args += (to_cute(q_c) if normalized else to_cute(projected),)
+        wq_map = weight_map(wq, 128)
+        weights = cutlass.Int64(wq_map.data_ptr())
+    args += (to_cute(q_norm), weights)
+    args += (to_cute(norm_w, 4), to_cute(norm_b, 4), to_cute(index))
+    args += (to_cute(slots, 8), to_cute(q_rows), to_cute(head_w, 4))
+    kernel(*args, cutlass.Float32(EPS), cutlass.Float32(EPS), stream(dev))
+
+    wv = projected[:, KEY + 128 : KEY + 160]
+    assert torch.equal(head_w, (wv.float() / 64).to(bf))
+    iq = (q_c.float() @ wq.float().T).to(bf)
+    ref_q, ref_s, _ = mxfp4_q_quant(iq.view(batch, 32, 128), wv, 1 / 64, 32)
+    packed, scales = fp4_query_views(q_rows, batch)
+    ours = dequant(packed, scales.view(torch.uint8).view(batch, 32, 4))
+    theirs = dequant(ref_q, ref_s.view(torch.uint8).view(batch, 32, 4))
+    step = torch.exp2(
+        torch.maximum(
+            scales.view(torch.uint8).view(batch, 32, 4),
+            ref_s.view(torch.uint8).view(batch, 32, 4),
+        ).float()
+        - 127
+    )
+    bound = 2 * step.repeat_interleave(32, -1)  # one E2M1 step at the top binade
+    assert bool(((ours - theirs).abs() <= bound).all())
+    assert (packed != ref_q).float().mean() < 0.05
+    assert (scales != ref_s).float().mean() < 0.01
+
+    stock = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW, GAP)
+    topk = torch.empty(batch, 2048, device=dev, dtype=torch.int32)
+    k = projected[:, KEY : KEY + 128]
+    mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert(k, norm_w, norm_b, EPS, slots, stock, topk, batch)
+    assert torch.equal(pages(index), pages(stock))

+def order16(bits):
+    bits = bits & 0xFFFF
+    return torch.where(bits & 0x8000 != 0, bits ^ 0xFFFF, bits ^ 0x8000)
+
+
+def exact_topk(bits, k):
+    """Key indices of the top ``k`` of BF16 ``bits`` (ties to the lowest index),
+    in key order."""
+    pos = torch.arange(bits.shape[0], device=bits.device)
+    key = order16(bits.int()).long() << 32 | (2**32 - 1 - pos)
+    return torch.topk(key, min(k, bits.shape[0])).indices.sort().values
+
+
+def fp4_inputs(contexts, q, seed, gap=GAP):
+    """A packed MXFP4 indexer cache of random E2M1 codes and UE8M0 scales under a
+    random block table, per-row ends (row j of a request sees context + 1 + j
+    keys), the MXFP4 query in the query rows' layout and BF16 head weights."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    need = [-(-(c + q) // UNIT) for c in contexts]
+    blocks = sum(need) + 3
+    index = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW, gap)
+    page = pages(index)
+    page[:, : UNIT * 64] = torch.randint(
+        0, 256, (blocks, UNIT * 64), device="cuda", generator=gen, dtype=torch.uint8
+    )
+    page[:, UNIT * 64 :] = torch.randint(
+        118, 136, (blocks, UNIT * 4), device="cuda", generator=gen
+    ).to(torch.uint8)
+    perm = torch.randperm(blocks, device="cuda", generator=gen).int()
+    table = torch.zeros(len(contexts), max(need), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    used = 0
+    for r, n in enumerate(need):
+        table[r, :n] = perm[used : used + n]
+        used += n
+    ends = [c + 1 + j for c in contexts for j in range(q)]
+    ends = torch.tensor(ends, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    rows = max(64, len(contexts) * q)
+    q_rows = torch.zeros(rows, 32, 128, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    packed, scales = fp4_query_views(q_rows, rows)
+    packed.copy_(
+        torch.randint(0, 256, packed.shape, device="cuda", generator=gen).to(
+            torch.uint8
+        )
+    )
+    exps = torch.randint(118, 136, (rows, 32, 4), device="cuda", generator=gen)
+    scales.copy_(exps.to(torch.uint8).view(torch.int32).view(rows, 32))
+    weights = (torch.randn(rows, 32, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.1).bfloat16()
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        index=index, table=table, ends=ends, q_rows=q_rows, weights=weights
+    )
+
+
+def deepgemm_logits(x, rows, q, max_len):
+    """Stock's decode logits (DeepGEMM SM100 FP4 paged MQA logits, varlen as the
+    indexer metadata builds them): BF16 [rows, max_len]."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import (
+        kv_cache_as_quant_view,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+    from vllm.utils.deep_gemm import (
+        fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits,
+        get_num_sms,
+        get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata,
+        mqa_logits_mx_inputs,
+    )
+
+    packed, scales = fp4_query_views(x.q_rows, rows)
+    query = packed.contiguous().view(torch.int8).view(rows, 1, 32, 64)
+    q_scale = scales.contiguous().view(rows, 1, 32)
+    lens = x.ends[:rows].view(rows, 1).contiguous()
+    table = x.table.repeat_interleave(q, 0)[:rows].contiguous()
+    indices = torch.arange(rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    schedule = get_paged_mqa_logits_metadata(lens, UNIT, get_num_sms(), indices)
+    q_scale, weights = mqa_logits_mx_inputs(query, q_scale, x.weights[:rows])
+    return fp8_fp4_paged_mqa_logits(
+        (query, q_scale),
+        kv_cache_as_quant_view(x.index, 128, True),
+        weights,
+        lens,
+        table,
+        schedule,
+        max_model_len=max_len,
+        indices=indices,
+    )
+
+
+def same_bits(got, ref):
+    """BF16 bits equal (int16 tensors), -0 as +0."""
+    got, ref = got.int() & 0xFFFF, ref.int() & 0xFFFF
+    got = torch.where(got == 0x8000, 0, got)
+    ref = torch.where(ref == 0x8000, 0, ref)
+    return torch.equal(got, ref)
+

+FP4_TP_CASES = {
+    "short": ([1500, 300], 5),
+    "boundary": ([2046, 2047, 2048, 2049], 1),
+    "mixed": ([5000, 300, 9000, 33000], 5),
+    "long": ([100000, 70000, 3000, 130000], 5),
+    "q1_64": ([3000 + 977 * r for r in range(64)], 1),
+    "padded": ([40000, 3000, 0], 5),
+    "q7": ([6000, 20000, 2500], 7),
+    "q8": ([6000, 20000, 2500], 8),
+    "wide320": ([3000 + 257 * r for r in range(64)], 5),

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", list(FP4_TP_CASES))
+def test_fused_fp4_indexer_tp(case):
+    """The fused decode indexer (TP) on MXFP4 keys: its BF16 logits bit-exact
+    DeepGEMM's FP4 paged MQA logits (the stock decode's), and its selection
+    exactly the top-2048 of them (ties to the lowest key), as the MLA cache's
+    physical rows in key order with the counts."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.indexer import (
+        FusedIndexer,
+    )
+
+    contexts, q = FP4_TP_CASES[case]
+    x = fp4_inputs(contexts, q, len(contexts) * 131 + q)
+    rows, topk, mla_page = len(contexts) * q, 2048, UNIT
+    block_rows = mla_page + GAP
+    ends, table = x.ends, x.table
+    if case == "padded":
+        ends[-q:] = 0
+    real = rows - q if case == "padded" else rows
+    decode = SimpleNamespace(
+        seq_lens=ends[:real].view(real, 1),
+        block_table=table.repeat_interleave(q, 0)[:real],
+    )
+    indexer = SimpleNamespace(
+        k_cache=SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=x.index),
+        topk_tokens=topk,
+        max_model_len=1 << 20,
+    )
+    cap = max(64, rows)
+    fused = FusedIndexer(indexer, [(rows, q)], torch.device("cuda"), cap)
+    assert fused.fp4
+    mla_pages = max(-(-(c + q) // mla_page) for c in contexts)
+    mla_table = torch.randint(
+        1 << 14, (len(contexts), mla_pages), device="cuda", dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    ids = torch.full((cap, topk), -7, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    fused.write_ids(ids)
+    out, valid = fused.run(x.q_rows, x.weights, decode, mla_table, block_rows, rows, q)
+    ref = deepgemm_logits(x, rows, q, int(ends.max()) + 1).view(torch.int16)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    tiles = [-(-c // 128) if c > topk else 0 for c in ends[q - 1 :: q].tolist()]
+    for t in range(rows):
+        r, j, length = t // q, t % q, int(ends[t])
+        pos = torch.arange(length, device="cuda")
+        if tiles[r]:
+            base = (sum(tiles[:r]) * q + j * tiles[r]) * 128
+            got = fused.logits[base : base + length]
+            assert same_bits(got, ref[t, :length]), (case, t)
+            if length > topk:
+                pos = exact_topk(got, topk)
+        n = min(length, topk)
+        page = mla_table[r][pos // mla_page].long()
+        physical = page * block_rows + pos % mla_page
+        assert int(valid[t]) == n
+        assert torch.equal(out[t, :n].long(), physical), (case, t)
+        assert torch.equal(ids[t, :n].long(), pos), (case, t)
+        assert bool((out[t, n:] == -1).all()) and bool((ids[t, n:] == -1).all())

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("q", [1, 5])
+def test_prefill_cache_round_trip(q):
+    """P/D cache round trip: a prefill engine writes the MXFP4 indexer keys
+    through the stock model's call (mxfp4_fused_prologue, 16K-token chunks into
+    packed block rows under a block table), the decode's fused scorer reads them:
+    its BF16 logits bit-exact DeepGEMM's FP4 paged MQA logits (the stock decode's
+    read) and its selection the exact top-2048; the stock prefill's gather of the
+    same cache returns the written bytes, which dequantize to the LayerNorm'd
+    keys within half an E2M1 step of their block."""
+    import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer_mxfp4 import (
+        mxfp4_fused_prologue,
+        mxfp4_q_quant,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.index import (
+        fp4_query_views,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.indexer import (
+        FusedIndexer,
+    )
+
+    contexts, topk, chunk = [1500, 2047, 9000, 40000, 70000], 2048, 16384
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(17 + q)
+    need = [-(-(c + q) // UNIT) for c in contexts]
+    blocks = sum(need) + 3
+    index = packed_cache(blocks, UNIT, FP4_ROW)
+    perm = torch.randperm(blocks, device="cuda", generator=gen).int()
+    table = torch.zeros(len(contexts), max(need), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    used = 0
+    for r, n in enumerate(need):
+        table[r, :n] = perm[used : used + n]
+        used += n
+
+    # Prefill: every request's context and its q draft/verify positions.
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    lens = [c + q - 1 for c in contexts]
+    req = torch.cat([torch.full((n,), r, device="cuda") for r, n in enumerate(lens)])
+    pos = torch.cat([torch.arange(n, device="cuda") for n in lens])
+    slots = (table[req, pos // UNIT].long() * UNIT + pos % UNIT).contiguous()
+    tokens = slots.shape[0]
+    keys = torch.randn(tokens, 128, device="cuda", dtype=bf, generator=gen) * 3
+    k_w = torch.rand(128, device="cuda", generator=gen) + 0.5
+    k_b = torch.randn(128, device="cuda", generator=gen) * 0.1
+    q_w = torch.ones(1536, device="cuda", dtype=bf)
+    kv_w = torch.ones(512, device="cuda", dtype=bf)
+    for start in range(0, tokens, chunk):
+        end = min(start + chunk, tokens)
+        n = end - start
+        q_c = torch.randn(n, 1536, device="cuda", dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        kv_c = torch.randn(n, 512, device="cuda", dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        k_pe = torch.randn(n, 64, device="cuda", dtype=bf, generator=gen)
+        scratch = torch.empty(n, topk, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        mxfp4_fused_prologue(
+            q_c, kv_c, k_pe, keys[start:end], q_w, kv_w, k_w, k_b, EPS, scratch,
+            None, None, index, slots[start:end],
+        )  # fmt: skip
+
+    # The written keys: the LayerNorm'd BF16 keys within half an E2M1 step.
+    page = pages(index)
+    codes = page[:, : UNIT * 64].reshape(-1, 64)
+    scales = page[:, UNIT * 64 :].reshape(-1, 4)
+    got = dequant(codes[slots], scales[slots])
+    ref = F.layer_norm(keys.float(), (128,), k_w, k_b, EPS).to(bf).float()
+    step = torch.exp2(scales[slots].float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+    assert bool(((got - ref).abs() <= step).all())  # one step at the 4-6 code gap
+    # The stock prefill's read: the gathered rows are the written bytes.
+    k_quant = torch.empty(lens[-1], 64, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    k_scale = torch.empty(lens[-1], 4, dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda")
+    ops.cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache(
+        index,
+        k_quant,
+        k_scale,
+        table[-1:].contiguous(),
+        torch.tensor([0, lens[-1]], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"),

+    last = slots[req == len(contexts) - 1]

+
+    # Decode: the MXFP4 query (as the stock writer makes it) in the query rows.
+    rows = len(contexts) * q
+    iq = torch.randn(rows, 32, 128, device="cuda", dtype=bf, generator=gen)

+    packed, scale_words = fp4_query_views(q_rows, rows)
+    packed.copy_(q_packed)

+    ends = torch.tensor(
+        [c + 1 + j for c in contexts for j in range(q)],

+    )
+    indexer = SimpleNamespace(
+        k_cache=SimpleNamespace(kv_cache=index), topk_tokens=topk, max_model_len=1 << 20
+    )
+    fused = FusedIndexer(indexer, [(rows, q)], torch.device("cuda"), max(64, rows))
+    assert fused.fp4
+    mla_table = torch.randint(

+    )
+    ids = torch.full((max(64, rows), topk), -7, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    fused.write_ids(ids)

+    ref_logits = deepgemm_logits(x, rows, q, int(ends.max()) + 1).view(torch.int16)
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    tiles = [-(-c // 128) if c > topk else 0 for c in ends[q - 1 :: q].tolist()]
+    for t in range(rows):
+        r, j, length = t // q, t % q, int(ends[t])
+        sel = torch.arange(length, device="cuda")
+        if tiles[r]:
+            base = (sum(tiles[:r]) * q + j * tiles[r]) * 128

+def _local_select(rows, n, pitch, world):
+    """IndexerLocalTopk with its exchange push, compiled for [rows] rows."""
+    import cutlass
+    import cutlass.cute as cute
+    from cutlass.cute.runtime import make_fake_stream
+
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.common.host import (
+        dynamic_fake,
+        fake,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.dsa.indexer import (
+        IndexerLocalTopk,
+    )
+
+    width = n + n // 32
+    args = (
+        fake((rows * pitch,), (1,), cutlass.Int16),
+        fake((rows,), (1,), torch.int32, 4),
+        fake((rows, width), (width, 1), torch.int32, 4),
+        fake((rows,), (1,), torch.int32, 4),
+        dynamic_fake(1, torch.int64),
+        dynamic_fake(1, torch.int32),
+        cutlass.Int32(0),
+        cutlass.Int32(1),

+def _local_workspace(world, rank, max_rows, topk, n):
+    """A rescue workspace whose W peers are this GPU's own buffers."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge import packed_row_words, rescue_slots
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import DCPTopkRescueWorkspace
+
+    ws = DCPTopkRescueWorkspace.__new__(DCPTopkRescueWorkspace)
+    slots = rescue_slots(topk, n)
+    recv = torch.zeros(
+        max_rows, slots, packed_row_words(topk), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda"
+    )
+    flags = torch.zeros(world, max_rows, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    ptrs = [torch.tensor([t.data_ptr()] * world, device="cuda") for t in (recv, flags)]
+    ws._init(recv, flags, *ptrs, max_rows, topk, n)

+"""The specialized decode's KdaSplit against the stock KDA decode it replaces, at
+the production dtypes (FP32 conv weight, BF16 conv state, FP32 recurrent state)
+and TP8 heads.
+
+Stock decode per step kind (``vllm/models/kimi_k3/nvidia/kda.py``):
+- verify (q > 1), DS conv layout (production): Triton ``causal_conv1d_update``
+  (Q/K/V stored BF16) -> ``fused_recurrent_kda`` (output stored BF16) -> gated
+  RMSNorm (``rms_norm_gated``);
+- verify, SD conv layout: FlashInfer ``packed_fused_kda_decode`` (BF16 Q/K/V and
+  output in shared memory);
+- q = 1 next to a speculative config (production, ``kda_decode_backend ==
+  "triton"``): Triton ``causal_conv1d_update`` ->
+  ``fused_recurrent_kda_packed_decode`` -> gated RMSNorm.
+
+KdaSplit runs each stage at stock precision; only the reduction order differs. So
+the states it writes match stock to FP32 reduction noise and almost every output
+element is bit-identical. The RecoverSSM key record (the BF16 pre-normalization
+key) is bit-identical to the stock convolution's key."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not (
+    current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+):
+    pytest.skip("The specialized decode needs SM10x", allow_module_level=True)
+pytest.importorskip("cutlass")
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.causal_conv1d import (  # noqa: E402
+    causal_conv1d_update,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.recoverssm import (  # noqa: E402
+    KDARecoverSSMRecords,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.third_party.kda import (  # noqa: E402
+    fused_recurrent_kda,
+    fused_recurrent_kda_packed_decode,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.kda.prepared import (  # noqa: E402
+    PreparedKda,
+    decode_conv_weight,
+)
+from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.kda import (  # noqa: E402
+    rms_norm_gated,
+)
+
+D, HEADS = 128, 12  # TP8 (and DCP8) Kimi-K3 KDA heads
+DIM = HEADS * D
+# Q, K, V, output gate, F_A, beta and the stock padding to 16 columns.
+PITCH = 4 * DIM + D + HEADS + 4
+LOWER_BOUND, EPS = -5.0, 1e-5
+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+
+
+def _attention(seed, spec="native"):
+    """A KDA layer's decode parameters at the production dtypes."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    randn = lambda *shape: torch.randn(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        conv1d=SimpleNamespace(weight=randn(3 * DIM, 1, 4) * 0.5, bias=None),
+        dt_bias=randn(DIM) * 0.5,
+        A_log=randn(HEADS) * 0.5,
+        # F_B weights and F_A rows on a 2^-6 / integer grid: the gate projection is
+        # exact in any order, so the raw gates (BF16) agree bit for bit.
+        f_b_proj=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=(randn(DIM, D) * 3).round().clamp(-8, 8).bfloat16() / 64
+        ),
+        o_norm=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=(torch.rand(D, device=DEVICE, generator=g) + 0.5).bfloat16(),
+            eps=EPS,
+        ),
+        gate_lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+        recoverssm_records=None,
+        kda_spec_decode_backend=spec,
+    )
+
+
+def _inputs(seed, rows, slots, window):
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed + 1)
+    randn = lambda *shape: torch.randn(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    projected = randn(rows, PITCH).bfloat16()
+    projected[:, 4 * DIM : 4 * DIM + D] = (randn(rows, D) * 1.5).round().clamp(-3, 3)
+    conv = randn(slots, 3 * DIM, window).bfloat16()  # DS: [slot, dim, window]
+    state = randn(slots, HEADS, D, D) * 0.1
+    return projected, conv, state
+
+
+def _split(attention, projected):
+    n = projected.shape[0]
+    mixed = projected[:, : 3 * DIM]
+    g2 = projected[:, 3 * DIM : 4 * DIM].view(n, HEADS, D)
+    f_a = projected[:, 4 * DIM : 4 * DIM + D]
+    beta = projected[:, 4 * DIM + D : 4 * DIM + D + HEADS].unsqueeze(0)
+    g1 = (f_a @ attention.f_b_proj.weight.t()).view(1, n, HEADS, D)
+    return mixed, g1, g2, beta
+
+
+def _qkv(mixed):
+    return (x.reshape(1, mixed.shape[0], HEADS, D) for x in mixed.split(DIM, dim=-1))
+
+
+def _gated_norm(attention, core, g2):
+    out = rms_norm_gated(
+        core, g2, attention.o_norm.weight, None, "sigmoid", eps=attention.o_norm.eps
+    )
+    return out.reshape(core.shape[1], DIM)
+
+
+def _stock_verify_triton(attention, projected, conv, state, table, accepted, q):
+    """The stock verify on the DS conv layout (kda.py ``_forward``, native)."""
+    n = projected.shape[0]
+    mixed, g1, g2, beta = _split(attention, projected)
+    starts = torch.arange(0, n + 1, q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    weight = attention.conv1d.weight.view(3 * DIM, 4)
+    mixed = causal_conv1d_update(
+        mixed,
+        conv,
+        weight,
+        None,
+        activation="silu",
+        conv_state_indices=table[:, 0],
+        num_accepted_tokens=accepted,
+        query_start_loc=starts,
+        max_query_len=q,
+        validate_data=False,
+        out=torch.empty_like(mixed),
+    )
+    core, _ = fused_recurrent_kda(
+        *_qkv(mixed),
+        raw_g=g1,
+        raw_beta=beta,
+        A_log=attention.A_log,
+        dt_bias=attention.dt_bias,
+        lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+        initial_state=state,
+        cu_seqlens=starts,
+        ssm_state_indices=table,
+        num_accepted_tokens=accepted,
+    )
+    return _gated_norm(attention, core, g2), mixed
+
+
+def _stock_verify_flashinfer(attention, projected, conv, state, table, accepted, q):
+    """The stock verify on the SD conv layout (FlashInfer packed fused decode);
+    ``conv`` is the [slot, dim, window] view of the SD cache."""
+    from vllm.utils.flashinfer import flashinfer_packed_fused_kda_decode
+
+    n = projected.shape[0]
+    mixed, g1, g2, beta = _split(attention, projected)
+    out = torch.empty(1, n, HEADS, D, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=DEVICE)
+    flashinfer_packed_fused_kda_decode(
+        x=mixed,
+        weight=decode_conv_weight(attention.conv1d.weight),
+        conv_state=conv,
+        raw_gate=g1,
+        raw_beta=beta,
+        A_log=attention.A_log,
+        dt_bias=attention.dt_bias,
+        state_indices=table,
+        query_start_loc=torch.arange(0, n + 1, q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE),
+        num_accepted_tokens=accepted,
+        state=state,
+        output_gate=g2,
+        norm_weight=attention.o_norm.weight.float(),
+        lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+        norm_eps=EPS,
+        output=out,
+    )
+    return out.view(n, DIM)
+
+
+def _stock_decode_triton(attention, projected, conv, state, slots):
+    """The stock q = 1 decode next to a speculative config (backend "triton")."""
+    mixed, g1, g2, beta = _split(attention, projected)
+    weight = attention.conv1d.weight.view(3 * DIM, 4)
+    mixed = causal_conv1d_update(
+        mixed,
+        conv,
+        weight,
+        None,
+        activation="silu",
+        conv_state_indices=slots,
+        validate_data=True,
+        out=torch.empty_like(mixed),
+    )
+    core, _ = fused_recurrent_kda_packed_decode(
+        mixed_qkv=mixed,
+        raw_g=g1,
+        raw_beta=beta,
+        A_log=attention.A_log,
+        dt_bias=attention.dt_bias,
+        lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+        initial_state=state,
+        state_indices=slots,
+    )
+    return _gated_norm(attention, core, g2)
+
+
+def _compare(name, ours, stock, states, stock_states):
+    """The fraction of bit-identical output elements, the worst output difference
+    relative to its row's RMS, and the mean written-state error relative to the
+    mean state magnitude."""
+    same = (ours.view(torch.int16) == stock.view(torch.int16)).float().mean().item()
+    ours, stock = ours.float(), stock.float()
+    rms = stock.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True).sqrt()
+    out_err = ((ours - stock).abs() / rms).max().item()
+    state_err = (
+        (states - stock_states).abs().mean() / stock_states.abs().mean()
+    ).item()
+    print(f"{name}: same {same:.5f} out {out_err:.3g} state {state_err:.3g}")
+    return same, out_err, state_err
+
+
+def _assert_stock_precision(same, out_err, state_err):
+    # BF16 Q/K/V and output roundings matched: only FP32 reduction order (and, on
+    # the SD layout, FlashInfer's rearranged recurrence) is left. Without them
+    # about half of the outputs and every state differ (state error ~1e-3).
+    assert same > 0.99
+    assert out_err < 2e-2  # a few BF16 ulps at the row's scale
+    assert state_err < 2e-5
+
+
+def _view(cache, dim_first):
+    """The [slot, dim, window] view the kernels take of a conv cache."""
+    return cache if dim_first else cache.transpose(-1, -2)
+
+
+def _run_verify(attention, projected, conv, state, table, accepted, q, dim_first):
+    """``conv``: the conv cache in the deployment's layout."""
+    requests = table.shape[0]
+    caches = (conv, state)
+    kda = PreparedKda(attention, {(requests, q): (PITCH, 1)}, dim_first)
+    out = torch.empty(requests * q, DIM, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    kda.prepare_caches(caches).run(
+        projected, out, caches=caches, slots=table, accepted=accepted, q=q
+    )
+    return out
+
+

+            "@big mul.f32 b,b,0f3E800000; rcp.approx.ftz.f32 r,b; mul.f32 $0,a,r; }",

+    for name, (a, b) in cases.items():

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""The FP32-state RecoverSSM commit (``KdaCommitF32``, the ``fp32_deferred`` backend
+``KDARecoverSSMCommitContext`` gets under the specialized decode for FP32 checkpoints
+on SM10x) against the stock
+Triton commit it replaces: every layer's final state and, with prefix caching
+(align), the block-boundary state, over random accepted lengths."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not (
+    current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+):
+    pytest.skip("The specialized decode needs SM10x", allow_module_level=True)
+pytest.importorskip("cutlass")
+
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.recoverssm import (  # noqa: E402
+    KDARecoverSSMRecords,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.recoverssm.context import (  # noqa: E402
+    KDADeferredCommitContext,
+)
+
+D, LOWER_BOUND = 128, -5.0
+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+
+
+def _layers(heads, requests, q, slots, seed):
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    randn = lambda *shape: torch.randn(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    layers = []
+    for _ in range(2):
+        records = KDARecoverSSMRecords.allocate(
+            requests, heads, q, D, torch.bfloat16, DEVICE
+        )
+        records.correction.copy_(randn(*records.correction.shape))
+        records.key_gate.copy_(randn(*records.key_gate.shape).bfloat16())
+        conv = randn(slots, 3 * heads * D, q + 2).bfloat16()
+        layers.append(
+            SimpleNamespace(
+                kv_cache=(conv, randn(slots, heads, D, D) * 0.1),
+                recoverssm_records=records,
+                A_log=randn(heads) * 0.5,
+                dt_bias=randn(heads * D) * 0.5,
+                local_num_heads=heads,
+                head_dim=D,
+                gate_lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+            )
+        )
+    return layers
+
+
+def _commit(layers, backend, q, requests, accepted, sources, align):
+    context = KDADeferredCommitContext.create(
+        layers, spec_query_len=q, max_num_reqs=requests, backend="fp32_deferred"
+    )
+    context.backend = backend
+    starts = torch.arange(0, (requests + 1) * q, q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    kwargs = {}
+    if align is not None:
+        table, computed, block = align
+        kwargs = dict(block_table=table, num_computed_tokens=computed)
+        kwargs.update(mamba_block_size=block)
+    context.commit(accepted, sources, starts, **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("align", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads,requests,q", [(12, 9, 5), (96, 3, 8), (12, 4, 2)])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_commit_matches_stock(heads, requests, q, align, monkeypatch):
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.kda import commit
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(commit, "COMMIT_ITEMS", 0)  # at every batch
+    seed = heads + requests + q
+    blocks = 3  # align: each request owns 3 state blocks
+    slots = 1 + requests * blocks
+    layers = _layers(heads, requests, q, slots, seed)
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    accepted = torch.randint(1, q + 1, (requests,), device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    accepted = accepted.int()
+    table = torch.arange(1, slots, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    table = table.view(requests, blocks)
+    sources = table[:, 0].contiguous()
+    spec = None
+    if align:
+        block = 8
+        # Computed tokens just before a block boundary: most windows cross it.
+        computed = torch.randint(1, block, (requests,), device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+        computed = (computed + block - q // 2).int()
+        spec = (table, computed, block)
+    stock = [tuple(t.clone() for t in layer.kv_cache) for layer in layers]
+    ours = [tuple(t.clone() for t in layer.kv_cache) for layer in layers]
+    for caches, backend in ((stock, "triton"), (ours, "fp32_deferred")):
+        run = [
+            SimpleNamespace(**{**vars(layer), "kv_cache": cache})
+            for layer, cache in zip(layers, caches)
+        ]
+        _commit(run, backend, q, requests, accepted, sources, spec)
+    for layer, (stock_conv, stock_state), (conv, state) in zip(layers, stock, ours):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(conv, stock_conv, atol=0, rtol=0)
+        # FP32 rounding of a few products (the shared-key products are hoisted).
+        torch.testing.assert_close(state, stock_state, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5)
+        moved = (stock_state != layer.kv_cache[1]).flatten(1).any(1).sum()
+        assert moved >= requests, moved  # every final slot (and some boundaries)
+
+
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_unbounded_gate_falls_back_to_triton():
+    """The softplus gate (``gate_lower_bound=None``) keeps the stock Triton commit."""
+    layers = _layers(12, 2, 5, 3, seed=0)
+    for layer in layers:
+        layer.gate_lower_bound = None
+    context = KDADeferredCommitContext.create(
+        layers, spec_query_len=5, max_num_reqs=2, backend="fp32_deferred"
+    )
+    assert context.backend == "triton"
+
+
+def test_commit_policy_counts_layers():
+    """The commit folds every KDA layer in one launch: KdaCommitF32 from 384 (head,
+    request, layer) items, i.e. at every batch for a 69-layer rank."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.kda import commit
+
+    assert commit.use_commit_f32(12, 1, 69)
+    assert not commit.use_commit_f32(12, 1, 1)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Deferred RecoverSSM: the fused replay verify (KdaFused) against the stock eager
+pipeline (Triton RecoverSSM commit after sampling, then the stock RecoverSSM verify)
+and an FP64 reference of the recurrence.
+
+KdaFused replays each request's pending accepted tokens from its request-indexed
+records into the checkpoint and verifies the step in chunked form. Expected: the
+checkpoint equals the stock commit's to FP32 rounding, the conv window and the key /
+gate records exactly, the outputs to BF16 rounding, the corrections to FP32
+rounding; the error against FP64 is on par with stock's."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if not (
+    current_platform.is_cuda() and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+):
+    pytest.skip("The specialized decode needs SM10x", allow_module_level=True)
+pytest.importorskip("cutlass")
+
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.mamba.ops.causal_conv1d import (  # noqa: E402
+    causal_conv1d_update,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.recoverssm import (  # noqa: E402
+    KDARecoverSSMCommitContext,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.kda import (  # noqa: E402
+    prepared,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.cutedsl.kda.prepared import (  # noqa: E402
+    PreparedKda,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.recoverssm.context import (  # noqa: E402
+    KDADeferredCommitContext,
+    KDARecoverSSMDeferred,
+    allocate_records,
+)
+from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.specialized_decode.recoverssm.kernels import (  # noqa: E402
+    kda_recoverssm_verify,
+)
+from vllm.third_party.flash_linear_attention.ops.kda import (  # noqa: E402
+    rms_norm_gated,
+)
+
+D, LOWER_BOUND, EPS = 128, -5.0, 1e-5
+DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
+
+
+def _pitch(heads):
+    return -(-(4 * heads * D + D + heads) // 16) * 16
+
+
+def _layer(heads, seed, records, caches):
+    dim = heads * D
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    randn = lambda *shape: torch.randn(*shape, device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        conv1d=SimpleNamespace(weight=randn(3 * dim, 1, 4) * 0.5, bias=None),
+        dt_bias=randn(dim) * 0.5,
+        A_log=randn(heads) * 0.5,
+        f_b_proj=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=(randn(dim, D) * 3).round().clamp(-8, 8).bfloat16() / 64
+        ),
+        o_norm=SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=(torch.rand(D, device=DEVICE, generator=g) + 0.5).bfloat16(),
+            eps=EPS,
+        ),
+        gate_lower_bound=LOWER_BOUND,
+        recoverssm_records=records,
+        recoverssm_backend="triton",
+        kv_cache=caches,
+        local_num_heads=heads,
+        head_dim=D,
+    )
+
+
+def _step_inputs(heads, seed, rows):
+    dim = heads * D
+    g = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    projected = torch.randn(rows, _pitch(heads), device=DEVICE, generator=g)
+    projected = projected.bfloat16()
+    f_a = (torch.randn(rows, D, device=DEVICE, generator=g) * 1.5).round().clamp(-3, 3)
+    projected[:, 4 * dim : 4 * dim + D] = f_a
+    return projected
+
+
+def _stock_verify(layer, heads, projected, caches, table, q, record_indices=None):
+    """The stock RecoverSSM verify (Triton conv, F_B GEMM, Triton verify, gated
+    RMSNorm); returns (output, q, k, v, raw gate, beta) of the step."""
+    dim, n = heads * D, projected.shape[0]
+    conv, state = caches
+    weight = layer.conv1d.weight.view(3 * dim, 4)
+    g2 = projected[:, 3 * dim : 4 * dim].view(1, n, heads, D)
+    f_a = projected[:, 4 * dim : 4 * dim + D]
+    beta = projected[:, 4 * dim + D : 4 * dim + D + heads].unsqueeze(0)
+    g1 = (f_a @ layer.f_b_proj.weight.t()).view(1, n, heads, D)
+    starts = torch.arange(0, n + 1, q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    ones = torch.ones(n // q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    mixed = causal_conv1d_update(
+        projected[:, : 3 * dim], conv, weight, None, activation="silu",
+        conv_state_indices=table, num_accepted_tokens=ones,
+        query_start_loc=starts, max_query_len=q, validate_data=False,
+        out=torch.empty_like(projected[:, : 3 * dim]),
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    qkv = [x.reshape(1, n, heads, D) for x in mixed.split(dim, dim=-1)]
+    core = kda_recoverssm_verify(
+        *qkv, g1, beta, layer.A_log, layer.dt_bias, LOWER_BOUND, state,
+        layer.recoverssm_records, starts, table, q, record_indices=record_indices,
+    )  # fmt: skip
+    out = rms_norm_gated(
+        core, g2, layer.o_norm.weight, None, "sigmoid", eps=layer.o_norm.eps
+    )
+    return out.reshape(n, dim), (*qkv, g1, beta, core)
+
+
+def _reference(layer, state, inputs, q, n_prev, prev):
+    """FP64: the replay of ``n_prev`` accepted tokens of the previous step's
+    operands ``prev`` (normalized keys, decays, corrections) and this step's verify
+    from it; returns (replayed checkpoint, corrections, core outputs)."""
+    qs, ks, vs, g1, beta, _ = inputs
+    heads = state.shape[0]
+    a = layer.A_log.double().exp()
+    dt = layer.dt_bias.double().view(heads, D)
+    s = state.double()
+    if prev is not None:
+        keys, decays, us = prev
+        for t in range(n_prev):
+            s = s * decays[t][:, None, :] + us[t][:, :, None] * keys[t][:, None, :]
+    checkpoint = s.clone()
+    us_new, outs = [], []
+    for t in range(q):
+        qt, kt, vt = (x[t].double() for x in (qs, ks, vs))
+        kt = kt / (kt.pow(2).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6).sqrt()
+        qt = qt / (qt.pow(2).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6).sqrt() * D**-0.5
+        decay = torch.exp(
+            LOWER_BOUND * torch.sigmoid(a[:, None] * (g1[t].double() + dt))
+        )
+        s = s * decay[:, None, :]
+        u = (vt - (s * kt[:, None, :]).sum(-1)) * torch.sigmoid(beta[t].double())[
+            :, None
+        ]
+        s = s + u[:, :, None] * kt[:, None, :]
+        us_new.append(u)
+        outs.append((s * qt[:, None, :]).sum(-1))
+    return checkpoint, torch.stack(us_new), torch.stack(outs)
+
+
+def _record_operands(layer, records, row, heads, n):
+    """FP64 normalized keys, decays and corrections of record slot ``row``."""
+    a = layer.A_log.double().exp()
+    dt = layer.dt_bias.double().view(heads, D)
+    kg = records.key_gate[row].double()
+    keys = kg[:, :n, :D].transpose(0, 1)
+    keys = keys / (keys.pow(2).sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6).sqrt()
+    gates = kg[:, :n, D:].transpose(0, 1)
+    decays = torch.exp(LOWER_BOUND * torch.sigmoid(a[None, :, None] * (gates + dt)))
+    us = records.correction[row].double()[:, :n].transpose(0, 1)
+    return keys, decays, us
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def split(request, monkeypatch):
+    """Force KdaFused's CTAs per item."""
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepared, "FUSED_SPLIT", ((1 << 30, request.param),))
+    prepared.executable.cache_clear()
+    yield request.param
+    prepared.executable.cache_clear()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(params=["ws", "fused", "flush"])
+def path(request, monkeypatch):
+    """Deferred steps through KdaFusedWS or KdaFused (the replay in the verify), or
+    the policy's small-batch path: the deferred commit (flush), then the regular
+    core."""
+    items = 1 << 30 if request.param == "flush" else 0
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepared, "FUSED_ITEMS", items)
+    ws_items = 0 if request.param == "ws" else 1 << 30
+    monkeypatch.setattr(prepared, "FUSED_WS_ITEMS", ws_items)
+    prepared.executable.cache_clear()
+    yield request.param
+    prepared.executable.cache_clear()
+
+
+CASES = [
+    # (heads, requests, q, split)
+    (12, 1, 5, 8),
+    (12, 3, 5, 4),
+    (12, 6, 8, 2),
+    (12, 20, 5, 1),
+    (96, 2, 5, 2),
+    (96, 3, 2, 1),
+    (96, 4, 8, 4),
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("conv_dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "heads,requests,q,split", CASES, indirect=["split"],
+    ids=[f"h{h}-r{r}-q{q}-s{s}" for h, r, q, s in CASES],
+)  # fmt: skip
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_fused_steps_match_stock(heads, requests, q, split, path, conv_dtype):
+    """Three steps of one batch whose rows map to permuted record slots, with
+    pending counts 0 (first step), then random in [1, q] including 1 and q: each
+    fused step against the stock eager commit + verify of the same inputs."""
+    seed = heads + requests + q + split
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=DEVICE).manual_seed(seed)
+    slots = 1 + requests
+    max_reqs = requests + 3
+    dim = heads * D
+    conv = torch.randn(slots, 3 * dim, q + 2, device=DEVICE, generator=gen)
+    conv = conv.bfloat16().to(conv_dtype)
+    state = torch.randn(slots, heads, D, D, device=DEVICE, generator=gen) * 0.1
+    table = torch.arange(1, slots, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    # Record slots: a permutation of request-state slots (as idx_mapping gives).
+    record_rows = torch.randperm(max_reqs, device=DEVICE, generator=gen)[:requests]
+    record_rows = record_rows.to(torch.int32)
+    pending = torch.zeros(max_reqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+
+    ours_records = allocate_records(max_reqs, heads, q, D, torch.bfloat16, DEVICE)
+    stock_records = allocate_records(requests, heads, q, D, torch.bfloat16, DEVICE)
+    ours_caches = (conv.clone(), state.clone())
+    stock_caches = (conv.clone(), state.clone())
+    ours_layer = _layer(heads, seed, ours_records, ours_caches)
+    stock_layer = _layer(heads, seed, stock_records, stock_caches)
+    kda = PreparedKda(ours_layer, {(requests, q): (_pitch(heads), 0)}, True)
+    kda.prepare_caches(ours_caches)
+    assert kda.fused
+    stock_ctx = KDARecoverSSMCommitContext.create(
+        [stock_layer], spec_query_len=q, max_num_reqs=requests, backend="triton"
+    )
+    starts = torch.arange(0, requests * q + 1, q, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    accepted = torch.ones(requests, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
+    ours_ctx = KDADeferredCommitContext.create(
