+# The attention layer's static per-tensor query and KV scales.
+SCALES = SimpleNamespace(_q_scale_float=1.0, _k_scale_float=1.0)
+
+
+def _fp8_query(num_tokens: int, num_heads: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A query as the layer quantizes it for the FlashInfer kernels."""
+    q = torch.randn(num_tokens, num_heads, 576, device="cuda")
+    return q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+
+
+def _real_rows(rep: Replicated, cache_dtype: str):
+    """Write real MLA and indexer rows of every token into ``rep``; returns
+    the new tokens' latents (to write them as forward_impl does)."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer import (
+        indexer_k_norm_quant_insert,
+    )
+
+    seq_lens = [c + n for c, n in rep.lens]
+    slots = torch.from_numpy(
+        np.concatenate(
+            [p * PAGE + np.arange(s) for p, s in zip(_page_start(rep.lens), seq_lens)]
+        )
+    ).cuda()
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    kv_c = torch.randn(len(slots), 512, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    k_pe = torch.randn(len(slots), 64, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+    scale = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(kv_c, k_pe, rep.mla, slots, cache_dtype, scale)
+    norm = torch.ones(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+    # The insert also clears that many top-k rows.
+    scratch = torch.empty(len(slots), TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    indexer_k_norm_quant_insert(
+        torch.randn(len(slots), INDEX_HEAD_DIM, device="cuda").bfloat16(),
+        norm,
+        torch.zeros_like(norm),
+        1e-6,
+        slots,
+        rep.index,
+        scratch,
+        len(slots),
+    )
+    is_new = torch.from_numpy(
+        np.concatenate([np.arange(s) >= c for (c, _), s in zip(rep.lens, seq_lens)])
+    ).cuda()
+    return kv_c[is_new], k_pe[is_new], scale
+
+
+def _separable_decode_keys(rep: Replicated, num_decodes: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Rewrite the indexer keys of the first ``num_decodes`` (one-token)
+    requests of ``rep`` so that their top-k is unique: TOPK random positions
+    get the key +v and the others -v, so a query along v scores TOPK keys
+    positive and the rest zero (after the ReLU), with no tie at the cut-off.
+    Returns the sorted top-k positions, [num_decodes, TOPK]."""
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer import (
+        indexer_k_norm_quant_insert,
+    )
+
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(3)
+    v = _decode_query_direction()
+    expected = []
+    for q, (context, new) in enumerate(rep.lens[:num_decodes]):
+        seq_len = context + new
+        chosen = torch.randperm(seq_len, generator=gen)[:TOPK].cuda()
+        sign = torch.full((seq_len, 1), -1.0, device="cuda")
+        sign[chosen] = 1.0
+        page = int(_page_start(rep.lens)[q])
+        slots = page * PAGE + torch.arange(seq_len, device="cuda")
+        norm = torch.ones(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda")
+        scratch = torch.empty(seq_len, TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+        indexer_k_norm_quant_insert(
+            (sign * v).bfloat16(),
+            norm,
+            torch.zeros_like(norm),
+            1e-6,
+            slots,
+            rep.index,
+            scratch,
+            seq_len,
+        )
+        expected.append(torch.sort(chosen.int()).values)
+    if not expected:
+        return torch.empty((0, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    return torch.stack(expected)
+
+
+def _decode_query_direction() -> torch.Tensor:
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(4)
+    return torch.randn(INDEX_HEAD_DIM, generator=gen).cuda()
+
+
+def _random_topk(lens) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Random causal top-k of every new token (-1 pads short rows) and the
+    request of each new token."""
+    positions = np.concatenate([np.arange(c, c + n) for c, n in lens])
+    req_id = np.repeat(np.arange(len(lens)), [n for _, n in lens])
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(2)
+    topk = torch.full((len(positions), TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    for t, pos in enumerate(positions):
+        valid = min(pos + 1, TOPK)
+        topk[t, :valid] = torch.randperm(pos + 1, generator=gen)[:valid]
+    return topk.cuda(), torch.from_numpy(req_id).to(torch.int32).cuda()
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize(("cache_dtype", "kernel"), KERNEL_CASES)
+def test_attention_over_workspace_matches_replicated_cache(cache_dtype, kernel):
+    """New MLA rows written through the plan's slot mapping complete the
+    workspace; the kernel then attends it bit-identically to the replicated
+    cache, through the same block table."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_utils import (
+        flat_kv_row_view,
+        triton_convert_req_index_to_global_index,
+    )
+
+    lens, world = SCENARIOS["page_tails"], 8
+    rep = Replicated(lens, _layout(cache_dtype), fill_random=False)
+    kv_c, k_pe, scale = _real_rows(rep, cache_dtype)
+    workspaces, plans = _push_all(rep, world, num_dst=1)
+    _, ws_mla, ws_index = workspaces[0]
+    # The step's new tokens, as forward_impl writes them on every rank.
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
+        kv_c, k_pe, ws_mla, plans[0].slot_mapping, cache_dtype, scale
+    )
+    _check_workspace(ws_mla, ws_index, rep, new_mla_rows=True, fill=True)
+
+    topk, req_id = _random_topk(lens)
+    q = _fp8_query(topk.shape[0], NUM_HEADS)
+    impl = _flashinfer_impl(cache_dtype, kernel, 1)
+
+    def attend(cache):
+        _, block_stride_rows = flat_kv_row_view(cache, PAGE)
+        physical_topk, valid_counts = triton_convert_req_index_to_global_index(
+            req_id,
+            plans[0].block_table,
+            topk,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=PAGE,
+            BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS=block_stride_rows,
+            NUM_TOPK_TOKENS=TOPK,
+            return_valid_counts=True,
+        )
+        out, lse = impl._forward_mqa_kernel(
+            q,
+            cache,
+            physical_topk,
+            valid_counts,
+            layer=SCALES,
+            block_size=PAGE,
+            is_decode=False,
+        )
+        assert lse is None
+        return out
+
+    out = attend(ws_mla)
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all()
+    assert torch.equal(out, attend(rep.mla))

+def _distributed_worker(rank, world, init_file, cache_dtype, kernel):
+    """One rank of a DCP = TP group: the production gather, indexer and
+    attention over the gathered context against TP ShardQ over the replicated
+    caches, bit for bit, for two layers through the same workspace."""
+    from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig, set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import (
+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+        init_distributed_environment,
+        initialize_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from vllm.forward_context import create_forward_context, override_forward_context
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.sparse_mla_attention import (
+        SparseMLAShardQ,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import sparse_attn_indexer
+    from vllm.models.kimi_k3.nvidia.ops.dsa_indexer import (
+        indexer_q_quant_fold_weights,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+        DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+        DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillMetadata,
+        build_prefill_chunk_metadata,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq import indexer_rows, make_shardq_split
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", rank)
+    config = VllmConfig()
+    config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size = world
+    config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size = world
+    with set_current_vllm_config(config):
+        init_distributed_environment(
+            world_size=world,
+            rank=rank,
+            local_rank=rank,
+            distributed_init_method=f"file://{init_file}",
+        )
+        initialize_model_parallel(
+            tensor_model_parallel_size=world, decode_context_model_parallel_size=world
+        )
+        init_workspace_manager(device)
+        # Requests within the top-k, so every row selects all its keys: the
+        # top-k kernels break ties between equal scores nondeterministically.
+        lens = [(1000, 300), (513, 64), (0, 700), (1, 63)]
+        layout = _layout(cache_dtype)
+        seq_lens = [c + n for c, n in lens]
+        num_tokens = sum(n for _, n in lens)
+        rep = Replicated(lens, layout, fill_random=False)
+        kv_c, k_pe, scale = _real_rows(rep, cache_dtype)
+        plan = _build_context(lens, layout, world, rank)
+        tp_plan = _build_context(lens, layout, 1, 0)
+
+        torch.manual_seed(4)
+        q_fp8, weights = indexer_q_quant_fold_weights(
+            torch.randn(num_tokens, 32, INDEX_HEAD_DIM, device="cuda").bfloat16(),
+            torch.randn(num_tokens, 32, device="cuda").bfloat16(),
+            INDEX_HEAD_DIM**-0.5 * 32**-0.5,
+            32,
+        )
+        hidden = torch.randn(num_tokens, 256, device="cuda").bfloat16()
+        q = _fp8_query(num_tokens, NUM_HEADS // world)
+        qsl = np.r_[0, np.cumsum([n for _, n in lens])]
+        split = make_shardq_split(qsl, world, rank, device)
+        rows_cpu, rows = indexer_rows(split, 0)
+        req_id = torch.from_numpy(
+            np.repeat(np.arange(len(lens)), np.diff(qsl)).astype(np.int32)
+        ).cuda()
+        seq_lens_cpu = torch.tensor(seq_lens, dtype=torch.int32)
+        topk = torch.full((num_tokens, TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+
+        def dcp_local_chunks(index_table):
+            """The indexer builder's DCP-local chunk of the step, which a DCP
+            ShardQ step replaces."""
+            return [
+                build_prefill_chunk_metadata(
+                    0,
+                    len(lens),
+                    torch.from_numpy(qsl).int().cuda(),
+                    torch.from_numpy(qsl).int(),
+                    seq_lens_cpu.cuda(),
+                    seq_lens_cpu.cuda(),
+                    seq_lens_cpu,
+                    index_table,
+                    1,
+                    dcp_rank=rank,
+                    dcp_world_size=world,
+                )
+            ]
+
+        def run(gathered_context, mla, mla_table, index, index_table, chunks, dcp_size):
+            shardq = SparseMLAShardQ(
+                split, req_id[split.local_idx], 0, rows_cpu, rows, gathered_context
+            )
+            mla_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+                block_size=mla.shape[1],
+                block_table=mla_table,
+                req_id_per_token=req_id,
+                num_decode_tokens=0,
+                num_actual_tokens=num_tokens,
+                cp_kv_cache_interleave_size=1,
+                shardq=shardq,
+            )
+            index_metadata = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata(
+                seq_lens=seq_lens_cpu.cuda(),
+                max_seq_len=max(seq_lens),
+                slot_mapping=torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+                num_decodes=0,
+                num_decode_tokens=0,
+                num_prefills=len(lens),
+                num_prefill_tokens=num_tokens,
+                prefill=DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillMetadata(chunks),
+                block_table=index_table,
+            )
+            config.compilation_config.static_forward_context["mla"] = SimpleNamespace(
+                kv_cache=mla
+            )
+            context = create_forward_context(
+                {"idx": index_metadata, "mla": mla_metadata}, config
+            )
+            with override_forward_context(context):
+                sparse_attn_indexer(
+                    hidden,
+                    "idx",
+                    index,
+                    q_fp8,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    weights,
+                    INDEX_HEAD_DIM,
+                    "ue8m0",
+                    TOPK,
+                    INDEX_HEAD_DIM,
+                    1 << 20,
+                    1 << 20,
+                    topk,
+                    True,
+                    False,
+                    False,
+                    "",
+                    False,
+                    rank,
+                    dcp_size,
+                    1,
+                    shardq_layer_name="mla",
+                )
+            # A canonical order, so that both attentions read the same rows.
+            local_topk = torch.sort(topk[: split.num_local], dim=1).values
+            topk[: split.num_local] = local_topk
+            impl = _flashinfer_impl(cache_dtype, kernel, dcp_size)
+            impl.topk_indices_buffer = topk
+            if gathered_context is not None:
+                # forward_impl's write of the new tokens' MLA rows.
+                ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
+                    kv_c,
+                    k_pe,
+                    gathered_context.mla_view(mla),
+                    gathered_context.slot_mapping,
+                    cache_dtype,
+                    scale,
+                )
+            out = impl.forward_mqa_shardq(q, mla, mla_metadata, SCALES)
+            return local_topk, out.clone()
+
+        try:
+            tp_topk, tp_out = run(
+                None,
+                rep.mla,
+                tp_plan.block_table,
+                rep.index,
+                tp_plan.block_table,
+                tp_plan.indexer_chunks,
+                1,
+            )
+            for layer in range(2):  # The second layer reuses the workspace.
+                shard = _shard(rep, world, rank, seed=rank + 7 * layer)
+                dcp_topk, dcp_out = run(
+                    plan,
+                    shard.mla,
+                    shard.mla_table,
+                    shard.index,
+                    shard.index_table,
+                    dcp_local_chunks(shard.index_table),
+                    world,
+                )
+                _check_workspace(
+                    plan.mla_view(shard.mla),
+                    plan.index_view(shard.index),
+                    rep,
+                    new_mla_rows=True,
+                    fill=False,
+                )
+                assert torch.equal(dcp_topk, tp_topk)
+                assert torch.equal(dcp_out, tp_out)
+        finally:
+            cleanup_dist_env_and_memory()
+

+    tokens."""

+def _common_metadata(lens, block_table, dcp=None):
+    """The step's metadata, with the DCP-local sequence lengths that the runner
+    adds on rank ``dcp[1]`` of a DCP group of ``dcp[0]``."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import get_dcp_local_seq_lens
+
+    new = [n for _, n in lens]
+    qsl = torch.tensor(np.r_[0, np.cumsum(new)], dtype=torch.int32)
+    seq_lens = torch.tensor([c + n for c, n in lens], dtype=torch.int32)
+    num_tokens = int(qsl[-1])
+    local = None if dcp is None else get_dcp_local_seq_lens(seq_lens, *dcp)
+    return CommonAttentionMetadata(
+        query_start_loc=qsl.cuda(),
+        query_start_loc_cpu=qsl,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens.cuda(),
+        num_reqs=len(lens),
+        num_actual_tokens=num_tokens,
+        max_query_len=max(new),
+        max_seq_len=int(seq_lens.max()),
+        block_table_tensor=block_table,
+        # The layer's own cache writes are not under test.
+        slot_mapping=torch.full((num_tokens,), -1, dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda"),
+        seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=seq_lens,
+        dcp_local_seq_lens=None if local is None else local.cuda(),
+        dcp_local_seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=local,
+    )

+def _layer_forward(layer, q, kv_c, k_pe, kv_cache, metadata, q_dcp_replicated=None):
+    out = torch.empty(q.shape[0], q.shape[1] * 128, device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    return layer.forward_impl(
+        q,
+        kv_c,
+        k_pe.unsqueeze(1),
+        kv_cache,
+        metadata,
+        out,

+def _min_topk_recall(topk: torch.Tensor, ref: torch.Tensor) -> float:
+    """The smallest share of a row's ``ref`` keys that ``topk`` selects."""
+    keys = torch.sort(topk, dim=1).values.contiguous()
+    at = torch.searchsorted(keys, ref.contiguous()).clamp(max=keys.shape[1] - 1)
+    found = ((keys.gather(1, at) == ref) & (ref >= 0)).sum(1).float()
+    return float((found / (ref >= 0).sum(1).clamp(min=1)).min())

+def _indexer_topk(
+    indexer, mla_name, config, topk_buffer, inputs, mla_metadata, index_metadata
+):
+    """A DSA layer's indexer: the top-k of a step's rows (of this rank's
+    tokens on a ShardQ step) into the buffer, which the fused prologue clears
+    first."""
+    from vllm.forward_context import create_forward_context, override_forward_context
+
+    hidden, index_q, index_weights = inputs
+    topk_buffer.fill_(-1)
+    context = create_forward_context(
+        {mla_name: mla_metadata, indexer.k_cache.prefix: index_metadata}, config
+    )
+    with override_forward_context(context):
+        indexer.score(hidden, index_q, index_weights, index_k=None)

+def _layer_worker(rank, world, init_file, cache_dtype, kernel):
+    """One rank of a DCP = TP group running a real K3.1 DSA layer.
+
+    The model and its metadata builders register their JIT kernels with a
+    warmup registry, which warms them through the runner's path. The MLA
+    builder then engages DCP ShardQ on prefill steps (1024-token MLA kernel
+    blocks being whole pages), short pieces included. The layer's indexer
+    (the sparse_attn_indexer op, on the indexer builder's metadata) gathers
+    the context and scores this rank's tokens over it, and
+    MLAAttention.forward_impl over the gathered context (with the new tokens'
+    rows it writes there) matches the DCP path it replaces, top-k included,
+    without compiling any kernel; a mixed step's decode rows keep the DCP
+    path. Steps with too few prefill tokens or beyond the workspace keep the
+    DCP path, the builder counts each path, steps without prefill rows are not
+    counted, and a replicated query is ignored. Interleave-64 DCP and
+    disaggregated decode instances keep DCP ShardQ off.
+    """

+    from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode, KVTransferConfig, set_current_vllm_config

+        cleanup_dist_env_and_memory,
+        get_tp_group,
+        init_distributed_environment,

+    from vllm.utils import jit_monitor
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.flashinfer_mla_sparse import (
+        FlashInferMLASparseTRTLLMBackend,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+        DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+    )
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq import context as dcp
+    from vllm.v1.worker.block_table import get_block_table_width
+    from vllm.v1.worker.workspace import init_workspace_manager
+
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    device = torch.device("cuda", rank)
+    max_tokens = max(sum(c + n for c, n in lens) for lens in LAYER_STEPS.values())
+    config = create_vllm_config(
+        model_name=LAYER_MODEL,

+            world_size=world,
+            rank=rank,
+            local_rank=rank,
+            distributed_init_method=f"file://{init_file}",

+            tensor_model_parallel_size=world, decode_context_model_parallel_size=world

+def test_pack_layout_bit_exact():
+    """The B' word layout, bit for bit, from a hand-computed reference."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import (
+        dcp_topk_pack_indices,
+    )
+
+    n = 64
+    width = 140_000
+    scores = torch.tensor(
+        [1.5, -1.5, 0.0, -0.0, float("inf"), float("-inf"), 3.0e-39, -2.0],
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+    )
+    local = torch.tensor([0, 1, 65535, 65536, 70000, 131071, 5, 98304])
+    logits = torch.zeros((1, width), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    logits[0, local] = scores
+    idx = torch.full((1, n), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    idx[0, : len(local)] = local.int()
+    idx[0, 40] = 7  # a candidate after a gap; logits[7] = 0
+    out = torch.full((1, n + n // 32), 123, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    dcp_topk_pack_indices(logits.cuda(), idx.cuda(), out)
+
+    def word(score_bits: int, loc: int) -> int:
+        ordered = (
+            (score_bits | 0x8000) if score_bits < 0x8000 else (~score_bits & 0xFFFF)
+        )
+        return ((ordered << 16) | (0xFFFF - (loc & 0xFFFF))) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+
+    bits = logits.view(torch.int16).int() & 0xFFFF
+    expected = [0] * (n + n // 32)
+    for j, loc in enumerate(idx[0].tolist()):
+        if loc >= 0:
+            expected[j] = word(int(bits[0, loc]), loc)
+            if loc >> 16:
+                expected[n + j // 32] |= 1 << (j % 32)
+    got = [v & 0xFFFFFFFF for v in out[0].tolist()]
+    assert got == expected
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("with_row_ends", [False, True])
+def test_pack_drops_invalid_ids_and_nan(with_row_ends):
+    """Ids outside ``[0, min(row_end, S, 2**17))`` and NaN scores pack as
+    empty slots; +-inf scores pack as ordinary candidates."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import (
+        dcp_topk_pack_indices,
+    )
+
+    n, width, row_end = 64, 140_000, 100_000
+    logits = torch.zeros((1, width), dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    bits = logits.view(torch.int16)
+    bits[0, 1] = 0x7FC0  # +NaN
+    bits[0, 2] = -64  # 0xFFC0, -NaN
+    bits[0, 65535] = -1  # 0xFFFF, -NaN: would pack to the empty word 0
+    bits[0, 3] = 0x7F81  # signaling NaN
+    logits[0, 4] = float("inf")
+    logits[0, 5] = float("-inf")
+    logits[0, 99_999] = 2.0
+    logits[0, 120_000] = 3.0
+    local = [0, 1, 2, 65535, 3, 4, 5, 99_999, 120_000, 131_072, 139_999]
+    local += [width, 1 << 30, 2**31 - 1, -5, -(2**31)]
+    idx = torch.full((1, n), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
+    idx[0, : len(local)] = torch.tensor(local, dtype=torch.int32)
+    out = torch.full((1, n + n // 32), 123, dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    ends = torch.tensor([row_end], dtype=torch.int32, device="cuda")
+    dcp_topk_pack_indices(
+        logits.cuda(), idx.cuda(), out, ends if with_row_ends else None
+    )
+
+    bound = row_end if with_row_ends else 1 << 17
+    u16 = bits.int() & 0xFFFF
+    expected = [0] * (n + n // 32)
+    for j, loc in enumerate(local):
+        if not 0 <= loc < bound or (int(u16[0, loc]) & 0x7FFF) > 0x7F80:
+            continue
+        b = int(u16[0, loc])
+        ordered = (b | 0x8000) if b < 0x8000 else (~b & 0xFFFF)
+        expected[j] = ((ordered << 16) | (0xFFFF - (loc & 0xFFFF))) & 0xFFFFFFFF
+        if loc >> 16:
+            expected[n + j // 32] |= 1 << (j % 32)
+    got = [v & 0xFFFFFFFF for v in out[0].tolist()]
+    assert got == expected
+    # 0, inf, -inf, 99_999; 120_000 only without row_ends.
+    assert sum(1 for w in got[:n] if w) == (4 if with_row_ends else 5)

+    them by max_local_len (which moves DeepSelect off its <= 6-row cluster

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE on FlashInfer's prims_ts sparse MLA kernel (SM100).
+
+Kimi K3.1 DSA shapes: D576, top-k capacity 2048, 96 query heads (DCP8 gathered
+heads; zero-padded to 128 for the 2-CTA schedule on FlashInfer builds that do
+not schedule 96 heads natively), per-tensor fp8 and
+nvfp4_ds_mla caches written by the production cache writer into a packed
+(BLHNC-strided) block layout. Every cache row no live index addresses (page 0,
+the other layers' rows between blocks, unselected rows, rows named by entries
+past a row's length) is NaN, so any stray read fails the comparison.
+"""
+
+import math
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.flashinfer import has_flashinfer_prims_ts_sparse_mla
+
+if not (
+    current_platform.is_cuda()
+    and current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+    and has_flashinfer_prims_ts_sparse_mla()
+):
+    pytest.skip(
+        "needs SM100/SM103 and FlashInfer's prims_ts sparse MLA",
+        allow_module_level=True,
+    )
+
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla import flashinfer_mla_sparse as fims  # noqa: E402
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_utils import (  # noqa: E402
+    triton_filter_and_convert_dcp_index,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import CPTritonContext, correct_attn_out  # noqa: E402
+
+E4M3 = torch.float8_e4m3fn
+KV_LORA_RANK, ROPE = 512, 64
+TOPK = 2048
+BLOCK_SIZE = 64
+# Packed layout: other layers' pages sit between this layer's blocks.
+BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS = 3 * BLOCK_SIZE
+ROW_BYTES = {"fp8": 576, "nvfp4_ds_mla": 352}
+SCALE = 192**-0.5
+# Row capacities as _prims_ts_row_buckets plans them: powers of two (the test
+# shapes below have no CUDA graph sizes among them, so each row count below the
+# largest capacity runs on a larger plan with packed-query offsets).
+BUCKETS = tuple(1 << i for i in range(10))
+_E2M1 = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 6.0]
+
+
+def _impl(kv_cache_dtype: str, return_lse: bool = True, buckets=BUCKETS):
+    impl = object.__new__(fims.FlashInferMLASparseImpl)
+    impl.scale = SCALE
+    impl.kv_lora_rank = KV_LORA_RANK
+    impl.qk_rope_head_dim = ROPE
+    impl.use_prims_ts = True
+    impl.prims_ts_format = fims._PRIMS_TS_FORMATS[kv_cache_dtype]
+    impl.need_to_return_lse_for_decode = return_lse
+    impl.prims_ts_buckets = buckets
+    return impl
+
+
+def _cache(kv_cache_dtype: str, num_blocks: int, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[num_blocks, BLOCK_SIZE, row bytes] uint8 view of a NaN-filled packed
+    buffer whose blocks are BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS rows apart."""
+    raw = torch.full(
+        (num_blocks, BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS, ROW_BYTES[kv_cache_dtype]),
+        0xFF,
+        dtype=torch.uint8,
+        device=device,
+    )
+    return raw[:, :BLOCK_SIZE]
+
+
+def _write(cache, kv_cache_dtype, kv_c, k_pe, slots, k_scale):
+    """Production writer: token i into block slots[i] // BLOCK_SIZE, offset
+    slots[i] % BLOCK_SIZE."""
+    ops.concat_and_cache_mla(
+        kv_c,
+        k_pe,
+        cache,
+        slots.long(),
+        kv_cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype,
+        scale=torch.tensor(k_scale, dtype=torch.float32, device=kv_c.device),
+    )
+
+
+def _dequant_rows(cache, kv_cache_dtype, k_scale) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """fp32 [rows, 576] of every storage row (flat, packed stride), as the
+    kernel loads them: per-tensor e4m3 times the descale, or NVFP4 NoPE
+    expanded to e4m3(e2m1 * sf) (FlashInfer's loader) and unscaled e4m3 RoPE."""
+    rows, _ = fims.flat_kv_row_view(cache, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8":
+        return rows.view(E4M3).float() * k_scale
+    table = torch.tensor(
+        _E2M1 + [-v for v in _E2M1], dtype=torch.float32, device=rows.device
+    )
+    packed = rows[:, :256]
+    nibbles = torch.stack([packed & 0xF, packed >> 4], -1).flatten(-2).long()
+    sf = rows[:, 320:352].unflatten(-1, (4, 8)).transpose(-1, -2).flatten(-2)
+    sf = sf.contiguous().view(E4M3).float()
+    nope = (table[nibbles].unflatten(-1, (32, 16)) * sf[..., None]).flatten(-2)
+    nope = nope.to(E4M3).float()
+    rope = rows[:, 256:320].contiguous().view(E4M3).float()
+    return torch.cat([nope, rope], -1)
+
+
+def _quant_q(q: torch.Tensor, q_scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The layer's static per-tensor E4M3 query quantization."""
+    t, h, d = q.shape
+    q8, _ = ops.scaled_fp8_quant(
+        q.reshape(t, h * d),
+        torch.tensor([q_scale], dtype=torch.float32, device=q.device),
+    )
+    return q8.view(t, h, d)
+
+
+def _reference(q8, q_scale, kv, indices, lengths):
+    """fp32 sparse attention; natural-log LSE; empty rows -> (0, -inf)."""
+    t, h, _ = q8.shape
+    out = torch.zeros(t, h, KV_LORA_RANK, device=q8.device)
+    lse = torch.full((t, h), -math.inf, device=q8.device)
+    q = q8.float() * q_scale
+    for i in range(t):
+        sel = indices[i, : lengths[i]]
+        sel = sel[sel >= 0].long()
+        if sel.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        k = kv[sel]
+        s = q[i] @ k.T * SCALE
+        lse[i] = torch.logsumexp(s, -1)
+        out[i] = torch.softmax(s, -1) @ k[:, :KV_LORA_RANK]
+    return out, lse
+
+
+def _check(out, lse, ref_out, ref_lse, kv_cache_dtype):
+    assert out.dtype == torch.bfloat16 and lse.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert torch.isfinite(out).all(), "NaN/inf output: a masked row was read"
+    empty = torch.isinf(ref_lse)
+    assert torch.equal(torch.isinf(lse), empty)
+    assert (lse[empty] < 0).all() and (out[empty.nonzero(as_tuple=True)] == 0).all()
+    live = ~empty
+    if live.any():
+        o, r = out.float()[live], ref_out[live]
+        rel = ((o - r).norm() / r.norm()).item()
+        # E4M3 P (and the e4m3 Q/KV the reference already models).
+        assert rel < (2e-2 if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8" else 3e-2), rel
+        assert (lse[live] - ref_lse[live]).abs().max().item() < 2e-2
+
+
+def _problem(
+    kv_cache_dtype, counts, heads, k_scale, q_scale, seed, *, holes=False, blocks=None
+):
+    """Rows of local physical indices (compacted prefix, or with -1 holes
+    inside the prefix when ``holes``) over live packed rows; entries past each
+    row's length name poisoned rows."""
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(seed)
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    num_blocks = blocks or 1 + math.ceil(max(max(counts), 1) * 2 / BLOCK_SIZE) + 4
+    cache = _cache(kv_cache_dtype, num_blocks, dev)
+    # Live tokens: every slot of blocks 1.. (page 0 stays poisoned).
+    live_slots = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, num_blocks * BLOCK_SIZE, device=dev)
+    phys = (live_slots // BLOCK_SIZE) * BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS + live_slots % BLOCK_SIZE
+    t = len(counts)
+    indices = torch.empty((t, TOPK), dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    lengths = torch.tensor(counts, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    used = torch.zeros(phys.numel(), dtype=torch.bool, device=dev)
+    for i, c in enumerate(counts):
+        perm = torch.randperm(phys.numel(), generator=g, device=dev)
+        row = phys[perm[:c]].to(torch.int32)
+        if holes and c > 2:
+            row[torch.randperm(c, generator=g, device=dev)[: c // 4]] = -1
+        used[perm[:c]] |= row >= 0
+        # Past the length: poisoned rows (page 0 and inter-block rows).
+        tail = torch.randint(0, BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS, (TOPK - c,), generator=g, device=dev)
+        tail = torch.where(tail < BLOCK_SIZE, tail, tail % 7 + BLOCK_SIZE)
+        indices[i] = torch.cat([row, tail.to(torch.int32)])
+    # Write only the selected tokens; every other row stays NaN.
+    kv_c = torch.randn(phys.numel(), KV_LORA_RANK, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.2
+    k_pe = torch.randn(phys.numel(), ROPE, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.5
+    sel = used.nonzero().squeeze(1)
+    _write(
+        cache,
+        kv_cache_dtype,
+        kv_c[sel].bfloat16(),
+        k_pe[sel].bfloat16(),
+        live_slots[sel],
+        k_scale,
+    )
+    q = torch.randn(t, heads, KV_LORA_RANK + ROPE, generator=g, device=dev)
+    q8 = _quant_q(q.bfloat16() * 4, q_scale)
+    return cache, q8, indices, lengths
+
+
+COUNTS = {
+    # DCP8 local: about 1/8 of 2048, not multiples of 128, some empty.
+    "dcp_local": [0, 1, 37, 128, 129, 251, 256, 300, 0, 255, 383, 512],
+    "decode_b1": [251],
+    "full": [2048, 2047, 1, 0, 1000],
+}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["fp8", "nvfp4_ds_mla"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads", [96, 128, 16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case", list(COUNTS))
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("holes", [False, True])
+def test_prims_ts_matches_reference(kv_cache_dtype, heads, case, holes):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    k_scale = 0.5 if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8" else 1.0
+    q_scale = 2.0
+    cache, q8, indices, lengths = _problem(
+        kv_cache_dtype, COUNTS[case], heads, k_scale, q_scale, 1, holes=holes
+    )
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(_q_scale_float=q_scale, _k_scale_float=k_scale)
+    impl = _impl(kv_cache_dtype)
+    out, lse = impl._forward_prims_ts(q8, cache, indices, lengths, layer, BLOCK_SIZE)
+    kv = _dequant_rows(cache, kv_cache_dtype, k_scale)
+    ref_out, ref_lse = _reference(q8, q_scale, kv, indices, lengths)
+    _check(out, lse, ref_out, ref_lse, kv_cache_dtype)
+    # 96 heads ran natively, or zero-padded to the 128-head (2-CTA) plan on
+    # FlashInfer builds without native scheduling of that head count.
+    planned = {key[2] for key in fims._prims_ts_plans._plans}
+    assert impl._prims_ts_query_heads(heads) in planned
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["fp8", "nvfp4_ds_mla"])

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kv_cache_dtype", ["fp8", "nvfp4_ds_mla"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("interleave", [1, 64])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("q_len", [1, 5])
+def test_prims_ts_dcp8_merge(kv_cache_dtype, interleave, q_len):
+    """DCP8: each rank attends its shard of the global top-k (converted and
+    compacted by the production DCP index kernel) with the gathered 96 heads;
+    the LSE-weighted merge (natural log) must equal attention over the whole
+    top-k. Short rows leave ranks without entries (count 0)."""
+    dcp, heads, k_scale = 8, 96, 0.5 if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8" else 1.0
+    dev = torch.device("cuda")
+    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7)
+    seq_lens = [5000, 6, 700, 9000]
+    num_reqs = len(seq_lens)
+    tokens = num_reqs * q_len
+    # Global per-request top-k (logical token ids), -1 padded.
+    topk = torch.full((tokens, TOPK), -1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dev)
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        n_ctx = seq_lens[t // q_len] - (q_len - 1 - t % q_len)
+        c = min(TOPK, n_ctx)
+        topk[t, :c] = torch.randperm(n_ctx, generator=g, device=dev)[:c].int()
+    req_id = torch.arange(num_reqs, device=dev, dtype=torch.int32).repeat_interleave(
+        q_len
+    )
+    kv_c = torch.randn(sum(seq_lens), KV_LORA_RANK, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.2
+    k_pe = torch.randn(sum(seq_lens), ROPE, generator=g, device=dev) * 0.5
+    starts = [0]
+    for s in seq_lens:
+        starts.append(starts[-1] + s)
+    q8 = _quant_q(
+        torch.randn(tokens, heads, 576, generator=g, device=dev).bfloat16() * 4, 1.0
+    )
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(_q_scale_float=1.0, _k_scale_float=k_scale)
+    impl = _impl(kv_cache_dtype)
+
+    outs, lses, ref_kv = [], [], torch.empty(sum(seq_lens), 576, device=dev)
+    for rank in range(dcp):
+        # This rank's local cache: block b of request r at physical block
+        # 1 + r * blocks_per_req + b (page 0 unused).
+        local_lens = [
+            int(((torch.arange(s) // interleave) % dcp == rank).sum()) for s in seq_lens
+        ]
+        blocks_per_req = max(math.ceil(n / BLOCK_SIZE) for n in local_lens) + 1
+        cache = _cache(kv_cache_dtype, 1 + num_reqs * blocks_per_req, dev)
+        block_table = torch.tensor(
+            [
+                [1 + r * blocks_per_req + b for b in range(blocks_per_req)]
+                for r in range(num_reqs)
+            ],
+            dtype=torch.int32,
+            device=dev,
+        )
+        for r, s in enumerate(seq_lens):
+            pos = torch.arange(s, device=dev)
+            own = pos[(pos // interleave) % dcp == rank]
+            local = (own // (interleave * dcp)) * interleave + own % interleave
+            slots = block_table[r, local // BLOCK_SIZE].long() * BLOCK_SIZE + (
+                local % BLOCK_SIZE
+            )
+            if own.numel():
+                _write(
+                    cache,
+                    kv_cache_dtype,
+                    kv_c[starts[r] + own].bfloat16(),
+                    k_pe[starts[r] + own].bfloat16(),
+                    slots,
+                    k_scale,
+                )
+                rows = _dequant_rows(cache, kv_cache_dtype, k_scale)
+                phys = (slots // BLOCK_SIZE) * BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS + slots % BLOCK_SIZE
+                ref_kv[starts[r] + own] = rows[phys]
+        indices, counts = triton_filter_and_convert_dcp_index(
+            req_id,
+            block_table,
+            topk,
+            dcp_size=dcp,
+            dcp_rank=rank,
+            cp_kv_cache_interleave_size=interleave,
+            BLOCK_SIZE=BLOCK_SIZE,
+            BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS=BLOCK_STRIDE_ROWS,
+            NUM_TOPK_TOKENS=TOPK,
+            return_valid_counts=True,
+        )
+        out, lse = impl._forward_prims_ts(q8, cache, indices, counts, layer, BLOCK_SIZE)
+        outs.append(out)
+        lses.append(lse)
+    assert any((lse == -math.inf).all(-1).any() for lse in lses), "no empty rank row"
+    stacked = torch.stack(lses)
+    merged = sum(
+        correct_attn_out(o.clone(), stacked, r, CPTritonContext(), True)[0].float()
+        for r, o in enumerate(outs)
+    )
+    flat = topk.clone()
+    for t in range(tokens):
+        sel = flat[t] >= 0
+        flat[t, sel] += starts[t // q_len]
+    lengths = (flat >= 0).sum(-1).int()
+    flat = torch.sort(flat, dim=-1, descending=True).values
+    ref_out, _ = _reference(q8, 1.0, ref_kv, flat, lengths)
+    rel = ((merged - ref_out).norm() / ref_out.norm()).item()
+    assert rel < (2e-2 if kv_cache_dtype == "fp8" else 3e-2), rel

+def _f_pad_query_heads(query, heads):
+    """The zero head pad as the trtllm-gen call did it before (``F.pad``)."""
+    return torch.nn.functional.pad(query, (0, 0, 0, heads - query.shape[1]))

+def _masked_fill_dcp_partials(topk):
+    """trtllm-gen's empty-row guard before: an ``all(topk == -1)`` reduction,
+    then full ``masked_fill``s of the output and LSE views."""
+
+    def finish(out, lse, counts):
+        empty = (topk == -1).all(dim=-1)
+        out.masked_fill_(empty.view(-1, 1, 1), 0.0)
+        lse.masked_fill_(empty.view(-1, 1), float("-inf"))
+
+    return finish

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("world", [2, 4, 8])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lens", [[4096], [65, 300, 7000], [1000, 64, 64, 129]])
+def test_fold_split_partitions_tokens(world, lens):
+    qsl = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(lens)]
+    per_rank = fold_split(qsl, world)
+    merged = np.sort(np.concatenate(per_rank))
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(merged, np.arange(qsl[-1]))
+    for idx in per_rank:
+        assert np.all(np.diff(idx) > 0)
+    # Each rank takes one early and one late piece of every request, so its
+    # summed causal positions stay within a couple of tokens per request of
+    # the mean.
+    positions = [
+        sum(int((idx[(idx >= a) & (idx < b)] - a).sum()) for a, b in zip(qsl, qsl[1:]))
+        for idx in per_rank
+    ]
+    assert max(positions) - min(positions) <= sum(4 * n for n in lens)
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_decode_tokens", [0, 1, 37])
+def test_indexer_rows_cover_decodes_then_local_prefill(num_decode_tokens):
+    """Mixed steps: every rank scores the decode rows in place, then its own
+    prefill tokens compactly; across ranks each prefill row is scored once."""
+    world, lens = 4, [700, 64, 3001]
+    qsl = np.r_[0, np.cumsum(lens)]
+    num_prefill = int(qsl[-1])
+    prefill_rows = []
+    for rank in range(world):
+        split = make_shardq_split(qsl, world, rank, torch.device("cpu"))
+        host, rows = indexer_rows(split, num_decode_tokens)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(host, rows.numpy())
+        assert np.all(np.diff(host) > 0)
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+            host[:num_decode_tokens], np.arange(num_decode_tokens)
+        )
+        # Row p of the buffer holds the p-th scored row: this rank's prefill
+        # tokens follow the decode rows in the order the attention reads them.
+        np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+            host[num_decode_tokens:] - num_decode_tokens, split.local_idx_cpu
+        )
+        prefill_rows.append(host[num_decode_tokens:])
+    np.testing.assert_array_equal(
+        np.sort(np.concatenate(prefill_rows)),
+        np.arange(num_decode_tokens, num_decode_tokens + num_prefill),
+    )
+

+def _round_trip(rank, world, port, use_sm, q_dtype, num_leading_rows, pad):
+    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
+    torch.accelerator.set_device_index(rank)
+    dist.init_process_group("nccl", rank=rank, world_size=world)
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    lens = [700, 64, 3001]
+    heads, dim = 4, 576
+    full = torch.randn(sum(lens), world * heads, dim, device="cuda").to(q_dtype)
+    split = make_shardq_split(
+        np.r_[0, np.cumsum(lens)], world, rank, torch.device("cuda")
+    )
+    local_heads = full[:, rank * heads : (rank + 1) * heads].contiguous()
+    group = dist.group.WORLD
+    for _ in range(2):  # The second pass reuses the symmetric buffers.
+        sharded = shard_q(
+            local_heads,
+            split,
+            group,
+            use_sm=use_sm,
+            padded_heads=world * heads + pad if pad else None,
+        )
+        assert sharded.shape[1] == world * heads + pad
+        # Bitwise, as the exchanges only move bytes (and fp8 lacks torch.equal).
+        expected = full[split.local_idx]
+        received = sharded.view(torch.uint8)
+        assert torch.equal(received[:, : world * heads], expected.view(torch.uint8))
+        assert not received[:, world * heads :].any()
+        sharded = sharded[:, : world * heads]
+        # Attention outputs are a head-padded slice; unshard reads its strides.
+        padded = torch.zeros(sharded.shape[0], world * heads + 8, 512, device="cuda")
+        padded[:, : world * heads] = sharded[..., :512].float()
+        out = padded.bfloat16()[:, : world * heads]
+        restored = unshard_out(
+            out, split, group, use_sm=use_sm, num_leading_rows=num_leading_rows
+        )
+        assert restored.shape[0] == num_leading_rows + sum(lens)
+        assert torch.equal(
+            restored[num_leading_rows:], local_heads[..., :512].bfloat16()
+        )
+    dist.destroy_process_group()
+

+@pytest.mark.skipif(torch.accelerator.device_count() < 2, reason="needs 2 GPUs")
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("q_dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float8_e4m3fn])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("use_sm", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_leading_rows", [0, 33])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("pad", [0, 8])
+def test_shard_q_round_trip(use_sm, q_dtype, num_leading_rows, pad):
+    world = 2
+    mp.spawn(
+        _round_trip,
+        args=(world, get_open_port(), use_sm, q_dtype, num_leading_rows, pad),
+        nprocs=world,
+    )

+def _gdn_page(q, k, v, ssm, rank: int, tp: int) -> bytes:
+    """One rank's DS-layout GDN page: [Q | K | V] conv rows, then temporal."""
+
+    def shard(x):
+        n = x.shape[0] // tp
+        return x[rank * n : (rank + 1) * n]
+
+    conv = torch.cat([shard(q), shard(k), shard(v)])
+    return conv.numpy().tobytes() + shard(ssm).numpy().tobytes()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("p_tp", "d_tp"), [(8, 4), (4, 8), (2, 1), (1, 2), (8, 2), (4, 4)]
+)
+def test_mamba_hetero_tp_segments_reassemble_gdn_shards(p_tp: int, d_tp: int):
+    gen = torch.Generator().manual_seed(0)
+    rows, key_dim, value_dim, heads = 3, 16, 32, 8
+
+    def rand(*shape):
+        return torch.randint(-1000, 1000, shape, generator=gen).to(torch.float16)
+
+    q, k, v = rand(key_dim, rows), rand(key_dim, rows), rand(value_dim, rows)
+    ssm = rand(heads, 4, 4)
+    p_pages = [_gdn_page(q, k, v, ssm, rank, p_tp) for rank in range(p_tp)]
+    row_bytes = rows * 2
+    conv_proj_bytes = (
+        key_dim // p_tp * row_bytes,
+        key_dim // p_tp * row_bytes,
+        value_dim // p_tp * row_bytes,
+    )
+    ssm_bytes = heads // p_tp * 4 * 4 * 2
+
+    for d_rank in range(d_tp):
+        if p_tp >= d_tp:
+            ratio = p_tp // d_tp
+            p_ranks = range(d_rank * ratio, (d_rank + 1) * ratio)
+        else:
+            p_ranks = [d_rank // (d_tp // p_tp)]
+        expected = _gdn_page(q, k, v, ssm, d_rank, d_tp)
+        page = bytearray(len(expected))
+        for p_rank in p_ranks:
+            for src, dst, length in _mamba_hetero_tp_segments(
+                conv_proj_bytes, ssm_bytes, p_rank, p_tp, d_rank, d_tp
+            ):
+                page[dst : dst + length] = p_pages[p_rank][src : src + length]
+        assert bytes(page) == expected

+"""ROCm DCP candidates ordered by descending FP32 score, then ascending token id."""

+import math

+import torch

+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import (
+    dcp_global_to_local_index,
+    dcp_local_to_global_index,
+    get_dcp_local_seq_lens,

+FP8_DTYPE = current_platform.fp8_dtype()
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_candidates_kernel(
+    logits,
+    indices,
+    row_starts,
+    output,
+    rank,
+    rows: tl.constexpr,
+    k: tl.constexpr,
+    width: tl.constexpr,
+    logits_stride0: tl.constexpr,
+    logits_stride1: tl.constexpr,
+    indices_stride0: tl.constexpr,
+    indices_stride1: tl.constexpr,
+    starts_stride: tl.constexpr,
+    world_size: tl.constexpr,
+    interleave: tl.constexpr,
+    has_offsets: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    offsets = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    row, col = offsets // k, offsets % k
+    mask = row < rows
+    local = tl.load(
+        indices + row * indices_stride0 + col * indices_stride1,
+        mask=mask,
+        other=-1,
+    ).to(tl.int64)
+    column = local
+    if has_offsets:
+        column += tl.load(row_starts + row * starts_stride, mask=mask, other=0)
+    valid = mask & (local >= 0) & (column >= 0) & (column < width)
+    score = tl.load(
+        logits + row * logits_stride0 + column * logits_stride1,
+        mask=valid,
+        other=float("nan"),
+    )
+    valid &= tl.abs(score) < float("inf")
+    bits = score.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True).to(tl.int64)
+    bits = tl.where((bits & 0x7FFFFFFF) == 0, 0, bits)
+    ordered = tl.where(bits < 0, ~bits, bits ^ 0x80000000) - 0x80000000
+    global_ids = dcp_local_to_global_index(local, rank, world_size, interleave)
+    packed = (ordered << 32) | (0xFFFFFFFF - global_ids)
+    tl.store(output + offsets, tl.where(valid, packed, -9223372036854775808), mask)
+
+
+def pack_dcp_candidates(
+    logits: torch.Tensor,
+    indices: torch.Tensor,
+    rank: int,
+    world_size: int,
+    interleave: int,
+    row_starts: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Pack each local candidate into one sortable int64 collective element."""
+    assert logits.dtype == torch.float32 and indices.dtype == torch.int32
+    assert 0 <= rank < world_size and interleave > 0
+    invalid = torch.iinfo(torch.int64).min
+    if logits.shape[1] == 0:
+        return torch.full_like(indices, invalid, dtype=torch.int64)
+    output = torch.empty(indices.shape, dtype=torch.int64, device=indices.device)
+    if output.numel() == 0:
+        return output
+    _pack_candidates_kernel[(triton.cdiv(output.numel(), 256),)](
+        logits,
+        indices,
+        row_starts if row_starts is not None else logits,
+        output,
+        rank,
+        *indices.shape,
+        logits.shape[1],
+        *logits.stride(),
+        *indices.stride(),
+        row_starts.stride(0) if row_starts is not None else 0,
+        world_size,
+        interleave,
+        row_starts is not None,
+        BLOCK=256,
+    )
+    return output
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _decode_selected_candidates(
+    Keys,
+    Output,
+    Width: tl.constexpr,
+    Count: tl.constexpr,
+    KS: tl.constexpr,
+    OS: tl.constexpr,
+    OCOL: tl.constexpr,
+    B: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * B + tl.arange(0, B)
+    keys = tl.load(Keys + row * KS + col, col < Count, other=-9223372036854775808)
+    ids = 0xFFFFFFFF - (keys & 0xFFFFFFFF)
+    ids = tl.where(keys != -9223372036854775808, ids, -1)
+    tl.store(Output + row * OS + col * OCOL, ids, col < Width)
+
+
+def select_dcp_candidates(gathered: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Select global candidates without floating-point conversion of token ids.
+
+    The selected set follows the packed (score, token id) order, but the ids are
+    written in no particular order within a row.
+    """
+    if not out.numel():
+        return
+    count = min(out.shape[1], gathered.shape[1])
+    if count == 0:
+        out.fill_(-1)
+        return
+    keys = gathered.topk(count, dim=-1, sorted=False).values
+    _decode_selected_candidates[(out.shape[0], triton.cdiv(out.shape[1], 256))](
+        keys,
+        out,
+        out.shape[1],
+        count,
+        keys.stride(0),
+        out.stride(0),
+        out.stride(1),
+        B=256,
+    )
+

+# --- Global-key prefill: all-gather every rank's index keys for one chunk ----
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_local_keys(
+    Cache,
+    Table,
+    Cu,
+    Packed,
+    cache_page_bytes,
+    table_stride,
+    PAGE: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+    TILE: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Copy this rank's index keys out of the cache into one row per token.
+
+    A cache page holds ``PAGE`` value rows of ``HEAD_DIM`` bytes followed by
+    ``PAGE`` four-byte scales, the layout
+    ``cp_gather_indexer_k_quant_cache_triton`` reads. Values and scale travel
+    together so the all-gather below moves one buffer instead of two.
+    """
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = tl.program_id(1) * 16 + tl.arange(0, 16)
+    begin = tl.load(Cu + req)
+    length = tl.load(Cu + req + 1) - begin
+    page = tl.load(Table + req * table_stride + row // PAGE, row < length, 0).to(
+        tl.int64
+    )
+    slot = row % PAGE
+    byte = tl.arange(0, TILE)
+    offset = tl.where(
+        byte[None, :] < HEAD_DIM,
+        slot[:, None] * HEAD_DIM + byte[None, :],
+        PAGE * HEAD_DIM + slot[:, None] * 4 + byte[None, :] - HEAD_DIM,
+    )
+    mask = (row[:, None] < length) & (byte[None, :] < WIDTH)
+    value = tl.load(Cache + page[:, None] * cache_page_bytes + offset, mask, 0)
+    tl.store(
+        Packed + (begin + row[:, None]).to(tl.int64) * WIDTH + byte[None, :],
+        value,
+        mask,
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["Total", "MaxLocal"])
+def _restore_global_keys(
+    Packed,
+    TokenToSeq,
+    GlobalCu,
+    AllLocalCu,
+    Keys,
+    Scales,
+    Total,
+    MaxLocal,
+    World: tl.constexpr,
+    Interleave: tl.constexpr,
+    HEAD_DIM: tl.constexpr,
+    WIDTH: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Undo the DCP interleave: rank-major gathered rows to token order."""
+    token = tl.program_id(0) * 16 + tl.arange(0, 16)
+    req = tl.load(TokenToSeq + token, token < Total, 0)
+    pos = token - tl.load(GlobalCu + req)
+    owner, local = dcp_global_to_local_index(pos, World, Interleave)
+    local += tl.load(AllLocalCu + req * World + owner)
+    source = owner.to(tl.int64) * MaxLocal + local
+    byte = tl.arange(0, HEAD_DIM)
+    value = tl.load(
+        Packed + source[:, None] * WIDTH + byte[None, :], token[:, None] < Total, 0
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        Keys + token[:, None].to(tl.int64) * HEAD_DIM + byte[None, :],
+        value,
+        token[:, None] < Total,
+    )
+    b = tl.arange(0, 4)
+    scale = tl.load(
+        Packed + source[:, None] * WIDTH + HEAD_DIM + b[None, :],
+        token[:, None] < Total,
+        0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        Scales + token[:, None].to(tl.int64) * 4 + b[None, :],
+        scale,
+        token[:, None] < Total,
+    )
+
+
+def gather_global_indexer_keys(
+    kv_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    chunk,
+    dcp_world_size: int,
+    cp_interleave: int,
+    head_dim: int,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Every rank's index keys for one prefill chunk, in global token order.
+
+    Returns ``(keys, scales)`` of shape ``[chunk.total_seq_lens, head_dim]``
+    and ``[chunk.total_seq_lens]``: the whole context of every request in the
+    chunk, so a row scored against them needs no candidate merge afterwards.
+    """
+    from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+
+    width = head_dim + 4
+    page = kv_cache.shape[1]
+    assert kv_cache.shape[2] == width, (
+        f"indexer cache row is {kv_cache.shape[2]} bytes, expected {width}"
+    )
+    device = kv_cache.device
+    seq_lens = chunk.cu_seq_lens[1:] - chunk.cu_seq_lens[:-1]
+    counts = get_dcp_local_seq_lens(seq_lens, dcp_world_size, None, cp_interleave)
+    all_cu = torch.cat(
+        (counts.new_zeros((1, dcp_world_size)), counts.cumsum(0, dtype=torch.int32))
+    )
+    # The per-rank row count is the stride into the gathered buffer, so both
+    # the allocation and the restore below must use the same (padded) value.
+    rows = chunk.max_local_total_seq_lens
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_DSA_DCP_PAD_KEY_GATHER:
+        # AITER's IPC all-gather only takes a payload whose byte count is a
+        # multiple of 16. Rounding the rows up buys that for any width.
+        align = 16 // math.gcd(width, 16)
+        rows = triton.cdiv(rows, align) * align
+    packed = torch.empty((rows, width), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+    local_width = (
+        triton.cdiv(chunk.max_seqlen_k, dcp_world_size * cp_interleave) * cp_interleave
+    )
+    _pack_local_keys[chunk.num_reqs, max(1, triton.cdiv(local_width, 16))](
+        kv_cache.view(torch.uint8),
+        chunk.block_table,
+        chunk.local_cu_seq_lens,
+        packed,
+        kv_cache.stride(0) * kv_cache.element_size(),
+        chunk.block_table.stride(0),
+        PAGE=page,
+        HEAD_DIM=head_dim,
+        WIDTH=width,
+        TILE=triton.next_power_of_2(width),
+    )
+    gathered = get_dcp_group().all_gather(packed, dim=0)
+    total = chunk.total_seq_lens
+    keys = torch.empty((total, head_dim), dtype=FP8_DTYPE, device=device)
+    scales = torch.empty((total,), dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    _restore_global_keys[(triton.cdiv(total, 16),)](
+        gathered,
+        chunk.token_to_seq,
+        chunk.cu_seq_lens,
+        all_cu,
+        keys.view(torch.uint8),
+        scales.view(torch.uint8),
+        total,
+        rows,
+        World=dcp_world_size,
+        Interleave=cp_interleave,
+        HEAD_DIM=head_dim,
+        WIDTH=width,
+    )
+    return keys, scales

+def _aiter_gemm_m_buckets(max_m: int) -> list[int]:
+    """One token count per AITER tuned-GEMM bucket up to ``max_m``.
+
+    AITER pads M to 1, 2, 4 or 8 below 16, then to multiples of 16 / 32 / 64 /
+    128 up to 256 / 1024 / 4096 / beyond, and builds each bucket's kernel on
+    first use.
+    """
+    buckets = [m for m in (1, 2, 4, 8) if m <= max_m]
+    for step, upper in ((16, 256), (32, 1024), (64, 4096), (128, max_m)):
+        start = (buckets[-1] // step + 1) * step if buckets else step
+        buckets.extend(range(start, min(upper, max_m) + 1, step))
+    if max_m > 0 and buckets[-1] != max_m:
+        buckets.append(max_m)
+    return buckets
+

+    sizes = sorted(

+            m

+        len(sizes),
+        time.perf_counter() - start,
+    )

+"""Kimi K3.1 DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) for the kimi_k3 stack on ROCm.
+
+Ports ``nvidia/dsa.py``: the indexer runs through
+``SparseAttnIndexer.forward_hip`` (the DeepSeek V3.2 ROCm pattern) and the
+sparse MLA layers are served by ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE over the fp8_ds_mla

+@triton.jit
+def _index_weights_kernel(
+    values,
+    scales,
+    output,
+    value_stride,
+    weight_scale,
+    softmax_scale,
+    NUM_HEADS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    head = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    value = tl.load(values + row * value_stride + head, head < NUM_HEADS, 0)
+    # Preserve the projection dtype's rounding before the FP32 scale products.
+    value = (value.to(tl.float32) * weight_scale).to(values.dtype.element_ty)
+    scale = tl.load(scales + row * NUM_HEADS + head, head < NUM_HEADS, 0)
+    weight = value.to(tl.float32) * scale * softmax_scale
+    tl.store(output + row * NUM_HEADS + head, weight, head < NUM_HEADS)
+
+
+def yarn_get_mscale(scale: float = 1, mscale: float = 1) -> float:
+    if scale <= 1:
+        return 1.0
+    return 0.1 * mscale * math.log(scale) + 1.0
+
+
+class KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Bias-full fp32 LayerNorm for the DSA indexer shared key.
+
+    weight/bias load and stay in fp32; a copy in the activation dtype is cached
+    so the fp32 round trip does not cost two casts per call. F.layer_norm still
+    accumulates in fp32 for a bf16 input, so the only numeric change is that
+    weight/bias multiply in the activation dtype.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.normalized_shape = (dim,)
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(dim, dtype=torch.float32))
+
+        # Not persistent: derived from weight/bias rather than loaded from a
+        # checkpoint, so state_dict() keeps exporting fp32.
+        self.weight_bf16: torch.Tensor | None
+        self.bias_bf16: torch.Tensor | None
+        self.register_buffer("weight_bf16", None, persistent=False)
+        self.register_buffer("bias_bf16", None, persistent=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        weight, bias = self.weight_bf16, self.bias_bf16
+        if weight is None or weight.dtype != x.dtype:
+            weight = self.weight.to(x.dtype)
+            bias = self.bias.to(x.dtype)
+            # nn.Module.__setattr__ is expensive, and mutating a buffer during
+            # tracing would bake this branch into the captured graph.
+            if not torch.compiler.is_compiling():
+                self.weight_bf16, self.bias_bf16 = weight, bias
+        return F.layer_norm(x, self.normalized_shape, weight, bias, self.eps)

+def _fp4_indexer(
+    q: torch.Tensor,
+    k: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    cache: torch.Tensor,
+    out: torch.Tensor,
+    prefix: str,
+    max_model_len: int,
+    dcp_rank: int = 0,
+    dcp_world_size: int = 1,
+    interleave: int = 1,
+    weight_scale: float = 1.0,

+        from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+        from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+            get_max_prefill_buffer_size,
+        )
+
+        config = get_current_vllm_config()

+            prefill_workspace_bytes(
+                get_max_prefill_buffer_size(config),
+                config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs,
+                dcp_world_size,
+                interleave,
+            ),
+            device=q.device,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+        )

+            q,
+            weights,
+            cache,
+            out,
+            m.prefill,
+            dcp_world_size,
+            interleave,

+            decode.query_start_loc is not None
+            and not decode.requires_padding
+            and decode.seq_lens.numel() == m.num_decode_tokens

+            starts = decode.query_start_loc
+            ends = decode.seq_lens.reshape(-1)
+        else:
+            starts, ends = decode_layout(
+                m.seq_lens,
+                decode.per_req_decode_lens,
+                m.num_decode_tokens,
+                dcp_rank,
+                dcp_world_size,
+                interleave,

+                cache,
+                weights[start:end].float() * weight_scale,
+                block_table[: starts.numel() - 1],

+            )

+                _select(logits, row_ends, selected, score_rows[start:end])
+            else:

+class KimiK3DSAIndexer(nn.Module):
+    """wq/wk/wv indexer projections with FP8 or MXFP4 scoring on ROCm.
+
+    Forward quantizes the indexer query, folds the scales into the per-head
+    weights and drives ``torch.ops.vllm.rocm_aiter_sparse_attn_indexer`` via
+    ``SparseAttnIndexer.forward_hip`` with ``cache_layout="NORMAL"``: the
+    indexer pages are block-flat, which the Triton insert wrapper cannot infer
+    from the cache shape alone. MXFP4 uses group scales and dedicated FlyDSL
+    scoring with the same global token-index output contract.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        index_q_input_size: int,
+        index_head_dim: int,
+        index_num_heads: int,
+        index_topk: int,
+        rms_norm_eps: float,
+        index_k_norm_type: str = "rmsnorm",
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.index_head_dim = index_head_dim
+        self.index_num_heads = index_num_heads
+        self.indexer_weight_scale = self.index_num_heads**-0.5
+        self.use_fp4 = v32_indexer.dsa_indexer_uses_fp4(vllm_config)
+        if self.use_fp4 and (
+            index_head_dim != 128 or index_num_heads not in (16, 32, 64)
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Kimi MXFP4 requires head_dim=128 and 16/32/64 heads")
+        self.cp_interleave = vllm_config.parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+        # MLAModules contract: MultiHeadLatentAttention asserts the indexer
+        # exposes topk_tokens.
+        self.topk_tokens = index_topk
+        self.wq_index = ReplicatedLinear(
+            index_q_input_size,
+            self.index_num_heads * self.index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.wq_index",
+        )
+        # The indexer query projection (wq_index) may be quantized in fp8
+        # checkpoints, while the shared-key (wk_index) and per-head weights
+        # (wv_index) projections are stored in bf16.
+        self.wk_index = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.wk_index",
+        )
+        self.wv_index = ReplicatedLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            self.index_num_heads,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.wv_index",
+        )
+        self.k_index_norm: nn.Module
+        if index_k_norm_type == "layernorm":
+            self.k_index_norm = KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm(
+                self.index_head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps
+            )
+        elif index_k_norm_type == "rmsnorm":
+            self.k_index_norm = RMSNorm(self.index_head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"dsa_config.index_k_norm_type must be 'rmsnorm' or "
+                f"'layernorm', got {index_k_norm_type!r}"
+            )
+
+        # Index cache scales use ue8m0 (power-of-2 rounding at write), the
+        # convention of upstream DeepSeek V3.2; the scoring kernels read the
+        # scales as full fp32, which is exact for power-of-2 values.
+        self.scale_fmt = "ue8m0"
+        self.quant_block_size = self.index_head_dim
+        self.index_softmax_scale = self.index_head_dim**-0.5
+        # FP8: 128 values + one FP32 scale. MXFP4: 64 packed value bytes
+        # + four UE8M0 group scales. Both formats add four scale bytes.
+        self.k_cache = KimiK3IndexerCache(
+            head_dim=(self.index_head_dim // 2 if self.use_fp4 else self.index_head_dim)
+            + 4,
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.k_cache",
+            cache_config=cast(CacheConfig, cache_config),
+        )
+        self.max_model_len = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+        self.max_total_seq_len = v32_indexer.get_max_prefill_buffer_size(vllm_config)
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer
+        self.dcp_scores = None
+        if vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size > 1:
+            assert topk_indices_buffer is not None
+            spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+            rows = max(
+                vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+                * (1 + (spec.num_speculative_tokens if spec else 0)),
+                vllm_config.compilation_config.max_cudagraph_capture_size or 0,
+            )
+            self.dcp_scores = torch.empty(
+                (rows, self.topk_tokens),
+                dtype=torch.float32,
+                device=topk_indices_buffer.device,
+            )
+        self.indexer_op = (
+            None
+            if self.use_fp4
+            else SparseAttnIndexer(
+                self.k_cache,
+                self.quant_block_size,
+                self.scale_fmt,
+                self.topk_tokens,
+                self.index_head_dim,
+                self.max_model_len,
+                self.max_total_seq_len,
+                topk_indices_buffer,
+                cache_layout="NORMAL",
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _quantize_index_q_and_weights(
+        self,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """FP8-quantize the indexer query and fold scales into the weights.
+
+        Fold the query, head-count and softmax scales into FP32 weights,
+        preserving the projection dtype's intermediate rounding.
+        """
+        q_flat = index_q.reshape(-1, self.index_head_dim).contiguous()
+        q_fp8, q_scale = per_token_group_quant_fp8(
+            q_flat,
+            self.quant_block_size,
+            column_major_scales=False,
+            use_ue8m0=True,
+        )
+        q_fp8 = q_fp8.view(index_q.shape)
+        weights = torch.empty(
+            (index_q.shape[0], self.index_num_heads),
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device=index_q.device,
+        )
+        if index_q.shape[0]:
+            _index_weights_kernel[(index_q.shape[0],)](
+                index_weights,
+                q_scale,
+                weights,
+                index_weights.stride(0),
+                self.indexer_weight_scale,
+                self.index_softmax_scale,
+                NUM_HEADS=self.index_num_heads,
+                BLOCK=triton.next_power_of_2(self.index_num_heads),
+            )
+        return q_fp8, weights
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q_input: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        rotary_emb: nn.Module | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if index_q_input is None:
+            # q_lora_rank is None: MultiHeadLatentAttention.forward_native
+            # passes q_c=None, so the indexer query reads hidden_states.
+            index_q_input = hidden_states
+        index_q = self.wq_index(index_q_input)[0].view(
+            -1, self.index_num_heads, self.index_head_dim
+        )
+        index_k = self.k_index_norm(self.wk_index(hidden_states)[0])
+        index_v = self.wv_index(hidden_states)[0]
+        if self.use_fp4:
+            dcp = get_dcp_group()
+            torch.ops.vllm.kimi_fp4_indexer(
+                index_q,
+                index_k,
+                index_v,
+                self.k_cache.kv_cache,
+                self.topk_indices_buffer,
+                self.k_cache.prefix,
+                self.max_model_len,
+                dcp.rank_in_group,
+                dcp.world_size,
+                self.cp_interleave,
+                self.indexer_weight_scale * self.index_softmax_scale,
+                self.dcp_scores,
+            )
+            return self.topk_indices_buffer
+        q_fp8, weights = self._quantize_index_q_and_weights(index_q, index_v)
+        # Under a dummy run kv_cache is an empty placeholder and the op takes
+        # its workspace-reservation path.
+        indexer_op = self.indexer_op
+        assert indexer_op is not None
+        if self.dcp_scores is not None:
+            torch.ops.vllm.kimi_dcp_score_indexer(
+                hidden_states,
+                q_fp8,
+                index_k,
+                weights,
+                self.k_cache.kv_cache,
+                self.topk_indices_buffer,
+                self.dcp_scores,
+                self.k_cache.prefix,
+                self.max_model_len,
+                self.max_total_seq_len,
+                indexer_op.dcp_rank,
+                indexer_op.dcp_world_size,
+                indexer_op._parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size,
+            )
+            return self.topk_indices_buffer
+        return indexer_op.forward_hip(hidden_states, q_fp8, index_k, weights)
+
+
+class KimiK3DSAAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Kimi K3.1 DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) inference path on ROCm.
+
+    Same MLA projections as the dense Kimi-K3 MLA path, plus the DSA indexer
+    wired through ``MLAModules(is_sparse=True)`` so the ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE
+    backend consumes the top-k indices.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: KimiLinearConfig,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        qk_nope_head_dim: int,
+        qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+        v_head_dim: int,
+        q_lora_rank: int | None,
+        kv_lora_rank: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        reduce_results: bool = True,
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if config.dsa_config is None:
+            raise ValueError("dsa_config is required for KimiK3DSAAttention")
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+        if parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Kimi-K3.1 DSA on ROCm does not support prefill context parallelism."
+            )
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.qk_nope_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim
+        self.qk_rope_head_dim = qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.qk_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.v_head_dim = v_head_dim
+
+        self.q_lora_rank = q_lora_rank
+        self.kv_lora_rank = kv_lora_rank
+
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        if num_heads % tp_size > 0:
+            num_padded_heads = (num_heads + tp_size - 1) // tp_size * tp_size
+            logger.warning_once(
+                f"DSA num_heads {num_heads} is not divisible by tp_size "
+                f"{tp_size}, will pad to {num_padded_heads} heads"
+            )
+            self.num_heads = num_padded_heads
+        self.num_local_heads = self.num_heads // tp_size
+
+        self.scaling = self.qk_head_dim**-0.5
+
+        if self.q_lora_rank is not None:
+            self.fused_qkv_a_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                [self.q_lora_rank, self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim],
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.fused_qkv_a_proj",
+                disable_tp=True,
+            )
+            self.q_a_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.q_lora_rank, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+            self.q_b_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.q_lora_rank,
+                self.num_heads * self.qk_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.q_b_proj",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa = ReplicatedLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.kv_a_proj_with_mqa",
+            )
+            self.q_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.num_heads * self.qk_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.q_proj",
+            )
+        self.kv_a_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.kv_lora_rank, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.kv_b_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            self.kv_lora_rank,
+            self.num_heads * (self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim),
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.kv_b_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.num_heads * self.v_head_dim,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",

+        # building this class; re-assert for direct construction.

+                "Kimi-K3.1 DSA on ROCm is NoPE-only (requires mla_use_nope)"
+            )

+        # attention softmax, independent of rotary application); nvidia/dsa.py
+        # applies it identically.
+        rope_parameters: dict = dict(getattr(config, "rope_parameters", None) or {})

+            rope_parameters

+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.v_head_dim * self.num_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.g_proj",
+            )

+        dsa_config = config.dsa_config
+        self.index_topk = dsa_config.index_topk
+        self.index_head_dim = dsa_config.index_head_dim
+        self.index_num_heads = dsa_config.index_num_heads
+        if dsa_config.index_rope_dim != 0:
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Kimi-K3.1 DSA on ROCm requires index_rope_dim == 0 "
+                f"(got {dsa_config.index_rope_dim}); the index_rope path is not "
+                "ported yet."
+            )
+
+        if topk_indices_buffer is None:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "KimiK3DSAAttention requires the model-level "
+                "topk_indices_buffer created by KimiLinearModel"
+            )
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer
+
+        # Kimi-K3.1 has no index-share mechanism: every DSA layer builds
+        # its own indexer; fail loudly on configs that ask for it.
+        if getattr(dsa_config, "index_topk_freq", 1) not in (None, 1):
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Kimi-K3.1 DSA does not support index_topk_freq != 1 "
+                f"(index share), got {dsa_config.index_topk_freq}."
+            )
+
+        index_q_input_size = (
+            self.q_lora_rank if self.q_lora_rank is not None else self.hidden_size
+        )
+        self.dsa_indexer = KimiK3DSAIndexer(
+            vllm_config=vllm_config,
+            hidden_size=self.hidden_size,
+            index_q_input_size=index_q_input_size,
+            index_head_dim=self.index_head_dim,
+            index_num_heads=self.index_num_heads,
+            index_topk=self.index_topk,
+            rms_norm_eps=config.rms_norm_eps,
+            index_k_norm_type=dsa_config.index_k_norm_type,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            topk_indices_buffer=self.topk_indices_buffer,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.dsa_indexer",
+        )
+
+        # The fp8_ds_mla normalization happens at config-verification time
+        # (see the KimiK3 verifier in vllm/model_executor/models/config.py):
+        # the runner resolves kv_cache_dtype from cache_config.cache_dtype
+        # before the model is built; changing it inside the model would make
+        # the spec dtype (bf16) inconsistent with the fp8_ds_mla page size.
+
+        mla_modules = MLAModules(
+            kv_a_layernorm=self.kv_a_layernorm,
+            kv_b_proj=self.kv_b_proj,
+            rotary_emb=self.rotary_emb,
+            o_proj=self.o_proj,
+            fused_qkv_a_proj=self.fused_qkv_a_proj
+            if self.q_lora_rank is not None
+            else None,
+            kv_a_proj_with_mqa=self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa
