+    """Vals * inv -> fp8 words (hi), and the residual * 32 as fp8 words (lo,
+    whose E8M0 scale is the hi one minus 5)."""
+    x = [fx.Float32(v) * inv for v in vals]
+    hi = [_pack_fp8x4(x[4 * i : 4 * i + 4]) for i in range(len(x) // 4)]
+    lo = []
+    for i in range(len(hi)):
+        dec = _unpack_fp8x4(hi[i])
+        lo.append(_pack_fp8x4([(x[4 * i + j] - dec[j]) * 32.0 for j in range(4)]))
+    return hi, lo
+
+
+def _lo_scale(s):
+    s = fx.Int32(s) - 5
+    return (s < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), s)
+
+
+def _swap_pair(fn, x):
+    st = llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32, T.i32])
+    v = _raw(fx.Float32(x).bitcast(fx.Int32).ir_value())
+    r = fn(st, v, v, False, False)
+    a = fx.Int32(llvm.ExtractValueOp(T.i32, r, [0]).res).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    b = fx.Int32(llvm.ExtractValueOp(T.i32, r, [1]).res).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return fx.Float32(a), fx.Float32(b)
+
+
+def _fmax(a, b):
+    return fx.maxnumf(a, b, fastmath="nnan")
+
+
+def _xsum(x):
+    """Sum over the 4 lane groups (xor 16, 32) via permlane swaps."""
+    a, b = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane16_swap, x)
+    a, b = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane32_swap, a + b)
+    return a + b
+
+
+def _xmax(x):
+    """Max over the 4 lane groups (xor 16, 32) via permlane swaps."""
+    a, b = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane16_swap, x)
+    a, b = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane32_swap, _fmax(a, b))
+    return _fmax(a, b)
+
+
+def _imax(a, b):
+    return (a > b).select(a, b)
+
+
+def _imin(a, b):
+    return (a < b).select(a, b)
+
+
+def _readfirstlane(v):
+    return fx.Int32(rocdl.readfirstlane(T.i32, _raw(fx.Int32(v))))
+
+
+def _e8m0_for(amax):
+    """E8M0 byte s with amax / 2^(s - 127) in [128, 256), and f32 2^(127 - s)."""
+    e = (fx.Float32(amax).bitcast(fx.Int32) >> 23) & 0xFF
+    s = e - 7
+    s = (s < 1).select(fx.Int32(1), s)
+    inv = ((254 - s) << 23).bitcast(fx.Float32)
+    return s, fx.Float32(inv)
+
+
+def _p_store_f16(pl, svs, p_wr, poff, p_wave_bytes):
+    for wp in range_constexpr(4):
+        pv = [
+            pl[4 * s + r] * fx.Float32(svs[s][wp][r])
+            for s in range(2)
+            for r in range(4)
+        ]
+        hv = Vec.from_elements(pv, fx.Float32).to(fx.Float16).bitcast(fx.Int32)
+        _lds_store(hv, T.i32, p_wr + poff(wp * p_wave_bytes), 16)
+
+
+def _pv_operands(p_rd, num_heads):
+    # kk = 2hf + sub; P block (w_src = g // 2 + 2hf, g_src = 2(g % 2) + sub)
+    return [
+        _lds_load(
+            T.i32, 4, p_rd + ((kk // 2) * 8 * num_heads + (kk % 2) * num_heads) * 16, 16
+        )
+        for kk in range(4)
+    ]
+
+
+def _pv_mfma(d0, v_a, pp, o):
+    """O^T[d0 .. d0 + 3] += V^T P'^T for 4 output column chunks, in place."""
+    for i in range_constexpr(4):
+        for kk in range_constexpr(4):
+            o[d0 + i] = _mfma_f16(_cvt_v8(v_a[i][kk]), pp[kk], o[d0 + i])
+
+
+def _q_prologue(q_t, q_row, g, h_ok):
+    """Quantize this lane's q row to fp8 hi/lo MFMA operands.
+
+    MFMA scale group kb (lanes 16kb.. supply its E8M0) is K bytes
+    32kb..32kb + 31, so lane d's bytes 0-15 belong to group d // 2 and bytes
+    16-31 to group 2 + d // 2. Lane g therefore holds, for MFMA j, chunk
+    2j + g % 2 of record block g // 2 (first 16 B) and of block 2 + g // 2
+    (second 16 B), and supplies the scale of block g.
+
+    Returns (q8 hi operands, hi E8M0, q8 lo operands, lo E8M0).
+    """
+    va, vb = [], []
+    for j in range(4):
+        c = 2 * j + g % 2
+        for hb, dst in ((0, va), (2, vb)):
+            d0 = (hb + g // 2) * 128 + c * 16  # bf16 dims
+            for k in range(2):
+                v = Vec(q_t.load(q_row + d0 // 2 + k * 4, vec_size=4))
+                dst.append(
+                    [fx.Float32(x) for x in Vec(v.bitcast(fx.BFloat16)).to(fx.Float32)]
+                )
+    va = [h_ok.select(x, fx.Float32(0.0)) for blk in va for x in blk]
+    vb = [h_ok.select(x, fx.Float32(0.0)) for blk in vb for x in blk]
+    am = []
+    for vv in (va, vb):
+        a = fx.Float32(0.0)
+        for x in vv:
+            a = _fmax(a, _fmax(x, fx.Float32(0.0) - x))
+        p0, p1 = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane16_swap, a)
+        am.append(_fmax(p0, p1))  # amax of block g // 2 (va) / 2 + g // 2 (vb)
+    oth = []
+    for a in am:
+        p0, p1 = _swap_pair(rocdl.permlane32_swap, a)
+        oth.append((g >= 2).select(p0, p1))  # value of lane g ^ 2
+    lo_half = g < 2
+    blk = [
+        lo_half.select(am[0], oth[0]),
+        lo_half.select(oth[0], am[0]),
+        lo_half.select(am[1], oth[1]),
+        lo_half.select(oth[1], am[1]),
+    ]
+    mine = (g == 0).select(
+        blk[0], (g == 1).select(blk[1], (g == 2).select(blk[2], blk[3]))
+    )
+    _, inva = _e8m0_for(am[0])
+    _, invb = _e8m0_for(am[1])
+    q8, q8l = [], []
+    for j in range(4):
+        ha, la = _quant(va[16 * j : 16 * j + 16], inva)
+        hb, lb = _quant(vb[16 * j : 16 * j + 16], invb)
+        q8.append(Vec.from_elements(ha + hb, fx.Int32))
+        q8l.append(Vec.from_elements(la + lb, fx.Int32))
+    qs, _ = _e8m0_for(mine)
+    return q8, qs, q8l, _lo_scale(qs)
+
+
+class _BoundedI32(GTensor):
+    """GTensor whose buffer descriptor carries the real byte size, so an
+    out-of-range read returns 0 instead of touching memory past the end."""
+
+    def __init__(self, memref, nbytes):
+        super().__init__(memref, dtype=T.i32, shape=(-1,))
+        self.nbytes = nbytes
+
+    def _view(self, elem, unit_elems):
+        return ptr_buf_tensor(
+            self.base_i64,
+            elem,
+            unit_elems=unit_elems,
+            unit_stride=1,
+            num_records_bytes=fx.Int64(self.nbytes),
+        )
+
+
+def _guarded(pred, fn):
+    """Run fn() under a runtime predicate (an scf.if around its body)."""
+
+    @flyc.jit
+    def _do(_pred=pred, _fn=fn):
+        if _pred:
+            _fn()
+
+    _do()
+
+
+def build_sparse_mla_fp8ds_module(num_heads, has_invalid, return_lse):
+    """JIT launcher for one (heads, has_invalid, return_lse) configuration.
+
+    The latent tile lives in LDS as 4 column blocks (bytes 128b..128b + 128 of
+    the record), filled directly by global_load ... lds (DMA) from 64-bit
+    per-lane row addresses. Wave w streams
+    the next tile's column block w right after its own PV tr8 reads; only
+    wave w reads block w in PV.
+    """
+    H = num_heads
+    if not 1 <= H <= MAX_HEADS:
+        raise ValueError(f"num_heads must be in [1, {MAX_HEADS}], got {H}")
+    lds_bytes = _P_OFF + 4 * 16 * H * 16
+    p_wave_bytes = 16 * H * 16  # P bytes per destination wave w'
+    name = f"sparse_mla_fp8ds_gfx950_h{H}_i{int(has_invalid)}_l{int(return_lse)}_flydsl"
+
+    @fx.struct
+    class Smem:
+        raw: fx.Array[fx.Uint8, lds_bytes, 16]
+
+    @flyc.kernel(name=name, known_block_size=[_BLOCK_THREADS, 1, 1])
+    def sparse_mla_fp8ds_kernel(
+        Q: fx.Tensor,
+        KV: fx.Tensor,
+        IDX: fx.Tensor,
+        IPTR: fx.Tensor,
+        OUT: fx.Tensor,
+        LSE: fx.Tensor,
+        stride_q: fx.Int32,
+        stride_qh: fx.Int32,
+        stride_o: fx.Int32,
+        stride_oh: fx.Int32,
+        c_log2: fx.Float32,
+        n_q: fx.Int32,
+        idx_bytes: fx.Int32,
+    ):
+        tid = fx.Int32(fx.thread_idx.x)
+        w = _readfirstlane(tid // 64)
+        lane = tid % 64
+        t = lane % 16  # QK: token row; S/O: head
+        g = lane // 16
+        qi = fx.Int32(n_q - 1) - fx.Int32(fx.block_idx.x)  # long rows first
+
+        q_t = GTensor(Q, dtype=T.i32, shape=(-1,))
+        kv_base = buf_base_i64(KV)  # i64: the cache may span more than 4 GiB
+        idx_t = _BoundedI32(IDX, idx_bytes)
+        ip_t = GTensor(IPTR, dtype=T.i32, shape=(-1,))
+        o_t = GTensor(OUT, dtype=T.i32, shape=(-1,))
+        lse_t = GTensor(LSE, dtype=T.i32, shape=(-1,))
+        lds = fx.SharedAllocator().allocate(Smem).peek()
+        base = _readfirstlane(fx.ptrtoint(lds.raw.ptr))
+
+        # ---- this row's CSR slice (wave-uniform)
+        r_beg = _readfirstlane(ip_t[qi])
+        r_end = _readfirstlane(ip_t[qi + 1])
+        r_len = r_end - r_beg
+        r_len = (r_len < 0).select(fx.Int32(0), r_len)
+
+        # ---- Q prologue: lane (h = t, g) holds all 128 dims of block g as fp8 hi/lo
+        h_ok = t < H
+        h_safe = h_ok.select(t, fx.Int32(0))
+        q_row = (qi * stride_q + h_safe * stride_qh) // 2  # i32 units (bf16 pairs)
+        q8, qs, q8l, qsl = _q_prologue(q_t, q_row, g, h_ok)
+        qr = [
+            Vec(q_t.load(q_row + (_L + 32 * i) // 2 + g * 4, vec_size=4))
+            for i in range_constexpr(2)
+        ]
+
+        # ---- tile count. has_invalid: tiles past the last entry >= 0 are
+        # skipped (the scan loop runs 0 times otherwise); -1 entries before it
+        # are masked as usual.
+        n_scan = ((r_len + 255) // 256) if has_invalid else fx.Int32(0)
+        zero = _raw(fx.Int32(0).ir_value())
+        for sc_c, sc_st in range(0, n_scan, 1, init=[zero, zero]):
+            lastp = fx.Int32(sc_st[0])
+            p0 = fx.Int32(sc_c) * 256 + lane * 4
+            v = Vec(idx_t.load(r_beg + p0, vec_size=4))
+            for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                pj = p0 + j
+                lastp = (pj < r_len).select(
+                    (fx.Int32(v[j]) >= 0).select(pj + 1, lastp), lastp
+                )
+            sc_fin = yield [lastp, fx.Int32(sc_st[1])]
+        lastp = fx.Int32(sc_fin[0]) if has_invalid else r_len
+        for sh in (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32):
+            o_ = fx.Int32(lastp).shuffle_xor(sh, 64)
+            lastp = (o_ > lastp).select(o_, lastp)
+        nt = _readfirstlane((lastp + (_TILE - 1)) // _TILE)
+
+        # Latent tile in LDS: 4 column blocks (bytes 128b..+128 of the record),
+        # each [128 tokens][8 x 16 B] row-major with the 16-B chunk
+        # XOR-swizzled by fsw(tok).
+        def fsw(tok):
+            return ((tok >> 1) & 7) ^ (((tok >> 4) & 1) << 1)
+
+        k_rdb = []
+        for s in range_constexpr(2):
+            tok = w * 32 + 16 * s + t
+            k_rdb.append(
+                base + _V_OFF + (g // 2) * 16384 + tok * 128 + ((g % 2) ^ fsw(tok)) * 16
+            )
+        # PV tr8 read: lane (t, g) row i = t // 2 ->
+        # token 32(g // 2 + 2hf) + 16(i // 4) + 4(2(g % 2) + sub) + i % 4,
+        # chunk dc of block w (addr ^ 16dc), byte half t % 2.
+        v_rd = []
+        for sub in range_constexpr(2):
+            i = t // 2
+            tok = (g // 2) * 32 + (i // 4) * 16 + ((g % 2) * 2 + sub) * 4 + i % 4
+            v_rd.append(
+                base + _V_OFF + w * 16384 + tok * 128 + fsw(tok) * 16 + (t % 2) * 8
+            )
+        # DMA: load j fills tokens 8j..8j + 7 of block w;
+        # lane -> token 8j + lane // 8, chunk (lane % 8) ^ f.
+        dma_c = [
+            w * 128
+            + ((lane % 8) ^ (4 * (jj & 1) + lane // 16) ^ (2 * ((jj >> 1) & 1))) * 16
+            for jj in range_constexpr(4)
+        ]
+        dma_src = [((8 * j + lane // 8) & 63) * 4 for j in range(8)]
+
+        ks_wr = base + _KS_OFF + ((w * 4 + g) * 32 + t) * 4
+        ks_rd = base + _KS_OFF + (w * 4 * 32 + 4 * g) * 4
+        mx_wr = base + _MX_OFF + (t * 4 + w) * 4
+        mx_rd = base + _MX_OFF + t * 16
+        sink = base + _SINK_OFF
+        h_rd = h_ok.select(t, fx.Int32(H - 1))
+        p_wr = h_ok.select(base + _P_OFF + ((w * 4 + g) * H + t) * 16, sink)
+        p_rd = (
+            base
+            + _P_OFF
+            + w * p_wave_bytes
+            + (((g // 2) * 4 + 2 * (g % 2)) * H + h_rd) * 16
+        )
+
+        def poff(c):
+            return h_ok.select(fx.Int32(c), fx.Int32(0))
+
+        def ld_idx(p):
+            """Slot of row position p; -1 past the row end (and for -1 entries)."""
+            ix = fx.Int32(idx_t[r_beg + p])
+            return (p < r_len).select(ix, fx.Int32(-1))
+
+        def ld_q_idx(tb):
+            return [ld_idx(w * 32 + t + tb + 16 * s) for s in range(2)]
+
+        def ld_d_idx(tb):
+            return [ld_idx(lane + 64 * hh + tb) for hh in range(2)]
+
+        def ld_side(ixs):
+            """Per-subtile pow2 scale (1 i32) and rope (2 x 4 i32) for the QK rows."""
+            out = []
+            for s in range_constexpr(2):
+                ix = fx.Int32(ixs[s])
+                row = (
+                    kv_base + fx.Int64((ix >= 0).select(ix, fx.Int32(0))) * RECORD_BYTES
+                )
+                out.append(
+                    Vec.from_elements(
+                        [_global_i32(row + fx.Int64(_L + g * 4), 1)], fx.Int32
+                    )
+                )
+                for i in range_constexpr(2):
+                    out.append(
+                        _global_i32(row + fx.Int64(_L + 16 + 64 * i + g * 16), 4)
+                    )
+            return out
+
+        def dma(ixd):
+            ixs = [(fx.Int32(ix) >= 0).select(fx.Int32(ix), fx.Int32(0)) for ix in ixd]
+            for j in range_constexpr(16):
+                # The slot id is what gets permuted; its byte offset needs 64 bits.
+                ix = fx.Int32(
+                    rocdl.ds_bpermute(T.i32, _raw(dma_src[j % 8]), _raw(ixs[j // 8]))
+                )
+                src = _global_llvm_ptr(
+                    kv_base + fx.Int64(ix) * RECORD_BYTES + fx.Int64(dma_c[j % 4])
+                )
+                dst = _lds_llvm_ptr(base + w * 16384 + (_V_OFF + j * 1024))
+                rocdl.global_load_lds(src, dst, 16, 0)
+
+        def nxt(tb, k):
+            return (tb < (nt - k) * _TILE).select(tb + k * _TILE, tb)
+
+        # Prologue: tile 0 latent via DMA, tile 0 side data, indices of tile 1.
+        t1 = (nt > 1).select(fx.Int32(_TILE), fx.Int32(0))
+        ixq0 = ld_q_idx(fx.Int32(0))
+        ixd0 = ld_d_idx(fx.Int32(0))
+        dma(ixd0)
+        side0 = ld_side(ixq0)
+        ixq1 = ld_q_idx(t1)
+        ixd1 = ld_d_idx(t1)
+
+        neg_inf = fx.Float32(-1.0e30)
+        init = [_raw(neg_inf.ir_value()), _raw(fx.Float32(0.0).ir_value())]
+        init += [_raw(Vec.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32).ir_value()) for _ in range(8)]
+        init += [_raw(fx.Int32(x).ir_value()) for x in ixq1 + ixd1]
+        init += [_raw(Vec(x).ir_value()) for x in side0]
+        init += [_raw(fx.Int32(x).ir_value()) for x in ixq0]
+        ns = 10  # loop-state slots before the index/side-data ones
+        for tile, st in range(0, nt, 1, init=init):
+            m_old = fx.Float32(st[0])
+            l_old = fx.Float32(st[1])
+            o = [Vec(st[2 + i]) for i in range(8)]
+            ixq_n = [fx.Int32(st[ns + i]) for i in range(2)]
+            ixd_n = [fx.Int32(st[ns + 2 + i]) for i in range(2)]
+            side = [Vec(st[ns + 4 + i]) for i in range(6)]
+            ixq_c = [fx.Int32(st[ns + 10 + i]) for i in range(2)]
+            tb = fx.Int32(tile) * _TILE
+            not_last = fx.Int32(tile) < nt - 1
+
+            # This tile's latent has landed (own DMA) and is visible (barrier).
+            rocdl.s_waitcnt(vmcnt=0)
+            gpu.barrier()
+            t2 = nxt(tb, 2)
+            ixq_nn = ld_q_idx(t2)
+
+            # ---- QK (A = K rows from LDS, B = Q^T) -> S^T:
+            # lane (h = t, g) holds tokens 16s + 4g + r.
+            def kread(j):
+                s, blk = j // 4, j % 4
+                ka = k_rdb[s] ^ (32 * blk)
+                return _cat(
+                    _lds_load(T.i32, 4, ka, 16), _lds_load(T.i32, 4, ka + 32768, 16), 4
+                )
+
+            kl = [kread(j) for j in range_constexpr(_K_DEPTH)] + [None] * (8 - _K_DEPTH)
+            sacc = [Vec.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32), Vec.filled(4, 0.0, fx.Float32)]
+            for j in range_constexpr(8):
+                s, blk = j // 4, j % 4
+                rocdl.sched_barrier(0)
+                lt = kl[j]
+                kl[j] = None
+                if const_expr(j + _K_DEPTH < 8):
+                    kl[j + _K_DEPTH] = kread(j + _K_DEPTH)
+                se = (fx.Int32(side[3 * s][0]) >> 23) & 0xFF
+                acc = _mfma_fp8(lt, q8[blk], sacc[s], se, qs)
+                sacc[s] = _mfma_fp8(lt, q8l[blk], acc, se, qsl)
+            for s in range_constexpr(2):
+                for i in range_constexpr(2):
+                    sacc[s] = _mfma_bf16(side[3 * s + 1 + i], qr[i], sacc[s])
+
+            # This lane's token scale for slice w' = g, as f32 bits; 0 marks a
+            # masked token. A valid token keeps >= 1 (a zero-scale record
+            # attends like a zero latent, as in the Gluon path) and <= 2^7
+            # (fp16 headroom of P' = P * scale).
+            for s in range_constexpr(2):
+                sg = fx.Int32(Vec(side[3 * s])[0])
+                sg = _imin(_imax(sg, fx.Int32(1)), fx.Int32(_SCALE_CAP_BITS))
+                sg = (ixq_c[s] >= 0).select(sg, fx.Int32(0))
+                _lds_store(Vec.from_elements([sg], fx.Int32), T.i32, ks_wr + 64 * s, 4)
+
+            # S-layout token scales: svs[s][w'] = 4 f32 for tokens 16s + 4g + r.
+            svs = [
+                [
+                    _lds_load(T.f32, 4, ks_rd + (wp * 32 + 16 * s) * 4, 16)
+                    for wp in range_constexpr(4)
+                ]
+                for s in range_constexpr(2)
+            ]
+            sl = []
+            tmax = neg_inf
+            for s in range_constexpr(2):
+                for r in range_constexpr(4):
+                    x = fx.Float32(Vec(sacc[s])[r]) * c_log2
+                    x = (fx.Float32(svs[s][0][r]) != fx.Float32(0.0)).select(x, neg_inf)
+                    sl.append(x)
+                    tmax = _fmax(tmax, x)
+            tmax = _xmax(tmax)
+            _lds_store(Vec.from_elements([tmax], fx.Float32), T.f32, mx_wr, 4)
+            rocdl.s_waitcnt(lgkmcnt=0)
+            gpu.barrier()
+
+            mx = _lds_load(T.f32, 4, mx_rd, 16)
+
+            def pv_reads(d0):
+                res = []
+                for i in range_constexpr(4):
+                    dc = d0 + i
+                    parts = []
+                    for hf in range_constexpr(2):
+                        for sub in range_constexpr(2):
+                            parts.append(_tr8(v_rd[sub] ^ (16 * dc), hf * 8192))
+                    res.append(parts)
+                return res
+
+            m_new = m_old
+            for j in range_constexpr(4):
+                m_new = _fmax(m_new, fx.Float32(mx[j]))
+            alpha = (m_old - m_new).exp2(fastmath="afn")
+            # All masked so far: exp2(-1e30 + 1e20) = 0.
+            m_cl = _fmax(m_new - _P_SHIFT, fx.Float32(-1.0e20))
+            pl = [(sl[k] - m_cl).exp2(fastmath="afn") for k in range(8)]
+            psum = fx.Float32(0.0)
+            for x in pl:
+                psum = psum + x
+            l_new = l_old * alpha + psum
+            o = [
+                Vec.from_elements(
+                    [fx.Float32(Vec(o[i])[j]) * alpha for j in range(4)], fx.Float32
+                )
+                for i in range(8)
+            ]
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""No-RoPE FP4 indexer quantization for the AITER row-group layout.
+
+Each 128-element head has four UE8M0 scales and 64 E2M1 payload bytes.
+Cache writes preserve the physical page stride of the merged MLA cache.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+
+def decode_tile_size(max_model_len: int, width: int, topk: int, heads: int) -> int:
+    """Bound logits, selection scratch and queries while grouping verify rows."""
+    row_bytes = 4 * width + 24 * min(topk, width) + 64 * heads + 256
+    return max(32, 32 * 4 * max_model_len // max(1, row_bytes))
+
+
+def decode_layout(
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    query_lens: torch.Tensor,
+    num_rows: int,
+    dcp_rank: int = 0,
+    dcp_world_size: int = 1,
+    interleave: int = 1,
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Group verify rows by request and bound scores in rank-local key space.
+
+    seq_lens are global, uncompressed sequence lengths from indexer metadata.
+    Graph padding remains outside the last query boundary, with zero key bounds.
+    No device-to-host reads are needed, including for nonuniform verify lengths.
+    """
+    if not 0 <= dcp_rank < dcp_world_size or interleave < 1 or num_rows < 0:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid DCP geometry or query row count")
+    if seq_lens.ndim != 1 or query_lens.ndim != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Sequence and query lengths must be one-dimensional")
+    if seq_lens.numel() < query_lens.numel():
+        raise ValueError("Each decode request requires a global sequence length")
+    starts = torch.cat(
+        (query_lens.new_zeros(1), query_lens.cumsum(0, dtype=torch.int32))
+    ).to(torch.int32)
+    rows = torch.arange(num_rows, device=query_lens.device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    if query_lens.numel() == 0:
+        return starts, torch.zeros_like(rows)
+    request = torch.searchsorted(starts[1:], rows, right=True).clamp_max(
+        query_lens.numel() - 1
+    )
+    ends = (
+        seq_lens[request] - query_lens[request] + rows - starts[request] + 1
+    ).clamp_min(0)
+    if dcp_world_size > 1:
+        full = ends // (dcp_world_size * interleave) * interleave
+        ends = full + (ends - full * dcp_world_size - dcp_rank * interleave).clamp(
+            0, interleave
+        )
+    return starts, torch.where(rows < starts[-1], ends, 0).to(torch.int32)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _quantize(values):
+    values = tl.reshape(values, (4, 32))
+    scale = tl.maximum(tl.max(tl.abs(values), 1) / 6.0, 1.0e-4)
+    bits = scale.to(tl.int32, bitcast=True)
+    exponent = tl.minimum(((bits >> 23) & 255) + ((bits & 0x7FFFFF) != 0), 254)
+    scale = (exponent << 23).to(tl.float32, bitcast=True)
+    x = values / scale[:, None]
+    a = tl.abs(x)
+    # E2M1 levels: 0, .5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6. Ties choose even codes.
+    code = (a > 0.25).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a >= 0.75).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a > 1.25).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a >= 1.75).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a > 2.5).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a >= 3.5).to(tl.uint8)
+    code += (a > 5.0).to(tl.uint8)
+    code |= ((x < 0) & (code != 0)).to(tl.uint8) << 3
+    low, high = tl.split(tl.reshape(code, (64, 2)))
+    return low | (high << 4), exponent.to(tl.uint8)
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _quantize_query(
+    Q, Payload, Scales, QS: tl.constexpr, QH: tl.constexpr, H: tl.constexpr
+):
+    row, head = tl.program_id(0), tl.program_id(1)
+    group = tl.arange(0, 4)
+    scale_offsets = row * 256 + group * 64 + (head % 16) * 4 + head // 16
+    if head < H:
+        values = tl.load(Q + row * QS + head * QH + tl.arange(0, 128)).to(tl.float32)
+        packed, scales = _quantize(values)
+        tl.store(Payload + (row * H + head) * 64 + tl.arange(0, 64), packed)
+        tl.store(Scales + scale_offsets, scales)
+    else:
+        tl.store(Scales + scale_offsets, tl.full((4,), 0, tl.uint8))
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _quantize_key(K, Cache, Slots, KS: tl.constexpr, CS: tl.constexpr):
+    row = tl.program_id(0)
+    slot = tl.load(Slots + row).to(tl.int64)
+    if slot >= 0:
+        values = tl.load(K + row * KS + tl.arange(0, 128)).to(tl.float32)
+        packed, scales = _quantize(values)
+        page, offset = slot // 64, slot % 64
+        byte = tl.arange(0, 64)
+        tl.store(
+            Cache + page * CS + (byte // 16) * 1024 + offset * 16 + byte % 16, packed
+        )
+        # AITER's 64-slot scale axis is a transposed 16 x 4 tile.
+        shuffled = (offset % 16) * 4 + offset // 16
+        tl.store(Cache + page * CS + 4096 + tl.arange(0, 4) * 64 + shuffled, scales)
+
+
+def quantize_queries(q: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Quantize [rows, heads, 128] without folding scales into head weights."""
+    if q.ndim != 3 or q.shape[2] != 128 or q.stride(2) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("FP4 index queries require contiguous 128-element heads")
+    rows, heads, _ = q.shape
+    if heads not in (16, 32, 64):
+        raise ValueError("FP4 row-group queries support 16, 32 or 64 heads")
+    payload = torch.empty((rows, heads, 64), device=q.device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    scales = torch.empty((rows, 1, 4, 16, 4), device=q.device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    if rows:
+        _quantize_query[(rows, 64)](q, payload, scales, q.stride(0), q.stride(1), heads)
+    return payload, scales
+
+
+def cache_views(cache: torch.Tensor) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """View index sections as payload/scales without copying across MLA pages."""
+    if (
+        cache.dtype != torch.uint8
+        or cache.ndim != 3
+        or cache.shape[1:] != (64, 68)
+        or cache.stride(2) != 1
+        or cache.stride(1) != 68
+        or cache.stride(0) < 4352
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("FP4 index cache requires uint8 [pages, 64, 68] sections")
+    pages, stride, start = cache.shape[0], cache.stride(0), cache.storage_offset()
+    payload = cache.as_strided(
+        (pages, 1, 4, 64, 16), (stride, 4096, 1024, 16, 1), start
+    )
+    scales = cache.as_strided((pages, 1, 4, 64), (stride, 256, 64, 1), start + 4096)
+    return payload, scales
+
+
+def store_keys(keys: torch.Tensor, cache: torch.Tensor, slots: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """Quantize normalized keys into merged cache pages; negative slots are padding."""
+    cache_views(cache)
+    if keys.ndim != 2 or keys.shape[1] != 128 or keys.stride(1) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("FP4 index keys require contiguous 128-element rows")
+    if slots.ndim != 1 or slots.numel() != keys.shape[0] or slots.stride(0) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("Each key requires one contiguous slot entry")
+    if keys.shape[0]:
+        _quantize_key[(keys.shape[0],)](
+            keys, cache, slots, keys.stride(0), cache.stride(0)
+        )
+
+
+def score_paged(
+    query: torch.Tensor,
+    cache: torch.Tensor,
+    weights: torch.Tensor,
+    block_table: torch.Tensor,
+    query_starts: torch.Tensor,
+    row_ends: torch.Tensor,
+    max_query_len: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Score one bounded query tile using shared-key row-group FP4 MLA logits.
+
+    Weights include the model's head/softmax factors, but not FP4 group scales.
+    The AITER reader must support physical page strides for merged caches.
+    """
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.mqa_logits.pa_mqa_logits_fp4_rowgroup import (
+        flydsl_pa_mqa_logits_fp4_rowgroup,
+        make_fp4_mqa_plan,
+    )
+
+    width = block_table.shape[1] * 64
+    output = torch.empty(
+        (query.shape[0], width), dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device
+    )
+    if not output.numel() or query_starts.numel() <= 1:
+        return output
+    payload, scales = cache_views(cache)
+    q_payload, q_scales = quantize_queries(query)
+    plan = make_fp4_mqa_plan(
+        num_seqs=query_starts.numel() - 1,
+        max_qlen=max_query_len,
+        num_rows=query.shape[0],
+        heads=query.shape[1],
+        page_size=64,
+        max_seq_len=width,
+    )
+    return flydsl_pa_mqa_logits_fp4_rowgroup(
+        plan,
+        q_payload,
+        q_scales,
+        payload,
+        scales,
+        block_table,
+        weights,
+        query_starts,
+        row_ends,
+        out=output,
+    )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""FP4 prefill: gather compact index keys once, then score global causal rows."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillMetadata
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.utils import get_dcp_local_seq_lens
+
+from .fp4_indexer import quantize_queries
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FP4QueryPlan:
+    start: int
+    end: int
+    row_starts: torch.Tensor
+    row_ends: torch.Tensor
+    batches: torch.Tensor
+    schedule: torch.Tensor
+    num_ctas: int
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class FP4ChunkPlan:
+    all_cu: torch.Tensor
+    page_table: torch.Tensor
+    first: int
+    per_rank: int
+    queries: list[FP4QueryPlan]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class FP4PrefillMetadata(DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillMetadata):
+    plans: list[FP4ChunkPlan] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+
+def _local_key_cu(chunk, world, interleave):
+    lengths = chunk.cu_seq_lens[1:] - chunk.cu_seq_lens[:-1]
+    counts = get_dcp_local_seq_lens(lengths, world, None, interleave)
+    return torch.cat(
+        (counts.new_zeros((1, world)), counts.cumsum(0, dtype=torch.int32))
+    )
+
+
+def _prepare_chunk(chunk, world, rank, interleave):
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.mqa_logits.pa_mqa_logits_fp4_prefill import (
+        compute_prefill_schedule,
+    )
+
+    device = chunk.cu_seq_lens.device
+    pages = triton.cdiv(chunk.total_seq_lens, 64)
+    width = pages * 64
+    # The scorer prefetches page IDs one block beyond the final iteration.
+    table = torch.zeros(
+        (1, triton.cdiv(pages, 4) * 4 + 4), device=device, dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    table[0, :pages] = torch.arange(pages, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    ks, ke = (
+        (chunk.global_cu_seqlen_ks, chunk.global_cu_seqlen_ke)
+        if world > 1
+        else (chunk.cu_seqlen_ks, chunk.cu_seqlen_ke)
+    )
+    assert ks is not None and ke is not None
+    per_rank = triton.cdiv(chunk.token_end - chunk.token_start, world)
+    first = chunk.token_start + rank * per_rank
+    last = min(first + per_rank, chunk.token_end)
+    row_chunk = max(1, min(8192, (1024**3 - 1) // (4 * width)))
+    if row_chunk >= 128:
+        row_chunk = row_chunk // 128 * 128
+    queries = []
+    for start in range(first, last, row_chunk):
+        end = min(start + row_chunk, last)
+        lo, hi = start - chunk.token_start, end - chunk.token_start
+        starts, ends = ks[lo:hi], ke[lo:hi]
+        batches = torch.zeros(end - start, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+        _, schedule, num_ctas = compute_prefill_schedule(
+            batches, starts, ends, 256, max(4096, end - start), width
+        )
+        queries.append(
+            FP4QueryPlan(start, end, starts, ends, batches, schedule, num_ctas)
+        )
+    return FP4ChunkPlan(
+        _local_key_cu(chunk, world, interleave), table, first, per_rank, queries
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_prefill_metadata(metadata, world, rank, interleave):
+    """Build read-only geometry once for the layers sharing this attention group."""
+    return FP4PrefillMetadata(
+        metadata.chunks,
+        metadata.max_prefill_seq_len,
+        [_prepare_chunk(chunk, world, rank, interleave) for chunk in metadata.chunks],
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit
+def _pack_keys(
+    Cache,
+    Table,
+    LocalCu,
+    Packed,
+    CS: tl.constexpr,
+    TS: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    req = tl.program_id(0)
+    row = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    begin = tl.load(LocalCu + req)
+    length = tl.load(LocalCu + req + 1) - begin
+    page = tl.load(Table + req * TS + row // 64, row < length, 0).to(tl.int64)
+    slot = row % 64
+    byte = tl.arange(0, 128)
+    offset = tl.where(
+        byte < 64,
+        byte // 16 * 1024 + slot[:, None] * 16 + byte % 16,
+        4096 + (byte - 64) * 64 + (slot[:, None] % 16) * 4 + slot[:, None] // 16,
+    )
+    value = tl.load(
+        Cache + page[:, None] * CS + offset,
+        (row[:, None] < length) & (byte[None, :] < 68),
+        0,
+    )
+    tl.store(
+        Packed + (begin + row[:, None]).to(tl.int64) * 68 + byte[None, :],
+        value,
+        (row[:, None] < length) & (byte[None, :] < 68),
+    )
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["Total", "MaxLocal"])
+def _stage_keys(
+    Packed,
+    TokenToSeq,
+    GlobalCu,
+    AllLocalCu,
+    Payload,
+    Scales,
+    Total,
+    MaxLocal,
+    World: tl.constexpr,
+    Interleave: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    token = tl.program_id(0) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    req = tl.load(TokenToSeq + token, token < Total, 0)
+    begin = tl.load(GlobalCu + req)
+    pos = token - begin
+    owner = pos // Interleave % World
+    local = pos // (Interleave * World) * Interleave + pos % Interleave
+    local += tl.load(AllLocalCu + req * World + owner)
+    source = owner.to(tl.int64) * MaxLocal + local
+    byte = tl.arange(0, 64)
+    value = tl.load(
+        Packed + source[:, None] * 68 + byte[None, :], token[:, None] < Total, 0
+    )
+    page, slot = token // 64, token % 64
+    target = (
+        page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * 4096
+        + byte[None, :] // 16 * 1024
+        + slot[:, None] * 16
+        + byte[None, :] % 16
+    )
+    tl.store(Payload + target, value, token[:, None] < Total)
+    group = tl.arange(0, 4)
+    scale = tl.load(
+        Packed + source[:, None] * 68 + 64 + group[None, :], token[:, None] < Total, 0
+    )
+    target_scale = (
+        page[:, None].to(tl.int64) * 256
+        + group[None, :] * 64
+        + slot[:, None] % 16 * 4
+        + slot[:, None] // 16
+    )
+    tl.store(Scales + target_scale, scale, token[:, None] < Total)
+
+
+def prefill_workspace_bytes(max_keys, max_reqs, world, interleave):
+    """Peak prefill scratch of one chunk holding at most ``max_keys`` keys.
+
+    The indexer builder caps each chunk's keys at its prefill buffer size and
+    _prepare_chunk keeps each logits tile under 1 GiB. Staging holds the local
+    packed keys, their DCP all-gather and the restored pages at once; a rank's
+    share exceeds an even split by at most one interleave run per request.
+    """
+    pages = triton.cdiv(max_keys, 64) * 64
+    if world == 1:
+        return 1024**3 + 68 * (max_keys + pages)
+    local = triton.cdiv(max_keys, world) + max_reqs * interleave
+    return 1024**3 + 68 * ((world + 1) * local + pages)
+
+
+def stage_keys(cache, chunk, world, interleave, all_cu=None):
+    """Preserve quantized bytes and swizzled scale rows, including merged strides."""
+    device = cache.device
+    cu = chunk.cu_seq_lens
+    if all_cu is None:
+        all_cu = _local_key_cu(chunk, world, interleave)
+    max_local = chunk.max_local_total_seq_lens if world > 1 else chunk.total_seq_lens
+    packed = torch.empty((max_local, 68), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    local_width = (
+        (chunk.max_seqlen_k + world * interleave - 1)
+        // (world * interleave)
+        * interleave
+    )
+    _pack_keys[(chunk.num_reqs, triton.cdiv(local_width, 32))](
+        cache,
+        chunk.block_table,
+        chunk.local_cu_seq_lens if world > 1 else chunk.cu_seq_lens,
+        packed,
+        cache.stride(0),
+        chunk.block_table.stride(0),
+        32,
+    )
+    gathered = get_dcp_group().all_gather(packed, dim=0) if world > 1 else packed
+    pages = triton.cdiv(chunk.total_seq_lens, 64)
+    payload = torch.zeros((pages, 1, 4, 64, 16), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    scales = torch.zeros((pages, 1, 4, 64), device=device, dtype=torch.uint8)
+    _stage_keys[(triton.cdiv(chunk.total_seq_lens, 32),)](
+        gathered,
+        chunk.token_to_seq,
+        cu,
+        all_cu,
+        payload,
+        scales,
+        chunk.total_seq_lens,
+        max_local,
+        world,
+        interleave,
+        32,
+    )
+    return payload, scales
+
+
+def prefill_indexer(
+    q,
+    weights,
+    cache,
+    out,
+    chunk,
+    world,
+    interleave,
+    weight_scale=1.0,
+    staged_keys=None,
+    pending=None,
+    plan=None,
+):
+    from aiter.ops.flydsl.kernels.mqa_logits.pa_mqa_logits_fp4_prefill import (
+        flydsl_pa_mqa_logits_fp4_prefill,
+    )
+    from aiter.ops.topk import top_k_per_row_prefill
+
+    assert weights.dtype == torch.bfloat16

+        stage_keys(cache, chunk, world, interleave, plan.all_cu)
+        if staged_keys is None

+    width = payload.shape[0] * 64

+    local_out = torch.full(
+        (plan.per_rank, out.shape[1]), -1, dtype=out.dtype, device=out.device
+    )
+    for query in plan.queries:
+        start, end = query.start, query.end
+        starts, ends = query.row_starts, query.row_ends

+            qp,
+            qs,
+            payload,
+            scales,
+            plan.page_table,
+            weights[start:end],
+            query.batches,
+            starts,
+            ends,
+            width,
+            weight_scale=weight_scale,
+            cta_info=query.schedule,
+            n_ctas=query.num_ctas,
+            out=logits,
+        )
+        selected = local_out[start - plan.first : end - plan.first]
+        top_k_per_row_prefill(
+            logits=logits,
+            rowStarts=starts,
+            rowEnds=ends,
+            indices=selected,
+            values=None,
+            numRows=end - start,
+            stride0=logits.stride(0),
+            stride1=logits.stride(1),
+            # DCP assigns each query to one rank and shares its selected IDs.
+            # Only replicated queries need identical tie-breaking on each rank.
+            stable=world == 1,
+            k=out.shape[1],

+def prefill_chunks(q, weights, cache, out, metadata, world, interleave, weight_scale):

+    gathered_keys = None

+        cache_key = (chunk.block_table.data_ptr(), chunk.num_reqs, chunk.total_seq_lens)
+        if gathered_keys is None or gathered_keys[0] != cache_key:
+            # Release the previous request set's pages before staging the next.
+            gathered_keys = None
+            gathered_keys = (
+                cache_key,
+                stage_keys(cache, chunk, world, interleave, plan.all_cu),
+            )

+            q,
+            weights,
+            cache,
+            out,
+            chunk,
+            world,
+            interleave,
+            weight_scale,
+            staged_keys=gathered_keys[1],
+            pending=pending,
+            plan=plan,
+        )
+    if not pending:
+        return
+    mine = (
+        torch.cat([rows for _, _, rows in pending])
+        if len(pending) > 1
+        else pending[0][2]
+    )
+    selected = get_dcp_group().all_gather(mine, dim=0) if world > 1 else mine
+    selected = selected.view(world, mine.shape[0], -1)
+    offset = 0
+    for start, end, rows in pending:
+        count = rows.shape[0]
+        out[start:end].copy_(
+            selected[:, offset : offset + count].reshape(-1, out.shape[1])[
+                : end - start

+import math
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.sparse_attn_indexer import MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE
+from vllm.model_executor.models.deepseek_v2 import DeepseekV32IndexerCache
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import cdiv
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import AttentionBackend, CommonAttentionMetadata
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.compressor_utils import (
+    get_compressed_slot_mapping,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepseekV32IndexerBackend,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+    dsa_indexer_uses_fp4,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    DS_MLA_STATE_CONTENT_BYTES,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+    get_kv_quant_mode,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_layout import KVCacheLayout
+
+
+def kimi_k3_indexer_uses_fp4(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> bool:
+    """FP8 (132 B/token) indexer keys by default (``indexer_kv_dtype='auto'``);
+    MXFP4 (68 B/token) only when requested with ``--attention-config
+    '{"indexer_kv_dtype": "mxfp4"}'``. MXFP4 needs SM10x (checked by
+    ``dsa_indexer_uses_fp4``), the fused key insert (layernorm k-norm, no indexer
+    RoPE) and no PCP; anything else raises instead of writing another format."""
+    if not dsa_indexer_uses_fp4(vllm_config):
+        return False
+    text_config = getattr(vllm_config.model_config, "hf_text_config", None)
+    dsa_config = getattr(text_config, "dsa_config", None)
+    if dsa_config is not None and not (
+        getattr(dsa_config, "index_k_norm_type", "rmsnorm") == "layernorm"
+        and getattr(dsa_config, "index_rope_dim", 0) == 0
+    ):
+        raise ValueError(
+            "indexer_kv_dtype='mxfp4' needs the fused Kimi K3 DSA key insert "
+            "(index_k_norm_type='layernorm', index_rope_dim=0)."
+        )
+    parallel_config = getattr(vllm_config, "parallel_config", None)
+    if getattr(parallel_config, "prefill_context_parallel_size", 1) > 1:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "indexer_kv_dtype='mxfp4' is not supported with prefill context "
+            "parallelism for Kimi K3 DSA."
+        )
+    return True
+
+
+def indexer_cache_entry_bytes(head_dim: int, use_fp4_cache: bool) -> int:
+    """Indexer key cache bytes per token: FP8 values + one 4 B scale, or MXFP4
+    values (two per byte) + one UE8M0 byte per 32 values."""
+    if use_fp4_cache:
+        return head_dim // 2 + head_dim // MXFP4_BLOCK_SIZE
+    return head_dim + 4
+
+
+class KimiK3IndexerMetadataBuilder(DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder):
+    """Writes the indexer keys at slots derived from the block table, as the
+    compressed indexers are written: in a packed block row the block table
+    addresses 64-token kernel pages, which manager slots do not."""
+
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        if self.use_pcp:
+            raise NotImplementedError("Kimi-K3.1 packed DSA caches with PCP")
+        # The K3.1 key format, validated as KimiK3DSAIndexer selects it.
+        self.indexer_uses_fp4 = kimi_k3_indexer_uses_fp4(self.vllm_config)
+        if self.indexer_uses_fp4 and current_platform.is_rocm():
+            self._needs_global_row_bounds = self.dcp_world_size > 1
+            # The FP4 prefill op always splits a chunk's query rows over the
+            # DCP ranks, so the chunk planner gets the same per-rank budget.
+            self._rowshard_dcp_prefill = self._needs_global_row_bounds
+        self.slot_mapping_buffer = torch.zeros(
+            self.vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
+            dtype=torch.int64,
+            device=self.device,
+        )
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata:
+        slot_mapping = get_compressed_slot_mapping(
+            common_attn_metadata.num_actual_tokens,
+            common_attn_metadata.slot_mapping,
+            common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc,
+            common_attn_metadata.seq_lens,
+            common_attn_metadata.block_table_tensor,
+            self.kv_cache_spec.block_size,
+            compress_ratio=1,
+            out=self.slot_mapping_buffer,
+            dcp_world_size=self.dcp_world_size,
+            cp_interleave=self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size,
+        )
+        metadata = super().build(
+            common_prefix_len,
+            replace(common_attn_metadata, slot_mapping=slot_mapping),
+            fast_build,
+        )
+        if self.indexer_uses_fp4 and current_platform.is_rocm() and metadata.prefill:
+            from vllm.models.kimi_k3.amd.ops.fp4_indexer_prefill import (
+                prepare_prefill_metadata,
+            )
+
+            metadata.prefill = prepare_prefill_metadata(
+                metadata.prefill,
+                self.dcp_world_size,
+                self.dcp_rank,
+                self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size,
+            )
+        return metadata
+
+
+class KimiK3IndexerBackend(DeepseekV32IndexerBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(kv_cache_spec=None):
+        if kv_cache_spec is not None:
+            fp4 = kv_cache_spec.head_size == 68
+        else:
+            fp4 = (
+                get_current_vllm_config().attention_config.resolve_indexer_kv_dtype(
+                    "fp8"
+                )
+                == "mxfp4"
+            )
+        return (
+            [64]
+            if fp4
+            else DeepseekV32IndexerBackend.get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(
+                kv_cache_spec
+            )
+        )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def supported_kv_cache_layouts(cls) -> tuple[KVCacheLayout, ...]:
+        # Pack the indexer pages beside the MLA pages inside each block, so a
+        # KDA state page sizes the whole block row rather than one MLA page.
+        return (KVCacheLayout.BLHNC,)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def writes_kv_cache_from_block_table(cls) -> bool:
+        return True
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type[KimiK3IndexerMetadataBuilder]:
+        return KimiK3IndexerMetadataBuilder
+
+
+class KimiK3IndexerCache(DeepseekV32IndexerCache):
+    def get_attn_backend(self) -> type[AttentionBackend]:
+        return KimiK3IndexerBackend
+
+
+# Block sizes stay divisible across TP sizes up to this one, so P/D can pair
+# blocks of different TP sizes.
+_PD_REFERENCE_TP = 16
+
+
+def dense_mla_draft_bytes_per_token(vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> int:
+    """Per-token bytes of a dense MLA draft's caches, which share the DSA row:
+    their full-attention MLA specs group with the target's (see
+    ``configure_dense_draft``)."""
+    spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
+    if spec_config is None or spec_config.method not in ("eagle3", "dspark"):
+        return 0
+    draft_model_config = spec_config.draft_model_config
+    draft_config = draft_model_config.hf_text_config
+    kv_lora_rank = getattr(draft_config, "kv_lora_rank", None)
+    if kv_lora_rank is None:
+        return 0
+    cache_dtype = spec_config.kv_cache_dtype or vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype
+    page = MLAAttentionSpec(
+        block_size=1,
+        num_kv_heads=1,
+        head_size=kv_lora_rank + draft_config.qk_rope_head_dim,
+        dtype=kv_cache_dtype_str_to_dtype(cache_dtype, draft_model_config),
+        cache_dtype_str=cache_dtype,
+        kv_quant_mode=get_kv_quant_mode(cache_dtype),
+        state_content_bytes=DS_MLA_STATE_CONTENT_BYTES.get(cache_dtype),
+    ).page_size_bytes
+    return draft_config.num_hidden_layers * page
+
+
+def packed_dsa_block_size(
+    vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+    mla_bytes_per_token: int,
+    state_bytes: int,
+    alignment: int,
+) -> int | None:
+    """Block size of the packed cache of a KDA-hybrid DSA model, else None.
+
+    A block row holds every DSA layer's MLA and indexer pages, plus a dense
+    MLA draft's pages; size it to fit as many KDA states as there are DSA
+    layers. The KDA state shards with TP and the row does not, so the block is
+    rounded at ``_PD_REFERENCE_TP`` and scaled by ``_PD_REFERENCE_TP / tp``.
+    Block sizes of different TP sizes stay divisible, and the rounding stays
+    fine: a power of two would leave up to half the row empty once spec
+    decoding grows the conv state past one.
+    """
+    text_config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config
+    dsa_config = getattr(text_config, "dsa_config", None)
+    linear_attn_config = getattr(text_config, "linear_attn_config", None)
+    if dsa_config is None or linear_attn_config is None:
+        return None
+    num_dsa = len(linear_attn_config["full_attn_layers"])
+    num_states = len(linear_attn_config["kda_layers"])
+    states_per_row = cdiv(num_states, cdiv(num_states, num_dsa))
+    # The indexer keeps fp8 values plus one fp32 scale per token, or MXFP4.
+    index_bytes = indexer_cache_entry_bytes(
+        dsa_config.index_head_dim, kimi_k3_indexer_uses_fp4(vllm_config)
+    )
+    row_bytes_per_token = num_dsa * (
+        mla_bytes_per_token + index_bytes
+    ) + dense_mla_draft_bytes_per_token(vllm_config)
+    tp_size = vllm_config.parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
+    reference_tp = math.lcm(_PD_REFERENCE_TP, tp_size)
+    # TP-invariant: the unsharded state bytes, in reference-TP block units.
+    reference_units = cdiv(
+        states_per_row * state_bytes * tp_size,
+        alignment * reference_tp * row_bytes_per_token,
+    )
+    return alignment * reference_units * (reference_tp // tp_size)

+"""Dense MLA draft support for Kimi K3.1 (DSA target).
+
+Dense EAGLE3 and DSpark drafts keep their own fp8 MLA cache and decode with
+FLASHINFER_MLA, or ROCM_AITER_MLA on ROCm (``configure_dense_draft``).
+"""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from vllm.config import SpeculativeConfig
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+
+def configure_dense_draft(spec_config: SpeculativeConfig, text_config: Any) -> None:
+    """Default an EAGLE3/DSpark draft's attention backend and KV dtype on a
+    KDA-hybrid DSA target: dense MLA + fp8 for MLA drafts, FLASH_ATTN +
+    model dtype for GQA drafts. MTP is unchanged."""
+    if (
+        spec_config.method not in ("eagle3", "dspark")
+        or getattr(text_config, "linear_attn_config", None) is None
+    ):
+        return
+    draft_text_config = spec_config.draft_model_config.hf_text_config
+    is_mla_draft = getattr(draft_text_config, "kv_lora_rank", None) is not None
+    if is_mla_draft:
+        # MLA draft: no dense MLA kernel reads the target's fp8_ds_mla, so the
+        # draft gets its own plain fp8 cache on the platform's dense MLA backend.
+        backend = (
+            AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_MLA
+            if current_platform.is_rocm()
+            else AttentionBackendEnum.FLASHINFER_MLA
+        )
+        kv_cache_dtype = "fp8"
+    else:
+        # GQA draft: its own cache, not the target's sparse backend or fp8_ds_mla.
+        backend, kv_cache_dtype = AttentionBackendEnum.FLASH_ATTN, "auto"
+    spec_config.attention_backend = spec_config.attention_backend or backend
+    spec_config.kv_cache_dtype = spec_config.kv_cache_dtype or kv_cache_dtype

+class KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm(nn.Module):
+    """Bias-full fp32 LayerNorm for the DSA indexer shared key.
+
+    ``F.layer_norm(x.float(), (dim,), weight.float(), bias.float(),
+    eps).type_as(x)`` -- fp32 compute with a cast back to the input dtype.
+    weight/bias are stored in fp32 directly (numerically equivalent to
+    casting per forward), keeping only the input/output dtype casts.
+    Selected via ``dsa_config.index_k_norm_type == "layernorm"``; legacy
+    checkpoints keep the RMSNorm path untouched.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.normalized_shape = (dim,)
+        self.eps = eps
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim, dtype=torch.float32))
+        self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(dim, dtype=torch.float32))
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return F.layer_norm(
+            x.float(), self.normalized_shape, self.weight, self.bias, self.eps
+        ).type_as(x)
+
+
+class KimiK3DSAIndexer(nn.Module):
+    """wq / wkv indexer projections + native ``DeepseekV32IndexerCache``.
+
+    Forward quantizes the indexer query, folds the scales into the per-head
+    weights and drives ``torch.ops.vllm.sparse_attn_indexer`` directly (the
+    upstream deepseek_v2.Indexer pattern).
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        index_q_input_size: int,
+        index_head_dim: int,
+        index_num_heads: int,
+        index_topk: int,
+        rms_norm_eps: float,
+        index_rope_dim: int = 0,
+        index_k_norm_type: str = "rmsnorm",
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.index_head_dim = index_head_dim
+        self.index_num_heads = index_num_heads
+        self.indexer_weight_scale = self.index_num_heads**-0.5
+        # MLAModules contract: MultiHeadLatentAttention asserts the indexer
+        # exposes topk_tokens.
+        self.topk_tokens = index_topk
+        # Leading dims of every indexer head that receive RoPE. Weights are
+        # pair-permuted at checkpoint conversion (interleaved -> half-split),
+        # so serving applies neox-style rope with the main-attention
+        # cos_sin_cache (YaRN scaling therefore carries over automatically).
+        # 0 = pre-rope checkpoints; the forward path is then unchanged.
+        if index_rope_dim < 0 or index_rope_dim % 2 != 0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"dsa_config.index_rope_dim must be even and >= 0, got {index_rope_dim}"
+            )
+        if index_rope_dim > index_head_dim:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"dsa_config.index_rope_dim ({index_rope_dim}) must not "
+                f"exceed index_head_dim ({index_head_dim})"
+            )
+        self.index_rope_dim = index_rope_dim
+        self.wq_index = ReplicatedLinear(
+            index_q_input_size,
+            self.index_num_heads * self.index_head_dim,
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.wq_index",
+        )
+        # The indexer query projection (wq_index) may be quantized in fp8
+        # checkpoints; wk and weights_proj are bf16 and share one GEMM.
+        self.wkv_index = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+            hidden_size,
+            [self.index_head_dim, self.index_num_heads],
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=None,
+            disable_tp=True,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.wkv_index",
+        )
+        self.k_index_norm: nn.Module
+        if index_k_norm_type == "layernorm":
+            self.k_index_norm = KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm(
+                self.index_head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps
+            )
+        elif index_k_norm_type == "rmsnorm":
+            self.k_index_norm = RMSNorm(self.index_head_dim, eps=rms_norm_eps)
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"dsa_config.index_k_norm_type must be 'rmsnorm' or "
+                f"'layernorm', got {index_k_norm_type!r}"
+            )
+
+        # Index cache scales use ue8m0 (power-of-2 rounding at write), the
+        # convention of upstream DeepSeek V3.2; the DeepGEMM scoring kernels
+        # read the scales as full fp32, which is exact for power-of-2 values.
+        self.scale_fmt = "ue8m0"
+        self.quant_block_size = self.index_head_dim
+        self.index_softmax_scale = self.index_head_dim**-0.5
+        # DeepGEMM indexer kernels support at most 64 index heads; smaller
+        # head counts are zero-padded to the next supported width.
+        if self.index_num_heads <= 32:
+            self.padded_index_num_heads = 32
+        elif self.index_num_heads <= 64:
+            self.padded_index_num_heads = 64
+        else:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Official DeepGEMM DSA indexer supports at most 64 index "
+                f"heads, got {self.index_num_heads}."
+            )
+        # FP8 keys by default; MXFP4 keys with MXFP4 queries (DeepGEMM's FP4
+        # MQA logits) only on an explicit indexer_kv_dtype='mxfp4'.
+        self.use_fp4_cache = kimi_k3_indexer_uses_fp4(vllm_config)
+        self.k_cache = KimiK3IndexerCache(
+            head_dim=indexer_cache_entry_bytes(self.index_head_dim, self.use_fp4_cache),
+            dtype=torch.uint8,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.k_cache",
+            cache_config=cast(CacheConfig, cache_config),
+        )
+        self.max_model_len = vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+        self.max_total_seq_len = v32_indexer.get_max_prefill_buffer_size(vllm_config)
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer
+        # Same derivation as the upstream SparseAttnIndexer
+        # (sparse_attn_indexer.py): enable the allgather-k path when prefill
+        # context parallelism is configured.
+        self.use_pcp = vllm_config.parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
+        # Set by KimiK3DSAAttention to skip scoring dense-MHA prefills.
+        self.dense_mha_metadata_layer_name = ""
+        # Set by KimiK3DSAAttention when its MLA layer takes ShardQ steps: the
+        # op then follows that layer's token split.
+        self.shardq_layer_name = ""
+        self.topk_backend = vllm_config.kernel_config.sparse_indexer_topk_backend
+        # PCP gathers the unquantized key inside the op.
+        self.use_fused_k_insert = (
+            not self.use_pcp
+            and index_k_norm_type == "layernorm"
+            and index_rope_dim == 0
+        )
+        if self.use_fp4_cache and not self.use_fused_k_insert:
+            raise NotImplementedError("MXFP4 indexer keys need the fused key insert")
+        # DCP wiring, same as the upstream SparseAttnIndexer: the op merges
+        # each rank's local top-K into the global top-K only when these are
+        # passed through (sparse_attn_indexer.py:_merge_dcp_topk_global).
+        self._parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+        self.dcp_world_size = self._parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
+        self.dcp_rank = get_dcp_group().rank_in_group if self.dcp_world_size > 1 else 0
+        self._cp_kv_cache_interleave_size: int | None = None
+        # Same as the upstream SparseAttnIndexer: decode merges each rank's
+        # packed local top-N in one exchange (0 keeps the generic merge).
+        self.dcp_local_topk = init_dcp_topk_merge(vllm_config, index_topk)
+
+    @property
+    def cp_kv_cache_interleave_size(self) -> int:
+        """Same lazy resolution as upstream SparseAttnIndexer: the real value
+        is finalized after block_size setup, ahead of warmup/serving."""
+        if self._cp_kv_cache_interleave_size is None:
+            value = self._parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+            if isinstance(get_forward_context().attn_metadata, dict):
+                self._cp_kv_cache_interleave_size = value
+            return value
+        return self._cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+
+    def _apply_index_rope(
+        self,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_k: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        rotary_emb: nn.Module,
+    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        """RoPE on the leading index_rope_dim dims of each head.
+
+        Slices the leading index_rope_dim//2 frequencies from the main
+        attention's cos_sin_cache (matching training, which reuses the
+        leading freqs of the main freqs_cis for the indexer), computes in
+        fp32 and casts back. index_q: [T, H, D]; index_k: [T, D] (already
+        k_index_norm-ed, matching the training order norm -> rope).
+
+        Uses the neox/half-split pairing (dim i pairs with dim i+half),
+        matching the pair-permuted checkpoint conversion.
+        """
+        index_rope(
+            index_q,
+            index_k,
+            positions.view(-1),
+            rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            self.index_rope_dim,
+            False,  # interleave: neox/half-split
+        )
+        return index_q, index_k
+
+    def _shardq_indexer_rows(self) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        """The rows a ShardQ step scores on this rank (decode rows, then this
+        rank's prefill tokens), or None outside ShardQ steps and in cudagraph
+        capture or replay: a graph would bake in the capture batch's row count
+        and the address of its rows tensor."""
+        if not self.shardq_layer_name:
+            return None
+        forward_context = get_forward_context()
+        if (
+            forward_context.cudagraph_runtime_mode != CUDAGraphMode.NONE
+            or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing()
+        ):
+            return None
+        attn_metadata = forward_context.attn_metadata
+        if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict):
+            return None
+        shardq = getattr(attn_metadata.get(self.shardq_layer_name), "shardq", None)
+        return None if shardq is None else shardq.indexer_rows
+
+    def _fused_k_insert(self, index_k: torch.Tensor, num_tokens: int) -> None:
+        attn_metadata = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+        kv_cache = self.k_cache.kv_cache
+        # Dummy / profiling run: the op leaves the cache and top-k buffer
+        # alone too.
+        if not isinstance(attn_metadata, dict) or kv_cache.numel() == 0:
+            return
+        metadata = attn_metadata[self.k_cache.prefix]
+        assert isinstance(metadata, v32_indexer.DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata)
+        assert self.topk_indices_buffer is not None
+        norm = cast(KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm, self.k_index_norm)
+        insert = indexer_k_norm_quant_insert
+        if self.use_fp4_cache:
+            insert = mxfp4_k_norm_quant_insert
+        insert(
+            index_k,
+            norm.weight,
+            norm.bias,
+            norm.eps,
+            metadata.slot_mapping,
+            kv_cache,
+            self.topk_indices_buffer,
+            num_tokens,
+        )
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q_input: torch.Tensor | None,
+        positions: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        rotary_emb: nn.Module | None = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if index_q_input is None:
+            # q_lora_rank is None: MultiHeadLatentAttention.forward_native
+            # passes q_c=None, so the indexer query reads hidden_states.
+            index_q_input = hidden_states
+        # A ShardQ step scores this rank's rows only: project and quantize the
+        # query of just those (the op detects the compact query).
+        rows = self._shardq_indexer_rows() if self.use_fused_k_insert else None
+        if rows is not None:
+            index_q_input = index_q_input[rows]
+        index_q = self.wq_index(index_q_input)[0].view(
+            -1, self.index_num_heads, self.index_head_dim
+        )
+        index_k, index_weights = self.wkv_index(hidden_states)[0].split(
+            [self.index_head_dim, self.index_num_heads], dim=-1
+        )
+        if rows is not None:
+            index_weights = index_weights[rows]
+        if self.use_fused_k_insert:
+            self._fused_k_insert(index_k, hidden_states.shape[0])
+            index_k = None
+        else:
+            index_k = self.k_index_norm(index_k)
+            if self.index_rope_dim > 0:
+                assert positions is not None and rotary_emb is not None, (
+                    "index_rope_dim > 0 requires positions and the main "
+                    "attention rotary_emb (mla_use_nope models cannot enable "
+                    "indexer rope)"
+                )
+                index_q, index_k = self._apply_index_rope(
+                    index_q, index_k, positions, rotary_emb
+                )
+        return self.score(hidden_states, index_q, index_weights, index_k)
+
+    def score(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        index_q: torch.Tensor,
+        index_weights: torch.Tensor,
+        index_k: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Top-k of the current rows into ``topk_indices_buffer``; ``index_k`` is
+        None when the key was already inserted (``use_fused_k_insert``)."""
+        weight_scale = self.index_softmax_scale * self.indexer_weight_scale
+        q_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        if self.use_fp4_cache:
+            q_quant, q_scale, weights = mxfp4_q_quant(
+                index_q, index_weights, weight_scale, self.padded_index_num_heads
+            )
+        else:
+            q_quant, weights = indexer_q_quant_fold_weights(
+                index_q, index_weights, weight_scale, self.padded_index_num_heads
+            )
+        # Writes the index-k cache and the top-k indices into the shared
+        # model-level buffer (same call as SparseAttnIndexer.forward_cuda:
+        # under a dummy run kv_cache is an empty placeholder and the op takes
+        # the workspace-reservation path internally, so kv_cache[0] indexing
+        # is not allowed here).
+        return torch.ops.vllm.sparse_attn_indexer(
+            hidden_states,
+            _encode_layer_name(self.k_cache.prefix),
+            self.k_cache.kv_cache,
+            q_quant,
+            q_scale,  # None for fp8 Q: its scale is folded into the weights
+            index_k,
+            weights,
+            self.quant_block_size,
+            self.scale_fmt,
+            self.topk_tokens,
+            self.index_head_dim,
+            self.max_model_len,
+            self.max_total_seq_len,
+            self.topk_indices_buffer,
+            self.use_fused_k_insert,  # skip_k_cache_insert
+            self.use_pcp,
+            self._parallel_config.pcp_shard_decode_requests,
+            _encode_layer_name(self.dense_mha_metadata_layer_name),
+            self.use_fp4_cache,
+            self.dcp_rank,
+            self.dcp_world_size,
+            self.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size,
+            skip_topk_buffer_clear=self.use_fused_k_insert,
+            topk_backend=self.topk_backend,
+            shardq_layer_name=self.shardq_layer_name,
+            dcp_local_topk=self.dcp_local_topk,
+        )
+

+class KimiK3DSAAttention(nn.Module):
+    """Kimi K3.1 DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) inference path.
+
+    Same MLA projections as the dense Kimi-K3 MLA path, plus the DSA indexer
+    wired through ``MLAModules(is_sparse=True)`` so the FlashMLA sparse
+    backend consumes the top-k indices.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: KimiLinearConfig,
+        hidden_size: int,
+        num_heads: int,
+        qk_nope_head_dim: int,
+        qk_rope_head_dim: int,
+        v_head_dim: int,
+        q_lora_rank: int | None,
+        kv_lora_rank: int,
+        cache_config: CacheConfig | None = None,
+        quant_config: QuantizationConfig | None = None,
+        prefix: str = "",
+        reduce_results: bool = True,
+        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+        aux_stream: torch.cuda.Stream | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if config.dsa_config is None:
+            raise ValueError("dsa_config is required for KimiK3DSAAttention")
+        if current_platform.is_rocm():
+            raise NotImplementedError(
+                "Kimi-K3.1 DSA requires the CUDA FlashMLA sparse / DeepGEMM "
+                "indexer kernels; ROCm is not supported."
+            )
+        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
+        self.qk_nope_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim
+        self.qk_rope_head_dim = qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.qk_head_dim = qk_nope_head_dim + qk_rope_head_dim
+        self.v_head_dim = v_head_dim
+
+        self.q_lora_rank = q_lora_rank
+        self.kv_lora_rank = kv_lora_rank
+
+        self.num_heads = num_heads
+        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        if num_heads % tp_size > 0:
+            num_padded_heads = (num_heads + tp_size - 1) // tp_size * tp_size
+            logger.warning_once(
+                f"DSA num_heads {num_heads} is not divisible by tp_size "
+                f"{tp_size}, will pad to {num_padded_heads} heads"
+            )
+            self.num_heads = num_padded_heads
+        self.num_local_heads = self.num_heads // tp_size
+
+        self.scaling = self.qk_head_dim**-0.5
+        self.max_position_embeddings = config.max_position_embeddings
+
+        if self.q_lora_rank is not None:
+            self.fused_qkv_a_proj = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                [self.q_lora_rank, self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim],
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.fused_qkv_a_proj",
+                disable_tp=True,
+            )
+            self.q_a_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.q_lora_rank, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+            self.q_b_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.q_lora_rank,
+                self.num_heads * self.qk_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.q_b_proj",
+            )
+        else:
+            self.kv_a_proj_with_mqa = ReplicatedLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.kv_lora_rank + self.qk_rope_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.kv_a_proj_with_mqa",
+            )
+            self.q_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.num_heads * self.qk_head_dim,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.q_proj",
+            )
+        self.kv_a_layernorm = RMSNorm(self.kv_lora_rank, eps=config.rms_norm_eps)
+        self.kv_b_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+            self.kv_lora_rank,
+            self.num_heads * (self.qk_nope_head_dim + self.v_head_dim),
+            bias=False,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.kv_b_proj",
+        )
+        self.o_proj = RowParallelLinear(
+            self.num_heads * self.v_head_dim,
+            self.hidden_size,
+            bias=False,
+            reduce_results=reduce_results,
+            quant_config=quant_config,
+            prefix=f"{prefix}.o_proj",
+        )
+
+        # Full-attention layers are NoPE; the rope path below only runs for
+        # checkpoints whose MLA uses positional encoding (GPT-J interleaved
+        # rope dims; freqs are identical, only the dim pairing differs).
+        rope_parameters: dict = dict(getattr(config, "rope_parameters", None) or {})
+        if "rope_theta" not in rope_parameters:
+            rope_parameters["rope_theta"] = 10000.0
+        rope_scaling = (
+            rope_parameters
+            if rope_parameters.get("rope_type") not in (None, "default")
+            else None
+        )
+        self.use_nope = bool(config.mla_use_nope)
+        if self.use_nope:
+            self.rotary_emb = None
+        else:
+            if rope_scaling:
+                rope_parameters["rope_type"] = "deepseek_yarn"
+            self.rotary_emb = get_rope(
+                qk_rope_head_dim,
+                max_position=self.max_position_embeddings,
+                is_neox_style=False,
+                rope_parameters=rope_parameters,
+            )
+        if rope_scaling:
+            mscale_all_dim = rope_scaling.get("mscale_all_dim", False)
+            scaling_factor = rope_parameters["factor"]
+            mscale = yarn_get_mscale(scaling_factor, float(mscale_all_dim))
+            self.scaling = self.scaling * mscale * mscale
+
+        # The output gate is full-rank (v_head_dim * num_heads), same shape
+        # as the dense Kimi-K3 MLA's g_proj.
+        if config.mla_use_output_gate:
+            self.g_proj = ColumnParallelLinear(
+                self.hidden_size,
+                self.v_head_dim * self.num_heads,
+                bias=False,
+                quant_config=quant_config,
+                prefix=f"{prefix}.g_proj",
+            )
+
+        dsa_config = config.dsa_config
+        self.index_topk = dsa_config.index_topk
+        self.index_head_dim = dsa_config.index_head_dim
+        self.index_num_heads = dsa_config.index_num_heads
+        self.index_rope_dim = dsa_config.index_rope_dim
+        if self.index_rope_dim > 0 and self.use_nope:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "dsa_config.index_rope_dim > 0 is incompatible with "
+                "mla_use_nope (there is no rotary cache to share)"
+            )
+        if self.index_rope_dim > min(self.qk_rope_head_dim, self.index_head_dim):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"dsa_config.index_rope_dim ({self.index_rope_dim}) must "
+                f"not exceed min(qk_rope_head_dim={self.qk_rope_head_dim}, "
+                f"index_head_dim={self.index_head_dim})"
+            )
+
+        vllm_config = get_current_vllm_config()
+        if topk_indices_buffer is None:
+            # Fallback for hosts that build KimiDecoderLayer directly:
+            # allocate a private buffer. The main model path always passes
+            # the single model-level buffer created in KimiLinearModel.
+            logger.warning_once(
+                "KimiK3DSAAttention did not receive a model-level "
+                "topk_indices_buffer; allocating a per-layer fallback."
+            )
+            topk_buffer_device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
+            # Same guard as KimiLinearModel's model-level buffer: in
+            # allgather_k mode prefill rows are padded to ceil(P/W) per rank,
+            # so the all-gathered output takes num_decode_tokens +
+            # W*ceil(P/W) rows, at most W-1 more than num_actual_tokens.
+            dcp_world_size = vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
+            dcp_kg_slack = dcp_world_size - 1 if dcp_world_size > 1 else 0
+            topk_indices_buffer = torch.empty(
+                (
+                    vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens + dcp_kg_slack,
+                    self.index_topk,
+                ),
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=topk_buffer_device,
+            )
+        self.topk_indices_buffer = topk_indices_buffer
+

+        # attention front-end on the aux stream for small batches.

+            self._gate_events is not None
+            and hidden_states.shape[0] < _GATE_MULTI_STREAM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD

+                lambda: self.g_proj(hidden_states)[0],

+                self.aux_stream,

+        input_weight, query_weight = self._packed

+            hidden_states, input_weight
+        ).split(
+            [
+                self.q_lora_rank,
+                self.kv_lora_rank,
+                self.qk_rope_head_dim,
+                indexer.index_head_dim,
+                indexer.index_num_heads,
+            ],
+            dim=-1,
+        )
+
+        # Profile / dummy runs have no metadata and leave both caches alone.
+        caches: tuple = (None, None, None, None)
+        has_prefills = False
+        forward_context = get_forward_context()
+        attn_metadata = forward_context.attn_metadata
+        if isinstance(attn_metadata, dict) and attn.kv_cache.numel() > 0:
+            assert isinstance(forward_context.slot_mapping, dict)
+            has_prefills = cast(Any, attn_metadata[attn.layer_name]).num_prefills > 0
+            index_metadata = attn_metadata[indexer.k_cache.prefix]
+            assert isinstance(index_metadata, v32_indexer.DeepseekV32IndexerMetadata)
+            caches = (
+                attn.kv_cache,
+                forward_context.slot_mapping[attn.layer_name],
+                indexer.k_cache.kv_cache,
+                index_metadata.slot_mapping,
+            )
+        assert indexer.topk_indices_buffer is not None
+        k_norm = cast(KimiK3DSAIndexerKNorm, indexer.k_index_norm)
+        # One eps for the three norms (equal, checked in pack_projections).
+        prologue = dsa_fused_prologue
+        if indexer.use_fp4_cache:
+            prologue = mxfp4_fused_prologue
+        q_c, kv_c_normed = prologue(
+            q_c,
+            kv_c,
+            k_pe,
+            index_k,
+            self.q_a_layernorm.weight,
+            self.kv_a_layernorm.weight,
+            k_norm.weight,
+            k_norm.bias,
+            k_norm.eps,
+            indexer.topk_indices_buffer,
+            *caches,
+        )
+
+        q, index_q = low_latency_linear(q_c, query_weight).split(
+            [
+                self.num_local_heads * self.qk_head_dim,
+                indexer.index_num_heads * indexer.index_head_dim,
+            ],
+            dim=-1,
+        )

+            # q is a column slice; some MHA prefill backends need it contiguous.
+            q = q.contiguous()

+        attn.impl.record_logical_topk_ready()
+
+        output = torch.empty(
+            (hidden_states.shape[0], self.num_local_heads * self.v_head_dim),
+            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
+            device=hidden_states.device,
+        )
+        torch.ops.vllm.unified_mla_attention_with_output(
+            q,
+            kv_c_normed,
+            k_pe.unsqueeze(1),
+            output,
+            _encode_layer_name(attn.layer_name),
+        )
+        return output

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""GQA drafts (e.g. a Qwen3 sliding-window DSpark) on Kimi-K3: their KV cache grouping.
+
+Dense MLA drafts keep their own MLA cache (``dense_draft.py``)."""
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.model_executor.models.interfaces import SupportsKVCacheGrouping
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    AttentionSpec,
+    KVCacheGroupSpec,
+    KVCacheSpec,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+)
+
+# A multiple of K3.1's 64-token prefix-hash unit. Draft blocks also divide the
+# target's block, so the scheduler block (their LCM) does not change.
+_DRAFT_BLOCK_ALIGN = 64
+
+
+def _fit_draft_page(spec: AttentionSpec, page_size: int) -> AttentionSpec:
+    """Shrink a draft's block until its page fits under ``page_size``."""
+    for block_size in range(spec.block_size, 0, -_DRAFT_BLOCK_ALIGN):
+        fitted = replace(spec, block_size=block_size)
+        if spec.block_size % block_size == 0 and fitted.page_size_bytes <= page_size:
+            return fitted
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"No draft block size fits the target's {page_size}-byte KV page: {spec}"
+    )
+
+
+class GQADraftKVCacheGrouping(SupportsKVCacheGrouping):
+    """Kimi-K3's KV cache grouping when a GQA draft is attached; otherwise the
+    default grouping.
+
+    Kimi-K3's own layers are KDA (Mamba) and MLA, so any other attention layer
+    belongs to a draft. All groups share one page size and MLA pages cannot be
+    padded, so the draft's page must fit under the target's. With all KV heads
+    on one rank (attention TP1 under DP) it does not, and the draft gets the
+    largest block that fits. Grouping the draft on its own also keeps the
+    target's groups: the default grouping sizes every group by the draft's few
+    layers (20 groups instead of 4 + 1 for a 5-layer draft).
+    """
+
+    @classmethod
+    def get_kv_cache_groups(
+        cls,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        kv_cache_spec: dict[str, KVCacheSpec],
+    ) -> list[KVCacheGroupSpec]:
+        from vllm.v1.core.kv_cache_planning import (
+            get_kv_cache_groups,
+            unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size,
+        )
+
+        draft = {
+            name: spec
+            for name, spec in kv_cache_spec.items()
+            if isinstance(spec, AttentionSpec)
+            and not isinstance(spec, MLAAttentionSpec)
+        }
+        target = {n: s for n, s in kv_cache_spec.items() if n not in draft}
+        layout = vllm_config.cache_config.get_resolved_kv_cache_layout()
+        if not draft or not target or layout.is_block_outermost:
+            return get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, kv_cache_spec)
+        page_size = max(spec.page_size_bytes for spec in target.values())
+        draft = {n: _fit_draft_page(s, page_size) for n, s in draft.items()}
+        specs = unify_kv_cache_spec_page_size(target | draft)
+        return get_kv_cache_groups(
+            vllm_config, {n: specs[n] for n in target}
+        ) + get_kv_cache_groups(vllm_config, {n: specs[n] for n in draft})
