+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ShardQ prefill steps under DCP: attention over a gathered context.
+
+DCP shards the KV cache by token, so a DCP prefill step runs every query token
+with all heads against each rank's 1/W of the keys, merges the indexer's
+per-rank top-k across ranks, and combines the attention partials by LSE: per
+layer it moves gigabytes and repeats the attention work W times over.
+
+When the TP group is the DCP group, a pure prefill step can instead run as a
+TP ShardQ step (vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq): each rank gathers its requests'
+whole context into a symmetric-memory workspace, in token order and in the
+paged formats of the MLA and indexer caches, then scores and attends its slice
+of the query tokens with all heads over the workspace, exactly as TP ShardQ
+does over a replicated cache. No top-k merge and no LSE combine remain.
+
+Per layer, the indexer pushes every rank's owned rows of the step's requests
+into all workspaces (prior-context MLA and indexer rows, plus the indexer rows
+of the new tokens); the MLA layer then writes the new tokens' MLA rows, which
+every rank computes for all tokens, into its own workspace.
+
+A step runs this way when its prefill rows fit the workspace. Its leading
+decode rows (rows of at most ``1 + num_speculative_tokens`` tokens, which the
+indexer scores on its decode path) keep the DCP path within the step; its
+other rows are sharded, including the short prefill pieces that the sparse
+MLA backend classifies as decodes. The workspace holds the prefill rows'
+requests only. ``DcpShardQPlanner`` decides, and counts the prefill steps and
+tokens of each path.
+
+Scope: any sparse MLA layer with a DSA-style fp8 indexer cache, under DCP
+with the DCP group equal to the TP group; nothing here is model-specific.
+"""
+
+import time
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.distributed.parallel_state import get_tp_group
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.math_utils import round_up
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import get_dtype_size
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.indexer import (
+    DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder,
+    DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata,
+    build_prefill_chunk_metadata,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.sparse_utils import (
+    ConvertReqIndexToGlobalIndexKernel,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import dcp_a2a_lse_reduce
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_shardq import PAGE_TOKENS
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.shardq import (
+    ShardQSplit,
+    _symm_buffer,
+    _SymmBuffer,
+    make_shardq_split,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import KVCacheSpec, MLAAttentionSpec
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import MLADCPManager
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# Workspace block tables are padded to whole multiples of this many pages, so
+# their row stride has one Triton specialization.
+TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN = 16
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class ContextLayout:
+    """Per-token bytes of a DSA layer's MLA and indexer caches."""
+
+    mla_row_bytes: int
+    index_row_bytes: int
+    index_scale_bytes: int
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_layer(cls, spec: KVCacheSpec, indexer: object) -> "ContextLayout | None":
+        """The layout of a DSA layer that DCP ShardQ steps can gather, or None.
+
+        The MLA cache must keep one-byte elements (per-tensor ``fp8``,
+        ``nvfp4_ds_mla``) in kernel blocks of whole 64-token pages (a packed
+        cache may use e.g. 1024-token blocks), and the indexer fp8 keys
+        with one 4-byte scale per ``quant_block_size`` values (or MXFP4 keys:
+        64 B of values and 4 B of scales per token).
+        """
+        k_cache = getattr(indexer, "k_cache", None)
+        quant_block = getattr(indexer, "quant_block_size", 0)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(spec, MLAAttentionSpec)
+            or get_dtype_size(spec.dtype) != 1
+            or spec.block_size % PAGE_TOKENS
+            or k_cache is None
+            or not quant_block
+        ):
+            return None
+        if getattr(indexer, "use_fp4_cache", False):
+            # MXFP4 keys: head_dim / 2 B of E2M1 values and one UE8M0 scale per
+            # 32 values (17 / 32 B per dim), pages of the values then the scales
+            # (as the fp8 layout).
+            index_row = k_cache.head_dim * 16 // 17
+        else:
+            # fp8 keys with one 4-byte scale per quant_block values.
+            index_row = k_cache.head_dim * quant_block // (quant_block + 4)
+        return cls(
+            spec.state_content_size_bytes, index_row, k_cache.head_dim - index_row
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def mla_page_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return PAGE_TOKENS * self.mla_row_bytes
+
+    @property
+    def index_page_bytes(self) -> int:
+        return PAGE_TOKENS * (self.index_row_bytes + self.index_scale_bytes)
+
+
+def workspace_max_tokens(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> int:
+    """Tokens of context the workspace holds: ``max_model_len``, so any one
+    request fits. It costs about ``mla_row_bytes + index_row_bytes`` (plus
+    the index scales) per token on each rank, ~0.7 GB per 1M tokens with a
+    per-tensor ``fp8`` cache and ~0.5 GB with ``nvfp4_ds_mla``. Call it
+    through this module so tests can patch it."""
+    return vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len
+
+
+def capacity_pages(max_tokens: int, max_reqs: int) -> int:
+    """Workspace pages for ``max_tokens`` tokens, each request rounded up."""
+    return -(-max_tokens // PAGE_TOKENS) + max_reqs
+
+
+def scheduler_context_pages(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> int | None:
+    """The workspace pages the scheduler keeps each step's prefill rows
+    within (the sum over them of ``ceil(seq_len / 64)``), or None when DCP
+    ShardQ steps cannot run under this configuration.
+
+    With the cap, no step finds the workspace full, so the DCP path only runs
+    a step's leading decode rows and steps of fewer than
+    ``sparse_mla_shard_q_min_tokens`` prefill tokens, and the memory profile
+    reserves those (``dcp_fallback_max_tokens``) instead of a whole
+    ``max_num_batched_tokens`` step. These are the configuration-level and
+    platform conditions of SparseMLAShardQ's DCP ShardQ; when its layer-level
+    ones fail the cap merely keeps a step's prefill context within
+    ``max_model_len``.
+    """
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    kv_transfer_config = vllm_config.kv_transfer_config
+    dcp = parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
+    if (
+        not vllm_config.attention_config.sparse_mla_shard_q
+        or dcp <= 1
+        or dcp != parallel_config.tensor_parallel_size
+        or parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size != 1
+        or parallel_config.use_ubatching
+        or not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        or parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size != 1
+        or (
+            kv_transfer_config is not None
+            and kv_transfer_config.kv_role == "kv_consumer"
+        )
+    ):
+        return None
+    return capacity_pages(
+        workspace_max_tokens(vllm_config), vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_seqs
+    )
+
+
+def dcp_fallback_max_tokens(vllm_config: "VllmConfig", decode_query_len: int) -> int:
+    """Most tokens of a step that keeps the DCP path under DCP ShardQ, given
+    the scheduler's context cap: its leading decode rows plus fewer than
+    ``sparse_mla_shard_q_min_tokens`` prefill tokens, or a padded step of at
+    most the DCP workspace's tokens."""
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import get_dcp_workspace_max_num_tokens
+
+    scheduler_config = vllm_config.scheduler_config
+    few_tokens = (
+        scheduler_config.max_num_seqs * decode_query_len
+        + vllm_config.attention_config.sparse_mla_shard_q_min_tokens
+        - 1
+    )
+    return min(
+        scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
+        max(few_tokens, get_dcp_workspace_max_num_tokens(vllm_config)),
+    )
+
+
+def _workspace(layout: ContextLayout, pages: int, device) -> _SymmBuffer:
+    # Sizes come from the configuration, so every rank rendezvouses together.
+    nbytes = pages * (layout.mla_page_bytes + layout.index_page_bytes)
+    return _symm_buffer(
+        get_tp_group().device_group, "dcp_shardq_context", nbytes, torch.uint8, device
+    )
+
+
+def reserve_workspace(
+    layout: ContextLayout, max_tokens: int, max_reqs: int, device: torch.device
+) -> None:
+    """Allocate the workspace in the memory profile; symmetric memory lives
+    outside the torch caching allocator, so it counts as non-torch memory."""
+    _workspace(layout, capacity_pages(max_tokens, max_reqs), device)
+
+
+# The (group, step shape) keys warm_up_dcp_fallback ran.
+_WARMED_UP_DCP_FALLBACK: set[tuple[Any, ...]] = set()
+
+
+def warm_up_dcp_fallback(dcp_manager: "MLADCPManager", num_tokens: int) -> None:
+    """Run ``dcp_manager``'s query gather and output combine of a step of
+    ``num_tokens`` tokens, and the combine's Triton kernels for every batch
+    size, on dummy inputs (once per process and shape).
+
+    A DCP ShardQ instance takes most prefill steps off the DCP path, so the
+    steps that keep it (decode rows, few tokens, a full workspace) may come
+    only late, after the KV cache and the caching allocator took the memory.
+    Beyond the direct workspaces the DCP path falls back to NCCL collectives,
+    which connect their peers and allocate their buffers on first use, and its
+    Triton kernels compile on first use; calling this in the memory profile
+    run makes both happen there and accounts for them. Every rank of the
+    group must call it.
+    """
+    world = dcp_manager.group.world_size
+    key = (
+        dcp_manager.group.unique_name,
+        num_tokens,
+        dcp_manager.num_heads,
+        dcp_manager.query_head_dim,
+        dcp_manager.output_head_dim,
+        dcp_manager.query_dtype,
+        dcp_manager.output_dtype,
+        dcp_manager.is_lse_base_on_e,
+    )
+    if world == 1 or key in _WARMED_UP_DCP_FALLBACK:
+        return
+    _WARMED_UP_DCP_FALLBACK.add(key)
+    # The gathered query stays alive while the attention writes its partial
+    # output and the combine runs, as in a real step.
+    gathered_query = None
+    if dcp_manager.query_gather is not None:
+        gathered_query = dcp_manager.query_gather(
+            torch.zeros(
+                (num_tokens, dcp_manager.num_heads, dcp_manager.query_head_dim),
+                dtype=dcp_manager.query_dtype,
+                device=dcp_manager.device,
+            )
+        )
+    # Every head's partial output, as the attention backend returns it.
+    partial_output = torch.zeros(
+        (num_tokens, world * dcp_manager.num_heads, dcp_manager.output_head_dim),
+        dtype=dcp_manager.output_dtype,
+        device=dcp_manager.device,
+    )
+    partial_lse = torch.zeros(
+        partial_output.shape[:2], dtype=torch.float32, device=dcp_manager.device
+    )
+
+    def batch(num_tokens: int, num_seqs: int) -> dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
+        # num_seqs requests of one token each, the last one taking the rest.
+        query_start_loc = torch.arange(
+            num_seqs + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=dcp_manager.device
+        )
+        query_start_loc[-1] = num_tokens
+        seq_lens = torch.ones(num_seqs, dtype=torch.int32, device=dcp_manager.device)
+        return dict(seq_lens=seq_lens, query_start_loc=query_start_loc)
+
+    dcp_manager.combine(partial_output, partial_lse, **batch(num_tokens, 1))
+    if dcp_manager.use_a2a and (
+        dcp_manager.direct_a2a is None
+        or num_tokens > dcp_manager.direct_a2a.max_num_tokens
+    ):
+        # The NCCL A2A's pack kernel compiles once per power-of-two
+        # bucket of the batch's requests, and both its kernels once per
+        # alignment of the per-rank stride of their buffers, a multiple of
+        # the token count: a multiple of 16 tokens takes one, an odd count
+        # the other one (if any).
+        num_seqs = 1
+        while num_seqs < 2 * dcp_manager.max_num_seqs and num_seqs <= num_tokens:
+            for rows in (round_up(num_seqs, 16), num_seqs | 1):
+                if rows > num_tokens:
+                    continue
+                dcp_a2a_lse_reduce(
+                    partial_output[:rows],
+                    partial_lse[:rows],
+                    cp_group=dcp_manager.group,
+                    is_lse_base_on_e=dcp_manager.is_lse_base_on_e,
+                    **batch(rows, num_seqs),
+                )
+            num_seqs *= 2
+    del gathered_query
+    logger.info_once("Warmed up the MLA DCP collectives of %d-token steps.", num_tokens)
+
+
+@dataclass
+class DcpShardQContext:
+    """One step's gathered-context plan (see the module docstring).
+
+    The workspace holds ``pages`` MLA pages, then as many indexer pages.
+    """
+
+    layout: ContextLayout
+    world: int
+    rank: int
+    pages: int
+    # The step's leading decode rows, which keep the DCP path: its requests
+    # before num_decodes and its tokens before num_decode_tokens.
+    num_decodes: int
+    num_decode_tokens: int
+    # The prefill rows' requests: int32 sequence lengths and query start
+    # locations, on the device.
+    seq_lens: torch.Tensor
+    query_start_loc: torch.Tensor
+    # Most local 64-token pages of any prefill request on any rank.
+    max_local_pages: int
+    # int32 [num_reqs, width]: workspace page of each prefill request's
+    # 64-token block, addressed like a paged block table by the step's request
+    # index (width a multiple of TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN; decode rows' rows unused).
+    block_table: torch.Tensor
+    # int64 [num_prefill_tokens]: workspace slot of each new prefill token.
+    slot_mapping: torch.Tensor
+    # Indexer prefill chunks over the workspace, in the non-DCP form.
+    indexer_chunks: list[DeepseekV32IndexerPrefillChunkMetadata]
+
+    # The workspace's pages of 64 tokens address its views and block table.
+    block_size = PAGE_TOKENS
+
+    def _view(self, dtype: torch.dtype, offset: int, row_bytes: int, device):
+        """The workspace pages at ``offset`` as a [pages, 64, row] cache."""
+        storage = _workspace(self.layout, self.pages, device).storage
+        return torch.as_strided(
+            storage.view(dtype),
+            (self.pages, PAGE_TOKENS, row_bytes),
+            (PAGE_TOKENS * row_bytes, row_bytes, 1),
+            offset,
+        )
+
+    def mla_view(self, mla_cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The workspace's MLA pages, typed as ``mla_cache``."""
+        layout = self.layout
+        return self._view(mla_cache.dtype, 0, layout.mla_row_bytes, mla_cache.device)
+
+    def index_view(self, index_cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The workspace's indexer pages, typed as ``index_cache``."""
+        layout = self.layout
+        return self._view(

+                DCP_CONTEXT_PUSH_KERNEL,

+            first = self.num_decodes

+        buffer.handle.barrier()

+def build_dcp_shardq_context(
+    common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+    layout: ContextLayout,
+    max_pages: int,
+    max_indexer_keys: int,
+    max_logits_bytes: int,
+    world: int,
+    rank: int,
+    device: torch.device,
+    num_decodes: int = 0,
+) -> DcpShardQContext | None:
+    """The context plan of a step's prefill rows (its requests from
+    ``num_decodes`` on) on DCP rank ``rank`` of ``world``, or None when they
+    do not fit the ``max_pages`` workspace pages.
+
+    Every rank derives the same plan; the push kernel finds each rank's rows
+    from the step's device sequence lengths.
+    """
+    num_reqs = common_attn_metadata.num_reqs
+    query_start_loc_cpu = common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc_cpu[: num_reqs + 1]
+    seq_lens_cpu = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound
+    assert seq_lens_cpu is not None
+    # Exact for prefill rows.
+    seq_lens_cpu = seq_lens_cpu[:num_reqs]
+    qsl = query_start_loc_cpu.numpy().astype(np.int64)[num_decodes:]
+    num_decode_tokens = int(qsl[0])
+    query_lens = np.diff(qsl)
+    seq_lens = seq_lens_cpu.numpy().astype(np.int64)[num_decodes:]
+    pages = -(-seq_lens // PAGE_TOKENS)
+    if pages.sum() > max_pages:
+        return None
+    page_start = np.cumsum(pages) - pages
+
+    context_lens = seq_lens - query_lens
+    # Rank 0 holds the most rows: ceil(seq_len / world).
+    max_local_pages = -(-int(seq_lens.max()) // (world * PAGE_TOKENS))
+    # Columns past a request's pages are never addressed.
+    width = -(-int(pages.max()) // TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN) * TABLE_PAGES_ALIGN
+    block_table = np.zeros((num_reqs, width), dtype=np.int64)
+    block_table[num_decodes:] = page_start[:, None] + np.arange(width)
+    slot_mapping = np.repeat(
+        page_start * PAGE_TOKENS + context_lens - (qsl[:-1] - qsl[0]), query_lens
+    ) + np.arange(int(qsl[-1] - qsl[0]))
+
+    def to_device(array: np.ndarray, dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+        host = torch.from_numpy(np.ascontiguousarray(array)).to(dtype)
+        if device.type == "cuda":
+            host = host.pin_memory()
+        return host.to(device, non_blocking=True)
+
+    block_table_gpu = to_device(block_table, torch.int32)
+    seq_lens_gpu = common_attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_reqs]
+    chunk_specs = DeepseekV32IndexerMetadataBuilder._split_indexer_prefill_chunks(
+        seq_lens_cpu[num_decodes:],
+        torch.from_numpy(query_lens),
+        max_indexer_keys,
+        max_logits_bytes,
+    )
+    indexer_chunks = [
+        build_prefill_chunk_metadata(
+            num_decodes + req_slice.start,
+            num_decodes + req_slice.stop,
+            common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc,
+            query_start_loc_cpu,
+            seq_lens_gpu,
+            seq_lens_gpu,
+            seq_lens_cpu,
+            block_table_gpu,
+            1,
+            query_slice=query_slice,
+            skip_kv_gather=query_slice.start > 0,
+        )
+        for req_slice, query_slice in chunk_specs
+    ]
+    return DcpShardQContext(
+        layout=layout,
+        world=world,
+        rank=rank,
+        pages=max_pages,
+        num_decodes=num_decodes,
+        num_decode_tokens=num_decode_tokens,
+        seq_lens=seq_lens_gpu[num_decodes:],
+        query_start_loc=common_attn_metadata.query_start_loc[
+            num_decodes : num_reqs + 1
+        ],
+        max_local_pages=max_local_pages,
+        block_table=block_table_gpu,
+        slot_mapping=to_device(slot_mapping, torch.int64),
+        indexer_chunks=[chunk for chunk in indexer_chunks if chunk is not None],
+    )

+class DcpShardQStats:
+    """Steps with prefill rows, and their prefill tokens, by path: ShardQ, or
+    the DCP path and why. Rank 0 logs them at most every
+    VLLM_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL seconds, for the steps since its previous report
+    and in total, labeled with the layers of the metadata builder that plans
+    them. Every step the builder plans counts, the runner's profile and warmup
+    steps included."""

+        self.last_report = time.monotonic()
+        # Path -> [steps, tokens].
+        self.recent: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+        self.total: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
+
+    def record(self, path: str, num_tokens: int) -> None:
+        for counts in (self.recent, self.total):
+            entry = counts.setdefault(path, [0, 0])
+            entry[0] += 1
+            entry[1] += num_tokens
+        if self.log:
+            now = time.monotonic()
+            if now - self.last_report >= self.interval:
+                self.last_report = now
+                logger.info("%s", self.report())
+                self.recent.clear()
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _share(counts: dict[str, list[int]]) -> tuple[int, int, int, int]:
+        steps, tokens = counts.get(SHARDQ, (0, 0))
+        all_steps = sum(c[0] for c in counts.values())
+        all_tokens = sum(c[1] for c in counts.values())
+        return steps, all_steps, tokens, all_tokens
+
+    def report(self) -> str:
+        steps, all_steps, tokens, all_tokens = self._share(self.recent)
+        _, _, total_tokens, total_all = self._share(self.total)
+        fallback = ", ".join(
+            f"{path} {c[0]} steps / {c[1]} tokens"
+            for path, c in sorted(self.recent.items())
+            if path != SHARDQ
+        )
+        return (
+            f"DCP ShardQ prefill{f' [{self.label}]' if self.label else ''}: "
+            f"{steps}/{all_steps} steps, "
+            f"{tokens}/{all_tokens} tokens "
+            f"({100 * tokens / max(all_tokens, 1):.1f}%; "
+            f"{100 * total_tokens / max(total_all, 1):.1f}% since start) on "
+            f"ShardQ; DCP path: {fallback or 'none'}"
+        )

+class DcpShardQPlanner:
+    """Plans the DCP ShardQ steps of one metadata builder (see the module
+    docstring); every rank reaches the same decisions from the same batch."""

+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        layout: ContextLayout,
+        max_pages: int,
+        max_indexer_keys: int,
+        max_logits_bytes: int,
+        min_tokens: int,
+        max_decode_query_len: int,
+        world: int,
+        rank: int,
+        device: torch.device,
+        label: str = "",
+        max_fallback_tokens: int | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.layout = layout
+        # Most tokens of a DCP-path step the memory profile reserved.
+        self.max_fallback_tokens = (
+            max_fallback_tokens if max_fallback_tokens is not None else 1 << 62
+        )
+        self.max_pages = max_pages
+        self.max_indexer_keys = max_indexer_keys
+        self.max_logits_bytes = max_logits_bytes
+        self.min_tokens = min_tokens
+        self.max_decode_query_len = max_decode_query_len
+        self.world = world

+        self.device = device

+        """The prefill rows' token split and context plan of a step that runs
+        as a DCP ShardQ step, or None for the DCP path.
+
+        The step's leading decode rows (the requests of at most
+        ``max_decode_query_len`` tokens before its first longer one, which the
+        indexer scores on its decode path) keep the DCP path; the split and
+        the plan cover the rest. A step without prefill rows is not counted.
+
+        ``use_dense_mha``: the step's prefill rows take dense MHA.

+"""Push a DCP rank's context rows into every rank's gathered workspace.
+
+Under DCP (interleave 1) rank ``r`` of ``W`` stores global token ``t`` iff
+``t % W == r``, at local position ``t // W`` of its paged caches: a DSA layer's
+MLA cache (one row per token) and its indexer cache (64-token pages of fp8
+keys, then their scales). This kernel copies the rank's rows, byte for byte, to
+their global positions in every rank's workspace (peer addresses, e.g.
+symmetric memory), which holds each request's tokens in order in dense pages of
+the same two formats. The work comes from the step's device metadata: CTA
+row ``r`` of the grid serves request ``r``, and each CTA moves eight rows of one
+of its local pages (CTAs past the request's rows exit).
+"""

+from typing import Any

+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_v4(address: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> tuple[Int32, ...]:
+    out = llvm.inline_asm(
+        llvm.StructType.get_literal([T.i32()] * 4),
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "ld.global.nc.L1::no_allocate.v4.u32 {$0, $1, $2, $3}, [$4];",
+        "=r,=r,=r,=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+    return tuple(
+        Int32(llvm.extractvalue(T.i32(), out, [i], loc=loc, ip=ip)) for i in range(4)
+    )
+

+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_v4(
+    address: Int64, a: Int32, b: Int32, c: Int32, d: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None
+) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(
+        None,
+        [
+            address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            a.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            b.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            c.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+            d.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip),
+        ],
+        "st.global.v4.u32 [$0], {$1, $2, $3, $4};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+

+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_u32(address: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int32:
+    out = llvm.inline_asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        [address.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip)],
+        "ld.global.nc.u32 $0, [$1];",
+        "=r,l",
+        has_side_effects=False,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        asm_dialect=llvm.AsmDialect.AD_ATT,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,

+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_u32(address: Int64, value: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    llvm.inline_asm(

+        "l,r",
+        has_side_effects=True,

+class DcpContextPushKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel["DcpContextPushKernel.CompileKey"]):
+    num_threads = 128
+    rows_per_cta = 8

+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class CompileKey:
+        world: int
+        mla_row_bytes: int
+        index_row_bytes: int
+        index_scale_bytes: int

+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(compile_key: CompileKey) -> Any:
+        num_threads = DcpContextPushKernel.num_threads
+        rows_per_cta = DcpContextPushKernel.rows_per_cta

+                    + section
+                    + Int64(token % PAGE_TOKENS) * row_bytes

+        @cute.jit
+        def page_address(
+            base: Int64,
+            block_stride: Int64,
+            pages_per_block: Int32,
+            block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            req: Int32,
+            page: Int32,
+            page_bytes: int,
+        ) -> Int64:
+            block = Int64(block_table[req, page // pages_per_block])
+            in_block = Int64((page % pages_per_block) * page_bytes)
+            return base + block * block_stride + in_block

+        @cute.kernel

+            mla_base: Int64,

+            index_base: Int64,
+            index_block_stride: Int64,
+            index_block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            seq_lens: cute.Tensor,

+        ):
+            tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()

+            page = bidx // ctas_per_page
+            row0 = (bidx % ctas_per_page) * rows_per_cta
+            # The request's local rows: tokens t < n with t % world == rank.
+            # Its MLA rows stop at the prior context, since every rank writes
+            # the new tokens' MLA rows itself.
+            seq_len = seq_lens[req]
+            context_len = seq_len - (query_start_loc[req + 1] - query_start_loc[req])

+                mla_dst = [Int64(dst_addrs[d]) for d in range(world)]
+                index_dst = [
+                    Int64(dst_addrs[d]) + dst_index_offset for d in range(world)
+                ]
+
+                mla_src = page_address(
+                    mla_base,
+                    mla_block_stride,
+                    mla_pages_per_block,
+                    mla_block_table,
+                    req,
+                    page,
+                    mla_page,

+                copy_rows(
+                    mla_src,
+                    mla_dst,
+                    dst_page,
+                    rank,
+                    row0,
+                    num_mla,
+                    mla_page,
+                    0,
+                    mla_row,

+                index_src = (
+                    index_base
+                    + Int64(index_block_table[req, page]) * index_block_stride
+                )

+                    index_src,
+                    index_dst,
+                    dst_page,

+                    row0,
+                    num_index,
+                    index_page,
+                    0,
+                    index_row,
+                )
+                if tidx < num_index:
+                    i = row0 + tidx
+                    token = i * world + rank
+                    scale = _ld_u32(index_src + scale_offset + Int64(i) * scale_bytes)
+                    dst_offset = (
+                        (dst_page + Int64(token // PAGE_TOKENS)) * index_page
+                        + scale_offset
+                        + Int64(token % PAGE_TOKENS) * scale_bytes
+                    )
+                    for d in cutlass.range_constexpr(world):
+                        _st_u32(index_dst[d] + dst_offset, scale)
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def host_entrypoint(
+            mla_base: Int64,
+            mla_block_stride: Int64,
+            mla_pages_per_block: Int32,
+            mla_block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            index_base: Int64,
+            index_block_stride: Int64,
+            index_block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            seq_lens: cute.Tensor,
+            query_start_loc: cute.Tensor,
+            dst_block_table: cute.Tensor,
+            dst_addrs: cute.Tensor,
+            dst_index_offset: Int64,
+            rank: Int32,
+            max_local_pages: Int32,
+            stream: CUstream,
+        ):
+            device_kernel(
+                mla_base,
+                mla_block_stride,
+                mla_pages_per_block,
+                mla_block_table,
+                index_base,
+                index_block_stride,
+                index_block_table,
+                seq_lens,
+                query_start_loc,
+                dst_block_table,
+                dst_addrs,
+                dst_index_offset,
+                rank,
+            ).launch(
+                grid=(max_local_pages * ctas_per_page, seq_lens.shape[0], 1),
+                block=(num_threads, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+        return host_entrypoint
+
+    def dispatch(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        *,
+        world: int,
+        mla_row_bytes: int,
+        index_row_bytes: int,
+        index_scale_bytes: int,
+    ) -> CompileKey:
+        return self.CompileKey(
+            world=world,
+            mla_row_bytes=mla_row_bytes,
+            index_row_bytes=index_row_bytes,
+            index_scale_bytes=index_scale_bytes,
+        )
+
+    # The JIT warmup registry passes a registration's keywords through as is
+    # (vllm_config only to a registration without arguments).
+    def get_warmup_keys(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self,
+        *,
+        world: int,
+        mla_row_bytes: int,
+        index_row_bytes: int,
+        index_scale_bytes: int,
+    ) -> list[CompileKey]:
+        return [
+            self.dispatch(
+                world=world,
+                mla_row_bytes=mla_row_bytes,
+                index_row_bytes=index_row_bytes,
+                index_scale_bytes=index_scale_bytes,
+            )
+        ]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, compile_key: CompileKey) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        def table():
+            return cute.runtime.make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32,
+                (cute.sym_int(), cute.sym_int()),
+                stride=(cute.sym_int(), 1),
+                assumed_align=4,
+            )
+
+        def vector():
+            return make_fake_tensor(Int32, (cute.sym_int(),))
+
+        dst_addrs = make_fake_tensor(Int64, (compile_key.world,))
+        return (
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(1),
+            table(),
+            Int64(0),
+            Int64(0),
+            table(),
+            vector(),
+            vector(),
+            table(),
+            dst_addrs,
+            Int64(0),
+            Int32(0),
+            Int32(1),
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        mla_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        mla_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        index_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        index_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        seq_lens: torch.Tensor,
+        query_start_loc: torch.Tensor,
+        dst_block_table: torch.Tensor,
+        max_local_pages: int,
+        dst_addrs: torch.Tensor,
+        dst_index_offset: int,
+        rank: int,
+        index_row_bytes: int,

+        """Push this rank's rows of the first ``seq_lens`` tokens of each

+            PAGE_TOKENS

+            mla_cache.stride(0),
+            mla_cache.shape[1] // PAGE_TOKENS,
+            mla_block_table,
+            index_cache.data_ptr(),
+            index_cache.stride(0),
+            index_block_table,
+            seq_lens,
+            query_start_loc,
+            dst_block_table,
+            dst_addrs,
+            dst_index_offset,
+            rank,
+            max_local_pages,
+        )
+
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

+"""One-round DCP decode top-k merge for the DSA indexer.
+
+The kernels live in ``kernels.py`` (imports CuTe DSL); this module only holds
+the configuration helpers so model construction stays import-light.
+
+Packed candidate rows (the "B'" layout), int32 ``[T, N + N/32]`` per rank,
+N a multiple of 32, local index ``l`` = the token's position in this rank's
+shard (global id ``l * W + rank``, interleave 1), ``l < 2**17``:
+
+- word ``j < N``: ``(ord16(s) << 16) | (0xFFFF - (l & 0xFFFF))`` as uint32,
+  where ``s`` is the bf16 score bits and ``ord16(s) = s | 0x8000`` for
+  ``s >= 0`` (sign bit clear), ``~s & 0xFFFF`` otherwise (order-preserving:
+  a larger score gives a larger ``ord16``). ``0`` marks an empty slot; slots
+  may be in any order and empty ones anywhere.
+- word ``N + j // 32``, bit ``j % 32``: bit 16 of ``l`` for candidate ``j``.
+"""
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.import_utils import has_cutedsl
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+# The packed candidate word keeps local[15:0]; a bit plane carries local[16].
+LOCAL_INDEX_BITS = 17
+# The saturation word holds a 16-bit rank mask.
+MAX_WORLD_SIZE = 16
+_WARP = 32
+
+
+def dcp_merge_local_topk(topk: int, world_size: int) -> int:
+    """Per-rank candidate count N: 1.5x the fair share ``topk / world_size``,
+    warp-aligned. 0 when it would not be smaller than ``topk``."""
+    fair_share = -(-topk // world_size)
+    local_topk = -(-(3 * fair_share) // (2 * _WARP)) * _WARP
+    return local_topk if local_topk < topk else 0
+
+
+def packed_row_words(local_topk: int) -> int:
+    """int32 words per packed row: N candidate words + N/32 bit-plane words."""
+    return local_topk + local_topk // _WARP
+
+
+def dcp_topk_merge_local_topk(vllm_config: Any, topk: int) -> int:
+    """N for the one-round DCP decode top-k merge, or 0 when it is unavailable
+    (no DCP, more than ``MAX_WORLD_SIZE`` DCP ranks, PCP, a top-k backend
+    other than auto / deep_select, not SM100, no CuTe DSL / DeepSelect, or
+    local token indices that do not fit ``LOCAL_INDEX_BITS``)."""
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    world_size = parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
+    max_local_len = -(-vllm_config.model_config.max_model_len // world_size)
+    if (
+        world_size <= 1
+        or world_size > MAX_WORLD_SIZE
+        or parallel_config.prefill_context_parallel_size > 1
+        or vllm_config.kernel_config.sparse_indexer_topk_backend
+        not in ("auto", "deep_select")
+        or not current_platform.is_cuda()
+        or not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+        or not has_cutedsl()
+        or max_local_len > 1 << LOCAL_INDEX_BITS
+    ):
+        return 0
+    try:
+        import vllm._deepselect_C  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError:
+        return 0
+    return dcp_merge_local_topk(topk, world_size)
+
+
+def rescue_slots(topk: int, local_topk: int) -> int:
+    """Upper bound on the saturated ranks of one row in the exact merge.
+
+    A saturated rank sent N words, all strictly above the K-th selected key,
+    so they are among the K - 1 keys above it: at most ``(K - 1) // N``."""
+    return (topk - 1) // local_topk
+
+
+# (topk, local_topk) -> rows of the rescue workspace built by
+# init_dcp_topk_merge; a decode step with more rows takes the generic merge.
+_MERGE_MAX_ROWS: dict[tuple[int, int], int] = {}
+# topk -> init_dcp_topk_merge's result: the layers of a model share one
+# workspace, and the collectives run once (in the same order on every rank).
+_MERGE_INIT: dict[int, int] = {}
+
+
+def dcp_topk_merge_max_rows(topk: int, local_topk: int) -> int:
+    """Rows one merge call may hold (0 when the merge was not initialized)."""
+    return _MERGE_MAX_ROWS.get((topk, local_topk), 0)
+
+
+def dcp_topk_merge_fits(num_rows: int, topk: int, local_topk: int) -> bool:
+    """Whether a decode step of ``num_rows`` rows can take the one-round merge
+    (identical on every DCP rank): it was initialized and its rescue
+    workspace holds the rows. Otherwise the generic merge runs."""
+    return local_topk > 0 and num_rows <= dcp_topk_merge_max_rows(topk, local_topk)
+
+
+def init_dcp_topk_merge(vllm_config: Any, topk: int) -> int:
+    """Set up the exact one-round DCP decode top-k merge at model construction
+    and return its N, or 0 to keep the generic (fp32 all-gather) merge.
+
+    Collective: every DCP rank must call it, in the same order, outside CUDA
+    graph capture (only the first call per ``topk`` runs collectives). The
+    merge is exact only with its rescue workspace (symmetric memory over the
+    DCP group, sized by the decode rows of a step); without one the merge is
+    disabled here (fail closed) rather than run lossy. The ranks agree on
+    that before allocating; a failure of the (collective) allocation itself
+    is fatal. Also registers the merge kernels for JIT warmup.
+    """
+    if topk in _MERGE_INIT:
+        return _MERGE_INIT[topk]
+    local_topk = dcp_topk_merge_local_topk(vllm_config, topk)
+    if local_topk:
+        local_topk = _init_rescue(vllm_config, topk, local_topk)
+    _MERGE_INIT[topk] = local_topk
+    return local_topk
+
+
+def _init_rescue(vllm_config: Any, topk: int, local_topk: int) -> int:
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if parallel_config.use_ubatching:
+        # The rescue workspace holds one ubatch.
+        logger.info_once(
+            "DSA DCP top-k merge: generic merge (ubatching is not supported)."
+        )
+        return 0
+    import torch
+
+    from vllm.distributed import get_dcp_group
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.cp_common import direct_cp_enabled
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp import get_dcp_workspace_max_num_tokens
+
+    group = get_dcp_group()
+    max_rows = get_dcp_workspace_max_num_tokens(vllm_config)
+    # All ranks must agree before the collective allocation, or one would
+    # wait on the others (in the allocation, or later on rescue flags).
+    agree = torch.tensor(
+        [int(direct_cp_enabled(group, torch.int32, None))], dtype=torch.int32
+    )
+    torch.distributed.all_reduce(
+        agree, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.MIN, group=group.cpu_group
+    )
+    if not agree.item():
+        logger.warning_once(
+            "DSA DCP top-k merge: no symmetric memory over the DCP group; "
+            "using the generic merge."
+        )
+        return 0
+    from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge.kernels import (
+        init_dcp_topk_rescue_workspace,
+        register_dcp_topk_merge_warmup,
+    )
+
+    init_dcp_topk_rescue_workspace(max_rows, topk, local_topk, group)
+    _MERGE_MAX_ROWS[(topk, local_topk)] = max_rows
+    if vllm_config.kernel_config.enable_jit_warmup:
+        register_dcp_topk_merge_warmup(
+            topk, local_topk, parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size
+        )
+    logger.info_once(
+        "DSA DCP top-k merge: exact one-round merge of each rank's local "
+        "top-%d (rescue workspace for %d rows).",
+        local_topk,
+        max_rows,
+    )
+    return local_topk

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""One-round DCP decode top-k merge for the DSA indexer (CuTe DSL).
+
+Under DCP with interleave 1, rank ``r`` owns global token ``g`` iff
+``g % W == r`` and scores only its local tokens ``g // W``. The global top-K
+is merged from per-rank candidates:
+
+1. Each rank takes its local top-``N`` (``N`` ~ 1.5x the fair share ``K/W``)
+   from the bf16 logits and packs every candidate into one 32-bit word,
+   ``(ord16(score) << 16) | (0xFFFF - local[15:0])``, plus a bit plane
+   holding ``local[16]`` (one word per 32 candidates). Zero is padding.
+2. The ``[N + N/32]`` int32 rows are all-gathered over the DCP group
+   (``K / N`` times fewer bytes than the 8-byte ``(score, id)`` pairs of the
+   generic merge).
+3. Every rank radix-selects the top-``K`` of the ``W * N`` candidates under
+   (bf16 score desc, global id asc) and writes their global ids.
+
+The merge is exact: on every rank the selected scores equal, as a multiset,
+the top-``K`` of the union of all ranks' bf16 logits (equal scores may resolve
+to either token; the choice is a function of the gathered words, so all ranks
+agree). Round 1 can only miss a token of a *saturated* rank: one that sent
+``N`` words, all strictly above the ``K``-th selected key ``tau``. So the
+select also writes per row ``sat_word = (mask << 16) | ord16(tau)``, mask bit
+``r`` = rank ``r`` is saturated (identical on every rank). If the mask is 0,
+round 1 is exact. Otherwise (at most ``(K - 1) // N`` saturated ranks), each
+saturated rank pushes its local top-``K`` of the row into every rank's
+symmetric receive slot (P2P stores, then a release flag) from inside its
+select, which never waits; a persistent rescue kernel then re-selects the
+row over the other ranks' round-1 words at or above ``tau`` plus the pushed
+lists. The second round is exact without a third: every token it cannot see
+scores at most the ``K``-th of what it sees. Unsaturated rows cost the rescue
+one mask load.
+
+The rescue state (``DCPTopkRescueWorkspace``) is built once per DCP group by
+``init_dcp_topk_merge``; the entry points refuse to run without it. Every DCP
+rank must call every merge, the merges of a step must be stream-ordered, and
+no rank may start the round-1 exchange of call ``n + 1`` before its rescue of
+call ``n`` has finished (true for the all-gather here).
+
+Non-finite logits never cause an out-of-bounds access: the pack drops local
+ids outside ``[0, min(row_end, S, 2**17))`` (DeepSelect returns arbitrary ids
+for a row holding a NaN) and candidates with a NaN score, and the select
+never pushes past a row's rescue slots; +-inf scores are ordinary candidates
+(+inf first, -inf last, ties by global id). A row holding a NaN is outside
+the exactness contract: every rank still selects the same set, but it may
+miss top tokens of the rank whose local top-N the NaN disturbed.
+"""
+
+import functools
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any
+
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+import torch
+from cutlass import BFloat16, Int32, Int64, Uint16, Uint32, Uint64
+from cutlass._mlir.dialects import llvm
+from cutlass.cutlass_dsl import T, dsl_user_op
+from quack.compile_utils import make_fake_tensor
+
+from vllm.cute_utils import recast_val
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import kernel_launcher
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup_cutedsl_helper import (
+    CuTeDSLLaunchSpec,
+    VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel,
+)
+from vllm.v1.attention.ops.dcp_topk_merge import (
+    LOCAL_INDEX_BITS,
+    packed_row_words,
+    rescue_slots,
+)
+
+_WARP = 32
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def _block_scan_inclusive(
+    val: Int32, lane: Int32, warp: Int32, warp_totals: cute.Tensor, num_warps: int
+) -> Int32:
+    """Inclusive block-wide sum; ``warp_totals`` is smem [num_warps]."""
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+        partial = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_up(val, offset=1 << i, mask_and_clamp=0)
+        if lane >= Int32(1 << i):
+            val += partial
+    if lane == Int32(_WARP - 1):
+        warp_totals[warp] = val
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    if warp == Int32(0):
+        total = Int32(0)
+        if lane < Int32(num_warps):
+            total = warp_totals[lane]
+        prefix = total
+        for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(5):
+            partial = cute.arch.shuffle_sync_up(prefix, offset=1 << i, mask_and_clamp=0)
+            if lane >= Int32(1 << i):
+                prefix += partial
+        if lane < Int32(num_warps):
+            warp_totals[lane] = prefix - total
+    cute.arch.sync_threads()
+    return val + warp_totals[warp]
+
+
+class DCPTopkPackKernel(VllmCuTeDSLJitKernel["DCPTopkPackKernel.CompileKey"]):
+    """Local top-N indices (-1 padded) + bf16 logits -> packed candidate rows.
+
+    An index outside ``[0, min(row_end, S, 2**17))`` (``row_end`` from
+    ``row_ends`` when given) or a NaN score packs as an empty slot."""
+
+    max_tb_size = 512
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class CompileKey:
+        local_topk: int
+        has_row_ends: bool = False
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def kernel(compile_key: CompileKey) -> Any:
+        local_topk = compile_key.local_topk
+        has_row_ends = compile_key.has_row_ends
+        assert local_topk % _WARP == 0
+        tb_size = min(local_topk, DCPTopkPackKernel.max_tb_size)
+        num_chunks = -(-local_topk // tb_size)
+
+        @cute.kernel
+        def device_kernel(
+            logits: cute.Tensor,
+            local_idx: cute.Tensor,
+            packed: cute.Tensor,
+            row_ends: cute.Tensor,
+        ):
+            row, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+            tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+            # Ids past the row (DeepSelect's output for a NaN row) are dropped.
+            end = Int32(logits.shape[1])
+            if end > Int32(1 << LOCAL_INDEX_BITS):
+                end = Int32(1 << LOCAL_INDEX_BITS)
+            if cutlass.const_expr(has_row_ends):
+                row_end = row_ends[row]
+                if row_end < end:
+                    end = row_end
+            for c in cutlass.range_constexpr(num_chunks):
+                # local_topk is warp-aligned, so whole warps take this branch.
+                j = tid + Int32(c * tb_size)
+                if j < Int32(local_topk):
+                    local = local_idx[row, j]
+                    word = Uint32(0)
+                    high = False
+                    if local >= Int32(0) and local < end:
+                        bits = Uint32(recast_val(logits[row, local], Uint16))
+                        # NaN scores are dropped (no order).
+                        if (bits & Uint32(0x7FFF)) <= Uint32(0x7F80):
+                            # Order-preserving bf16 key: flip negatives, set
+                            # the sign bit of non-negatives.
+                            ordered = bits | Uint32(0x8000)
+                            if (bits & Uint32(0x8000)) != Uint32(0):
+                                ordered = ~bits & Uint32(0xFFFF)
+                            local_u = recast_val(local, Uint32)
+                            word = (ordered << Uint32(16)) | (
+                                Uint32(0xFFFF) - (local_u & Uint32(0xFFFF))
+                            )
+                            high = (local_u >> Uint32(16)) != Uint32(0)
+                    packed[row, j] = recast_val(word, Int32)
+                    high_bits = cute.arch.vote_ballot_sync(high)
+                    if j % Int32(_WARP) == Int32(0):
+                        packed[row, Int32(local_topk) + j // Int32(_WARP)] = high_bits
+
+        @cute.jit
+        def host_entrypoint(
+            logits: cute.Tensor,
+            local_idx: cute.Tensor,
+            packed: cute.Tensor,
+            row_ends: cute.Tensor,
+            stream,
+        ):
+            # Without has_row_ends ``row_ends`` is a placeholder.
+            device_kernel(logits, local_idx, packed, row_ends).launch(
+                grid=(packed.shape[0], 1, 1),
+                block=(tb_size, 1, 1),
+                stream=stream,
+            )
+
+        return host_entrypoint
+
+    def dispatch(  # type: ignore[override]
+        self, *, local_topk: int, has_row_ends: bool = False
+    ) -> CompileKey:
+        return self.CompileKey(local_topk=local_topk, has_row_ends=has_row_ends)
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(
+        self, *, local_topk: int, has_row_ends: bool = False
+    ) -> list[CompileKey]:
+        return self._trace_dispatch(self.dispatch)(
+            local_topk=local_topk, has_row_ends=has_row_ends
+        )
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, compile_key: CompileKey) -> tuple[Any, ...]:
+        num_rows = cute.sym_int()
+        local_idx = make_fake_tensor(
+            Int32, (num_rows, compile_key.local_topk), divisibility=1
+        )
+        return (
+            make_fake_tensor(BFloat16, (num_rows, cute.sym_int()), divisibility=1),
+            local_idx,
+            make_fake_tensor(
+                Int32,
+                (num_rows, packed_row_words(compile_key.local_topk)),
+                divisibility=1,
+            ),
+            make_fake_tensor(Int32, (cute.sym_int(),))
+            if compile_key.has_row_ends
+            else local_idx,
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(
+        self,
+        logits: torch.Tensor,
+        local_idx: torch.Tensor,
+        packed: torch.Tensor,
+        row_ends: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    ) -> CuTeDSLLaunchSpec[CompileKey]:
+        compile_key = self.dispatch(
+            local_topk=local_idx.shape[1], has_row_ends=row_ends is not None
+        )
+        return compile_key, (
+            logits,
+            local_idx,
+            packed,
+            local_idx if row_ends is None else row_ends,
+        )
+

+# Device helpers for the exact-merge rescue (raw-address loads/stores with
+# explicit memory semantics; the peer buffers are symmetric memory).
+
+
+def _asm(result_type, operands, asm: str, constraints: str, *, loc, ip):
+    return llvm.inline_asm(
+        result_type,
+        [operand.ir_value(loc=loc, ip=ip) for operand in operands],
+        asm,
+        constraints,
+        has_side_effects=True,
+        is_align_stack=False,
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+def _asm_void(operands, asm: str, constraints: str, *, loc, ip) -> None:
+    # A dummy result keeps the side-effecting asm in the DSL's value graph.
+    _asm(
+        T.i32(),
+        operands,
+        "mov.u32 $0, 0;\n\t" + asm,
+        ",".join(("=r", constraints)) if constraints else "=r",
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_i64(addr: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int64:
+    return Int64(
+        _asm(T.i64(), [Int64(addr)], "ld.global.u64 $0, [$1];", "=l,l", loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_u32(addr: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Uint32:
+    return Uint32(
+        _asm(T.i32(), [Int64(addr)], "ld.global.u32 $0, [$1];", "=r,l", loc=loc, ip=ip)
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_v4(addr: Int64, v0, v1, v2, v3, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    _asm_void(
+        [Int64(addr), *(Int32(v) for v in (v0, v1, v2, v3))],
+        "st.global.v4.u32 [$1], {$2, $3, $4, $5};",
+        "l,r,r,r,r",
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _ld_acquire_sys(addr: Int64, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int32:
+    return Int32(
+        _asm(
+            T.i32(),
+            [Int64(addr)],
+            "ld.acquire.sys.global.u32 $0, [$1];",
+            "=r,l",
+            loc=loc,
+            ip=ip,
+        )
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _st_release_sys(addr: Int64, value: Int32, *, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    _asm_void(
+        [Int64(addr), Int32(value)],
+        "st.release.sys.global.u32 [$1], $2;",
+        "l,r",
+        loc=loc,
+        ip=ip,
+    )
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _globaltimer(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> Int64:
+    return Int64(_asm(T.i64(), [], "mov.u64 $0, %globaltimer;", "=l", loc=loc, ip=ip))
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _nanosleep(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    _asm_void([], "nanosleep.u32 64;", "", loc=loc, ip=ip)
+
+
+@dsl_user_op
+def _trap(*, loc=None, ip=None) -> None:
+    _asm_void([], "trap;", "", loc=loc, ip=ip)
